weapons.name: Burnt Sienna
weapons.why: strong early ranged melee whip option
weapons.effect: Enemies killed using the weapon will drop three small orbs that each heal the player for 2 HP when picked up.

weapons.name: Enchanted Boomerang
weapons.why: Upgraded boomerang that returns faster and hits harder.
weapons.effect: It is a direct upgrade to the Wooden Boomerang.

weapons.name: Monstrous Knives
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: rapid thrown knife damage
weapons.effect: When used, the player throws a spread of 3-4 gravity-affected knives that heal the player for 5% to 10% of the damage dealt. The knives fade away after a short amount of time, losing 10% of its damage and knockback every 0.5 seconds, then disappear into cosmetic red dust when fully transparent.

weapons.name: Starfury
weapons.why: Calls a falling star from the sky on each swing.
weapons.effect: When swung, it occasionally summons a star projectile that falls from the sky to the cursor. The star deals ×1.5 the weapon's damage (37 base damage) but no knockback, and pierces once. [ 1 ] The star will pass through all blocks until it reaches the lowest empty space at or above the cursor, after which it will break on the next block it hits.

weapons.name: Terragrim
weapons.source: Rare drop from Enchanted Sword Shrine swords
weapons.why: Rapidly releases a flurry of slash projectiles toward the cursor when used.
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly releases slashes aimed towards the cursor. Anything within this area takes constant damage at a rate exceeding the weapon's stated use time.

armor.name: Gold armor
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +3 defense · Enemies have a 2% chance to drop 1 gold coin, and bosses always drop an extra 3 gold coin · +1% critical strike chance per 5 gold coin in inventory, capped at +5%
armor.desc: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet, Gold Chainmail, and Gold Greaves. The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

armor.name: Platinum armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: No set bonus. Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +4 defense · +10% damage reduction
armor.desc: Platinum armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Platinum Helmet, Platinum Chainmail, and Platinum Greaves. The full set grants 20 defense while equipped.

armor.name: Silver armor
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +3 defense · 2 seconds after being hit for ≥20 damage, heal for 10 health; getting hit again during this time will reset the timer
armor.desc: Silver armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Silver Helmet, Silver Chainmail, and Silver Greaves. The full set grants 13 defense while equipped.

accessories.name: Dunerider Boots
accessories.source: Dropped by Desert enemies, or found in Sandstone Chests in the Underground Desert
accessories.effect: The wearer can run super fast, and even faster on sand

accessories.name: Sandstorm in a Bottle
accessories.source: Found in Pyramids in the Desert
accessories.effect: Allows the holder to do an improved double jump

accessories.name: Fledgling Wings
accessories.source: Found in Azure Crate and 2 other sources
accessories.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
accessories.effect: Grants flight and gliding, and negates fall damage · At top speed, travels 15 mph horizontally and 22 mph vertically

accessories.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.source: Dropped by Blood Zombie and 1 other source
accessories.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration.
accessories.effect: It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

accessories.name: Black Glass Band
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

accessories.name: Feral Claws
accessories.source: Found in Jungle Chests, Ivy Chests and Jungle Crates
accessories.why: The melee speed and autoswing boost noticeably improves several early melee weapons.
accessories.effect: 12% increased melee speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons

accessories.name: Rover Drive
accessories.effect: When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

accessories.name: Luxor's Gift
accessories.effect: Summons a scarab launcher that follows you closely · The scarab launcher fires different projectiles at enemies depending on your held weapon type

buffs.name: Lesser Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It is the first tier of healing potion, preceding the Healing Potion, Greater Healing Potion, Jungle Juice and Super Healing Potion.

buffs.name: Eggnog
buffs.source: Dropped by Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event
buffs.effect: When used, it restores 80 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 40 seconds. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Roasted Bird
buffs.source: Crafted
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 10 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Sharpening Station
buffs.source: Found in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle
buffs.why: The armor penetration bonus is one of the best class-specific pre-Hardmode melee boosts.
buffs.effect: In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Merchant for 10 GC.

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Extra jump
items.why: Allows the player to perform a double-jump.
items.effect: Extra jumps allow the player to perform one or more extra mid-air jumps and are granted by five different accessories and four different mounts.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.name: Hermes Boots
items.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests
items.why: Movement is survival in early Terraria, and Hermes Boots give you the speed to dodge, kite, and position better.
items.effect: While equipped, they grant the ability to sprint, allowing the player to reach maximum running speed faster, and they increase the player's maximum movement speed to 31 mph (22.73 tiles/second).

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.source: Purchased from the Shady Salesman for 25 gold during a Full Moon after the item has been found
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Ilmeris' Spark
items.why: This is best on worms and other multi-hit scenarios.
items.effect: When equipped, it causes the player to release 8 gravity-affected sparks around them when harmed by any source of damage. These sparks linger for 2 seconds, partially ignore immunity frames, and deal 6 base damage, which is boosted by the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Rover Drive
items.effect: When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

items.name: Black Glass Band
items.effect: While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
items.effect: While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Feral Claws
items.source: Found in Jungle Chests, Ivy Chests and Jungle Crates
items.why: The melee speed and autoswing boost noticeably improves several early melee weapons.
items.effect: 12% increased melee speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons

items.source: Dropped by Blood Zombie and 1 other source
items.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration.
items.effect: It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

tools.name: Wulfrum Controller
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

weapons.name: Demon Bow
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Corruption bow requiring Shadow Scales dropped by the Eater of Worlds.

weapons.name: Tendon Bow
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Crimson counterpart to the Demon Bow.

weapons.name: Flintlock Pistol
weapons.source: Purchased from the Arms Dealer (5 GC)
weapons.why: Basic pistol sold by the Arms Dealer before any boss.

weapons.name: Molotov Cocktail
weapons.why: area fire damage
weapons.effect: Upon hitting a solid object or enemy, it will explode and release 6 Molotov Fire light emitting projectiles, which can hit up to 3 targets. These smaller projectiles deal 50% damage (11 base damage), apply no knockback and inflict the On Fire! debuff on enemies for 3–6 seconds.

weapons.name: Paintball Gun
weapons.why: Fires a three-shot burst of arcing paintballs and uses no ammunition.
weapons.effect: The Paintball Gun has a 11% critical strike chance, as opposed to the usual 4%. It has a 1/10 (10%) chance of being dropped by the Painter.

weapons.name: Spark Spreader
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Wulfrum-set gun option
weapons.effect: When used, it fires bursts of 4 short-ranged orange sparks with a 0.2 second delay in between. The sparks inflict the On Fire! debuff and pierce three enemies.

armor.name: Fossil armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.effect: 20% chance to save ammo
armor.desc: Fossil armor is a pre-Hardmode ranged armor set consisting of the Fossil Helmet, Fossil Plate, and Fossil Greaves.

armor.name: Snow Ruffian armor
armor.effect: You can glide to negate fall damage · Ranged critical strikes inflict Frostburn for 2 seconds

ammo.name: Flash Round
ammo.effect: They can bounce off enemies and tiles and creates a small flash which knocks away enemies. They become affected by gravity after bouncing, and can bounce off tiles twice, gaining 13% damage or +2 flat damage on each bounce, whichever is greater.

ammo.name: Frostburn Arrow
ammo.effect: It has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance to inflict the Frostburn debuff for 3 seconds on enemies.

ammo.name: Jester's Arrow
ammo.effect: It is unaffected by gravity and can pierce an infinite number of enemies, and its damage decreases by 10% per each enemy pierced.

ammo.name: Silver Bullet
ammo.effect: It deals 2 more damage and is slightly faster than Musket Balls. It also deals 300% damage to Werewolves. [ 1 ]

ammo.name: Tungsten Bullet
ammo.effect: It deals 2 more damage and is slightly faster than Musket Balls. When either Musket Balls or Tungsten Bullets are fired with certain guns, they will be converted into a special projectile (e.g. the Uzi converting them into High Velocity Bullets).

ammo.name: Unholy Arrow
ammo.effect: It can pierce 4 enemies, and its damage decreases by 5% per enemy pierced.

items.effect: It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

items.name: Extra jump
items.why: Allows the player to perform a double-jump.
items.effect: Extra jumps allow the player to perform one or more extra mid-air jumps and are granted by five different accessories and four different mounts.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.name: Hermes Boots
items.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests
items.why: Movement is survival in early Terraria, and Hermes Boots give you the speed to dodge, kite, and position better.
items.effect: While equipped, they grant the ability to sprint, allowing the player to reach maximum running speed faster, and they increase the player's maximum movement speed to 31 mph (22.73 tiles/second).

tools.name: Wulfrum Controller
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

weapons.name: Amber Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Gem staff whose amber bolt travels faster than other gem staves.
weapons.effect: It is the fifth tier of gem staff, along with the Ruby Staff, which has identical stats.

weapons.name: Crimson Rod
weapons.source: Destroyed from Crimson Hearts, or fished in Crimson/Hematic Crates
weapons.why: Places a lingering blood cloud that rains piercing droplets downward onto enemies below.
weapons.effect: One cloud projectile can be placed at a time and it does not pass through terrain, instead stopping if it hits a surface before it reaches its target location. Once placed, the cloud will remain for five minutes, similarly to the Nimbus Rod 's cloud.

weapons.name: Thunder Zapper
weapons.source: Found in Sandstone Chests and Oasis/Mirage Crates (Desert)
weapons.why: Fires an electric bolt that pierces one enemy, found in the Desert.
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a lightning bolt that travels in a zigzag pattern horizontally (but traveling straight when shooting directly up or down).

weapons.name: Veering Wind
weapons.why: solid primary magic option
weapons.effect: When used with its primary fire (⚒ Use / Attack), it fires an even ring of 12 fast air waves which travel outwards from the player and deal heavy knockback. When used with its secondary fire (⚷ Open / Activate), it instead fires frost waves that inflict the Frostburn and Frozen debuffs, with 20% knockback, 25% velocity, and 50% attack speed compared to the air waves.

weapons.name: Vilethorn
weapons.source: Dropped by Shadow Orbs (Corruption); found in Corrupt Crates
weapons.why: Projects a piercing line of thorns through blocks and enemies.
weapons.effect: It has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from destroying Shadow Orbs found in the Corruption or a 1/5 (20%) chance from Corrupt Crates (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) and Defiled Crates (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions), which are fished in the Corruption. When used, it extends a 15-tile-long thorn from the player's position, which passes through blocks, pierces infinite enemies, and hits rapidly for up to six times per enemy.

armor.name: Gold armor
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +3 defense · Enemies have a 2% chance to drop 1 gold coin, and bosses always drop an extra 3 gold coin · +1% critical strike chance per 5 gold coin in inventory, capped at +5%
armor.desc: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet, Gold Chainmail, and Gold Greaves. The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

armor.name: Platinum armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +4 defense · +10% damage reduction
armor.desc: Platinum armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Platinum Helmet, Platinum Chainmail, and Platinum Greaves. The full set grants 20 defense while equipped.

armor.name: Silver armor
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +3 defense · 2 seconds after being hit for ≥20 damage, heal for 10 health; getting hit again during this time will reset the timer
armor.desc: Silver armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Silver Helmet, Silver Chainmail, and Silver Greaves. The full set grants 13 defense while equipped.

accessories.name: Dunerider Boots
accessories.source: Dropped by Desert enemies, or found in Sandstone Chests in the Underground Desert
accessories.effect: The wearer can run super fast, and even faster on sand

accessories.name: Sandstorm in a Bottle
accessories.source: Found in Pyramids in the Desert
accessories.effect: Allows the holder to do an improved double jump

accessories.name: Fledgling Wings
accessories.source: Found in Azure Crate and 2 other sources
accessories.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
accessories.effect: Grants flight and gliding, and negates fall damage · At top speed, travels 15 mph horizontally and 22 mph vertically

accessories.name: Magiluminescence
accessories.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Shark Tooth Necklace

accessories.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration.
accessories.effect: It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

accessories.name: Nature's Gift
accessories.source: Grows on Jungle grass in the Underground Jungle
accessories.effect: 6% reduced mana cost

accessories.name: Band of Starpower
accessories.source: Found in Shadow Orbs / Crimson Hearts
accessories.effect: The Band of Starpower has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from destroying Shadow Orbs found in the Corruption or a 1/5 (20%) chance from Corrupt Crates and Defiled Crates, which are fished in the Corruption. It can furthermore be crafted.

accessories.name: Rover Drive

accessories.name: Luxor's Gift
accessories.effect: Summons a scarab launcher that follows you closely · The scarab launcher fires different projectiles at enemies depending on your held weapon type

buffs.name: Lesser Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It is the first tier of healing potion, preceding the Healing Potion, Greater Healing Potion, Jungle Juice and Super Healing Potion.

buffs.name: Eggnog
buffs.source: Dropped by Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event
buffs.effect: When used, it restores 80 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 40 seconds. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Mana Potion
buffs.source: Crafted, or found in most Crates
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: They are also sold by the Merchant in Hardmode for 2 SC 50 CC.

buffs.name: Roasted Bird
buffs.source: Crafted
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 10 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

weapons.name: Rusty Beacon Prototype
weapons.why: primary sentry for stationary damage

weapons.name: Squirrel Squire Staff
weapons.why: alternative sentry
weapons.effect: Is also obtained from the Starter Bag. When used, it summons a stationary squirrel sentry at the nearest block to the player's location. If there are no blocks directly underneath it, it will start falling.

weapons.name: Leather Whip
weapons.why: Bought from the Zoologist and directs minions onto the struck target.
weapons.effect: 4 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · 'Die monster!'

items.name: Black Glass Band

items.name: Craw Carapace

items.name: Shark Tooth Necklace

items.name: Wulfrum Battery

weapons.name: Antlion Skewer

weapons.name: Contaminated Bile
weapons.why: solid area-denial spam option; first-listed stealth strike option
weapons.effect: It throws a bile flask that shatters into a lingering irradiated cloud on hit.

weapons.name: Gilded Dagger
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a fast-moving golden dagger that ricochets towards the nearest enemy after hitting the first enemy. The dagger pierces once and breaks on tile contact.

weapons.name: Gleaming Dagger
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a fast-moving platinum dagger that ricochets towards the nearest enemy after hitting the first enemy. The dagger pierces once and breaks on tile contact.

weapons.name: Urchin Stinger
weapons.why: alternative spam weapon
weapons.effect: When used, they fire an urchin stinger that travels a short distance before being affected by gravity. The urchin stinger pierces once and inflicts the Poisoned debuff on hit.

weapons.name: Wulfrum Knife
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: early spam knife; stealth knife
weapons.effect: When used with its primary fire (⚒ Use / Attack), it throws a set of three knives in quick succession. The knives are affected by gravity and do not pierce.

weapons.name: Iron Francisca
weapons.effect: It throws a gravity affected axe that travels a short distance before falling to the ground. Each axe's damage has a 2x damage increase for the first 0.25 seconds after being thrown.

weapons.name: Lead Tomahawk
weapons.effect: It throws a gravity affected axe that travels a short distance before falling to the ground. Each axe's damage has a 2x damage increase for the first 0.25 seconds after being thrown.

armor.name: Desert Prowler armor

items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
items.effect: The Fledgling Wings are the only pre-Hardmode wings. Like all wings, they grant the player the ability to fly and glide when equipped, as well as not take fall damage. At top speed, they allow traveling at 15 mph horizontally and 22 mph vertically.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.name: Lightning Boots
items.why: You still need top-tier horizontal movement because every mech fight punishes sloppy spacing.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

items.name: Shield of Cthulhu
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eye of Cthulhu)
items.effect: While equipped, it grants 2 defense and allows the player to perform a dash attack by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right button, or the Dash button once. Dashing into an enemy deals damage to it, causes the player to bounce backward, and grants 0.07 seconds of invincibility frames and 0.17 seconds of immunity to contact damage from the hit enemy. [ 1 ] The cooldown between dashes is 0.5 seconds. [ 2 ]

items.name: Fungal Clump
items.effect: When equipped, it summons a Fungal Clump minion that attaches to enemies, damaging them and spawning blue healing orbs that home in on the player and heal them for 25% of the damage the minion deals.

items.name: Crown Jewel
items.why: This is difficult to obtain.
items.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.source: Purchased from the Shady Salesman for 25 gold during a Full Moon after the item has been found
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Rover Drive
items.effect: When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

items.name: Unholy Tonic
items.why: Use which matches your world evil.
items.effect: When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Corruption. It also grants immunity to the Brain Rot debuff.

items.name: Vicious Tonic
items.why: Use which matches your world evil.
items.effect: When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Crimson. It also grants immunity to the Burning Blood debuff.

items.name: Amidias' Pendant
items.effect: While equipped, it causes 3 homing prism shards to fall from the sky every 2 seconds. Each shard deals 30 base damage.

items.name: Black Glass Band
items.effect: While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
items.effect: While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Feral Claws
items.source: Found in Jungle Chests, Ivy Chests and Jungle Crates
items.why: The melee speed and autoswing boost noticeably improves several early melee weapons.
items.effect: 12% increased melee speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons

items.name: Extra jump
items.why: Allows the player to perform a double-jump.
items.effect: Extra jumps allow the player to perform one or more extra mid-air jumps and are granted by five different accessories and four different mounts.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

tools.name: Brittle Star Staff
tools.effect: When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

tools.name: Wulfrum Controller
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

weapons.name: Blood Rain Bow
weapons.source: Dropped by Wandering Eye Fish and Zombie Merman (Blood Moon fishing)
weapons.why: Fires arrows in an arc that rain down from above.
weapons.effect: When used, it converts any type of arrow into a spread of 1–3 streams of blood (average of 1.83 streams) [ 1 ] to rain from the sky, directed towards the cursor. Each use only consumes one arrow.

weapons.name: Boomstick
weapons.source: Found in Ivy Chests and Jungle/Bramble Crates
weapons.why: Pre-Hardmode shotgun that fires a spread of bullets, found in the Jungle.
weapons.effect: It can be found in Ivy Chests (21.72% chance) in the Underground Jungle, and also in Jungle Crates (19/100 (19%) chance). When used, it fires a spread of 3–4 bullets, consuming one piece of ammunition.

weapons.name: Fungicide
weapons.why: reliable auto-firing gun
weapons.effect: When Musket Balls are used as ammo, it fires a fungus bullet that, upon impact with an enemy or tile, splits into smaller spores which are affected by gravity. These spores quickly home in on nearby enemies and are not affected by gravity while doing so.

weapons.name: Spark Spreader
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: continuous flame gun for crowds
weapons.effect: When used, it fires bursts of 4 short-ranged orange sparks with a 0.2 second delay in between. The sparks inflict the On Fire! debuff and pierce three enemies.

weapons.name: Spiky Ball
weapons.source: Dropped by all goblins during the Goblin Army event, and can be purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for 80 CC each
weapons.effect: If not destroyed, they will automatically vanish after 1 minute and 20 seconds. [ 1 ] They can also be directly thrown at enemies, but they have a very short arc and quickly fall to the ground. Spiky Balls have a 199/400 (49.75%) chance of being dropped by all goblins during the Goblin Army event (except for the Goblin Warlock), and can be purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for 80 CC each.

armor.name: Fossil armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.effect: 20% chance to save ammo
armor.desc: Fossil armor is a pre-Hardmode ranged armor set consisting of the Fossil Helmet, Fossil Plate, and Fossil Greaves.

armor.name: Snow Ruffian armor
armor.effect: You can glide to negate fall damage · Ranged critical strikes inflict Frostburn for 2 seconds
armor.desc: Snow Ruffian armor is a Pre-Hardmode ranged armor set.

armor.name: Victide armor
armor.effect: When using any weapon you have a 10% chance to throw a returning seashell projectile · This seashell does true damage and does not benefit from any damage class · Provides increased underwater mobility and slightly reduces breath loss in the abyss
armor.desc: Victide armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: +1.5 HP/s life regen and 10% increased ranged damage while submerged in liquid

armor.name: Gold armor
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +3 defense · Enemies have a 2% chance to drop 1 gold coin, and bosses always drop an extra 3 gold coin · +1% critical strike chance per 5 gold coin in inventory, capped at +5%
armor.desc: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet, Gold Chainmail, and Gold Greaves. The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

armor.name: Platinum armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: No set bonus. Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +4 defense · +10% damage reduction
armor.desc: Platinum armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Platinum Helmet, Platinum Chainmail, and Platinum Greaves. The full set grants 20 defense while equipped.

accessories.name: Spectre Boots
accessories.effect: Grants flight · The wearer can run super fast

accessories.name: Sandstorm in a Balloon
accessories.effect: Grants an improved double jump · Increases jump height

accessories.name: Fledgling Wings
accessories.source: Found in Azure Crate and 2 other sources
accessories.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
accessories.effect: Grants flight and gliding, and negates fall damage · At top speed, travels 15 mph horizontally and 22 mph vertically

accessories.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.source: Dropped by Blood Zombie and 1 other source
accessories.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration.
accessories.effect: It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

accessories.name: Magiluminescence
accessories.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Scions Curio
accessories.effect: Ranged hits increase the effectiveness of Irradiated · Irradiated damage over time scales off of your ranged damage and crit chance · On kill, enemies burst, spreading Irradiated · Taking damage causes the curio to explode in retaliation · Current Irradiated damage: [DAMAGE]

accessories.name: Rover Drive
accessories.effect: When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

accessories.name: Crown Jewel
accessories.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s

buffs.name: Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It is the second tier of healing potion, succeeding the Lesser Healing Potion and preceding the Greater Healing Potion, Jungle Juice and Super Healing Potion.

buffs.name: Strange Brew
buffs.source: Purchased from the Skeleton Merchant during certain moon phases for 5 SC
buffs.effect: When used, it restores 70–120 health, inflicts 40–70 seconds of Potion Sickness, and has a 3/5 (60%) chance to grant up to 4 seconds of invincibility. The duration of Potion Sickness can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Ammo consumption adds up quickly on the strongest guns, so this stretches your best supplies further.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff reduces the chance of consuming any ammunition by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage of arrow -firing weapons by 10%, as well as the velocity of arrows by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Bounding Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Bounding buff, which increases jump speed by 5% and jump height by 20%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

ammo.effect: They can bounce off enemies and tiles and creates a small flash which knocks away enemies. They become affected by gravity after bouncing, and can bounce off tiles twice, gaining 13% damage or +2 flat damage on each bounce, whichever is greater.

ammo.name: Musket Ball
ammo.effect: It has no special properties and is used for crafting a variety of more advanced ammunition. When either Musket Balls or Tungsten Bullets are fired with certain guns, they will be converted into a special projectile (e.g. the Uzi converting them into High Velocity Bullets).

ammo.name: Tungsten Bullet
ammo.effect: It deals 2 more damage and is slightly faster than Musket Balls. When either Musket Balls or Tungsten Bullets are fired with certain guns, they will be converted into a special projectile (e.g. the Uzi converting them into High Velocity Bullets).

ammo.name: Shimmer Arrow
ammo.effect: It experiences reversed gravity when fired.

weapons.name: Acid Gun
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: steady ranged magic damage
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a volley of three acid streams that dissipate on collision with tiles or after piercing once. The acid streams inflict the Irradiated debuff.

weapons.name: Crimson Rod
weapons.source: Destroyed from Crimson Hearts, or fished in Crimson/Hematic Crates
weapons.why: Places a lingering blood cloud that rains piercing droplets downward onto enemies below.
weapons.effect: One cloud projectile can be placed at a time and it does not pass through terrain, instead stopping if it hits a surface before it reaches its target location. Once placed, the cloud will remain for five minutes, similarly to the Nimbus Rod 's cloud.

weapons.name: Gray Zapinator
weapons.why: Fires an erratic light beam that ricochets and varies in size.
weapons.effect: It is only available once King Slime, the Eye of Cthulhu, Eater of Worlds, Brain of Cthulhu, Queen Bee, Deerclops, or Skeletron has been defeated. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Orange Zapinator.

weapons.name: Sparkling Empress
weapons.source: Fished in the Sunken Sea after defeating Desert Scourge
weapons.why: strong sustained damage
weapons.effect: When used, it briefly charges, then releases a concentrated light-blue laser that pierces infinitely. Upon killing an enemy, they explode into two to three prism shards that shoot out in random directions, dealing 20% of the weapon's base damage.

weapons.name: Thunder Zapper
weapons.source: Found in Sandstone Chests and Oasis/Mirage Crates (Desert)
weapons.why: Fires an electric bolt that pierces one enemy, found in the Desert.
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a lightning bolt that travels in a zigzag pattern horizontally (but traveling straight when shooting directly up or down).

accessories.effect: The Band of Starpower has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from destroying Shadow Orbs found in the Corruption or a 1/5 (20%) chance from Corrupt Crates and Defiled Crates, which are fished in the Corruption. It can furthermore be crafted.

accessories.name: Rover Drive
accessories.effect: When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

accessories.name: Crown Jewel
accessories.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s

buffs.name: Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It is the second tier of healing potion, succeeding the Lesser Healing Potion and preceding the Greater Healing Potion, Jungle Juice and Super Healing Potion.

buffs.name: Strange Brew
buffs.source: Purchased from the Skeleton Merchant during certain moon phases for 5 SC
buffs.effect: When used, it restores 70–120 health, inflicts 40–70 seconds of Potion Sickness, and has a 3/5 (60%) chance to grant up to 4 seconds of invincibility. The duration of Potion Sickness can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Mana Potion
buffs.source: Crafted, or found in most Crates
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: They are also sold by the Merchant in Hardmode for 2 SC 50 CC.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases magic damage by 20%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the rate at which the player's mana regenerates. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Bounding Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Bounding buff, which increases jump speed by 5% and jump height by 20%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Extra jump
items.why: Allows the player to perform a double-jump.
items.effect: Extra jumps allow the player to perform one or more extra mid-air jumps and are granted by five different accessories and four different mounts.

items.name: Fledgling Wings
items.source: Found in Azure Crate and 2 other sources
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
items.effect: The Fledgling Wings are the only pre-Hardmode wings. Like all wings, they grant the player the ability to fly and glide when equipped, as well as not take fall damage. At top speed, they allow traveling at 15 mph horizontally and 22 mph vertically.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.name: Lightning Boots
items.why: Sprint and flight movement in one slot, accelerating faster and reaching a higher top speed than Spectre Boots.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

items.name: Shield of Cthulhu
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eye of Cthulhu)
items.effect: While equipped, it grants 2 defense and allows the player to perform a dash attack by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right button, or the Dash button once. Dashing into an enemy deals damage to it, causes the player to bounce backward, and grants 0.07 seconds of invincibility frames and 0.17 seconds of immunity to contact damage from the hit enemy. [ 1 ] The cooldown between dashes is 0.5 seconds. [ 2 ]

items.name: Fungal Clump
items.effect: When equipped, it summons a Fungal Clump minion that attaches to enemies, damaging them and spawning blue healing orbs that home in on the player and heal them for 25% of the damage the minion deals.

items.name: Crown Jewel
items.why: This is difficult to obtain.
items.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.source: Purchased from the Shady Salesman for 25 gold during a Full Moon after the item has been found
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Rover Drive
items.effect: When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

items.name: Unholy Tonic
items.why: Use which matches your world evil.
items.effect: When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Corruption. It also grants immunity to the Brain Rot debuff.

items.name: Vicious Tonic
items.why: Use which matches your world evil.
items.effect: When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Crimson. It also grants immunity to the Burning Blood debuff.

items.name: Amidias' Pendant
items.effect: While equipped, it causes 3 homing prism shards to fall from the sky every 2 seconds. Each shard deals 30 base damage.

items.name: Black Glass Band
items.effect: While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
items.effect: While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Mana Flower
items.why: Auto-potion support remains useful even when your mana tools are otherwise maximized.
items.effect: The Mana Flower stacks with other mana cost-reduction items, including Nature's Gift. It is.

items.name: Magic Cuffs
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 20 · Restores mana when damaged

tools.name: Brittle Star Staff
tools.effect: When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

tools.name: Wulfrum Controller
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

weapons.name: Brittle Star Staff
weapons.why: primary minion recommendation
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

weapons.name: Deathstare Rod
weapons.source: Dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu
weapons.why: solid alternative minion
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a tiny floating eyeball above the player's head that fires lasers at nearby enemies once every second. On hit, the laser deals damage in a tiny area of effect.

weapons.name: Enchanted Conch
weapons.source: Purchased from Sea King for 2 gold
weapons.why: crowd control on worms
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a Hermit Crab minion that runs on the ground or jumps around, dealing contact damage to enemies. If the player is far away, it will twirl around within its shell to catch up with them but will not be able to attack enemies while in this form.

weapons.name: Polyp Launcher
weapons.source: Purchased from Sea King for 2 gold
weapons.why: primary sentry recommendation
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a grounded polyp sentry which inaccurately fires gravity-affected balls of coral at nearby enemies. On hit, the coral chunk bursts into 1-4 fragments which deals half as much damage and knockback.

weapons.name: Rusty Beacon Prototype
weapons.why: alternative sentry option
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a stationary Rusty drone that bobs up and down. Every 2 seconds, starting 1 second after it is summoned, it fires a toxic wave pulse that inflicts the Irradiated debuff.

weapons.name: Snapthorn
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Jungle-material whip that inflicts Acid Venom and grants summon tag damage.
weapons.effect: 6 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies to gain whip attack speed

armor.name: Victide armor
armor.effect: When using any weapon you have a 10% chance to throw a returning seashell projectile · This seashell does true damage and does not benefit from any damage class · Provides increased underwater mobility and slightly reduces breath loss in the abyss
armor.desc: Victide armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: +1 max minion · Summons a sea snail to protect you · +1.5 HP/s life regen and 10% increased summon damage while submerged in liquid

armor.name: Wulfrum armor
armor.desc: Wulfrum armor is a Pre-Hardmode summoner armor set.
armor.effect: Wulfrum Bastion - Armor Set Bonus to equip a power armor, costing one Wulfrum Metal Scrap · While active, you can only use the integrated fusion cannon, but your defensive stats are increased · The armor lasts up to 30 seconds, but each hit loses 2 seconds of duration · Hold Shift to see the stats of the fusion cannon

armor.name: Gold armor
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +3 defense · Enemies have a 2% chance to drop 1 gold coin, and bosses always drop an extra 3 gold coin · +1% critical strike chance per 5 gold coin in inventory, capped at +5%
armor.desc: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet, Gold Chainmail, and Gold Greaves. The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

armor.name: Platinum armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +4 defense · +10% damage reduction
armor.desc: Platinum armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Platinum Helmet, Platinum Chainmail, and Platinum Greaves. The full set grants 20 defense while equipped.

items.effect: Minion attacks provide various buffs · Hold Shift for more Spirit Power grants 10% increased summon damage · Spirit Defense grants 2 defense · Spirit Regen grants 0.5 HP/s life regeneration

items.name: Crown Jewel
items.why: This is difficult to obtain.
items.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.source: Purchased from the Shady Salesman for 25 gold during a Full Moon after the item has been found

items.name: Rover Drive
items.effect: When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

items.name: Unholy Tonic

items.name: Vicious Tonic

items.effect: When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Crimson. It also grants immunity to the Burning Blood debuff.

items.name: Amidias' Pendant
items.effect: While equipped, it causes 3 homing prism shards to fall from the sky every 2 seconds. Each shard deals 30 base damage.

items.name: Black Glass Band
items.effect: While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
items.effect: While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Voltaic Jelly
items.source: Dropped by Ghost Bells after Desert Scourge has been defeated
items.effect: When equipped, it grants +1 minion slot and a 20% chance for minions to inflict the Static Discharge debuff. It does not stack with the Jelly-Charged Battery or its upgrades.

weapons.name: Pumpkaboom
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: primary spam thrown weapon
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a pumpkin bomb that sticks to enemies on hit. Upon sticking to enemies for 1.83 seconds, it explodes in a 10.625 tile radius for 200% damage.

weapons.name: Sand Dollar
weapons.source: Purchased from Sea King for 2 gold
weapons.why: solid spam alternative
weapons.effect: When used, it throws up to 2 sand dollars that return to the player after traveling a moderate distance or hitting an enemy.

weapons.name: Seafoam Bomb
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: area-damage spam option
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a small bomb that travels a short distance before being affected by gravity. Upon collision with a tile or enemy, the bomb explodes into a bubble that ignores enemy immunity frames.

weapons.name: Spore Knife
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: listed spam/stealth thrown option
weapons.effect: It releases damaging spore clouds upon contact with a surface or enemy.

weapons.name: Contaminated Bile
weapons.why: high stealth-strike damage for this tier
weapons.effect: It throws a bile flask that shatters into a lingering irradiated cloud on hit.

weapons.name: Scourge of the Desert
weapons.why: high stealth-strike damage alternative
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a javelin that burrows into tiles and launches itself towards the closest enemy when burrowing through tiles. Thrown javelins are slightly affected by gravity and pierce twice.

armor.name: Sulphurous armor
armor.effect: +65 maximum stealth · Attacking and being attacked by enemies inflicts Poisoned for 1 second · Grants an additional jump that summons a sulphurous bubble · Reduces the severity of the sulphuric waters
armor.desc: Sulphurous armor is a Pre-Hardmode rogue armor set.

armor.name: Victide armor
armor.effect: When using any weapon you have a 10% chance to throw a returning seashell projectile · This seashell does true damage and does not benefit from any damage class · Provides increased underwater mobility and slightly reduces breath loss in the abyss
armor.desc: Victide armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: +60 maximum stealth · +1.5 HP/s life regen and 10% increased rogue damage while submerged in liquid

armor.name: Gold armor
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +3 defense · Enemies have a 2% chance to drop 1 gold coin, and bosses always drop an extra 3 gold coin · +1% critical strike chance per 5 gold coin in inventory, capped at +5%
armor.desc: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet, Gold Chainmail, and Gold Greaves. The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

armor.name: Platinum armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +4 defense · +10% damage reduction
armor.desc: Platinum armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Platinum Helmet, Platinum Chainmail, and Platinum Greaves. The full set grants 20 defense while equipped.

accessories.name: Spectre Boots
accessories.effect: Grants flight · The wearer can run super fast

accessories.name: Sandstorm in a Balloon
accessories.effect: Grants an improved double jump · Increases jump height

accessories.effect: Grants flight and gliding, and negates fall damage · At top speed, travels 15 mph horizontally and 22 mph vertically

accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: When equipped, it increases rogue critical strike chance by 6% and makes stealth strikes only require 90% of the player's maximum stealth to perform and consume 90% of the player's maximum stealth when performed.

accessories.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.source: Dropped by Blood Zombie and 1 other source
accessories.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration.
accessories.effect: It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

accessories.name: Scuttler's Jewel
accessories.effect: When equipped, it causes rogue projectiles to spawn a stationary floating jewel spike on the first hit of a stealth strike that deals 16 rogue damage. It can also be used at an Extractinator to obtain gems.

weapons.effect: When swung, it fires a glowing aquamarine sword beam that emits glowing particles, deals damage and travels indefinitely, disappearing upon hitting a block or an enemy.

weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
