items.name: Extra jump
items.why: Allows the player to perform a double-jump.
items.effect: Extra jumps allow the player to perform one or more extra mid-air jumps and are granted by five different accessories and four different mounts.

items.name: Fledgling Wings
items.source: Found in Azure Crate and 2 other sources
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
items.effect: The Fledgling Wings are the only pre-Hardmode wings. Like all wings, they grant the player the ability to fly and glide when equipped, as well as not take fall damage. At top speed, they allow traveling at 15 mph horizontally and 22 mph vertically.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.name: Lightning Boots
items.why: You still need top-tier horizontal movement because every mech fight punishes sloppy spacing.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

items.name: Shield of Cthulhu
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eye of Cthulhu)
items.effect: While equipped, it grants 2 defense and allows the player to perform a dash attack by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right button, or the Dash button once. Dashing into an enemy deals damage to it, causes the player to bounce backward, and grants 0.07 seconds of invincibility frames and 0.17 seconds of immunity to contact damage from the hit enemy. [ 1 ] The cooldown between dashes is 0.5 seconds. [ 2 ]

items.name: Fungal Clump
items.effect: When equipped, it summons a Fungal Clump minion that attaches to enemies, damaging them and spawning blue healing orbs that home in on the player and heal them for 25% of the damage the minion deals.

items.name: Brain of Confusion
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Brain of Cthulhu)
items.effect: Has a chance to create illusions and dodge an attack · Temporarily increase critical chance and minion damage after dodge · May confuse nearby enemies after being struck

items.name: Crown Jewel
items.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.source: Purchased from the Shady Salesman for 25 gold during a Full Moon after the item has been found
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Unholy Tonic
items.why: Use which matches your world evil.
items.effect: When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Corruption. It also grants immunity to the Brain Rot debuff.

items.name: Vicious Tonic
items.why: Use which matches your world evil.
items.effect: When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Crimson. It also grants immunity to the Burning Blood debuff.

items.name: Worm Scarf
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eater of Worlds)
items.why: Reduces all damage taken by 17%.
items.effect: While equipped, it grants +17% damage reduction.

items.name: Counterweights
items.source: Purchased from the Traveling Merchant and the Skeleton Merchant
items.why: Causes yoyos after landing a hit on enemies to produce a "counterweight" projectile, which travels towards the enemy before arcing over the player.
items.effect: Counterweights are accessories sold by the Traveling Merchant and the Skeleton Merchant. They fire a second yoyo-type projectile after hitting an enemy with a yoyo, which travels towards it, then orbits around the player. Counterweights deal the yoyo's full damage and stay active until the yoyo is retracted towards the player.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
items.effect: While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Feral Claws
items.source: Found in Jungle Chests, Ivy Chests and Jungle Crates
items.why: The melee speed and autoswing boost noticeably improves several early melee weapons.
items.effect: 12% increased melee speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons

items.name: Magma Stone
items.why: Causes melee attacks to inflict Hellfire.
items.effect: It has a 1/50 (2%) chance to be dropped by Lava Bats and a 1/150 (0.67%) chance to be dropped by Hellbats in The Underworld.

items.name: Extra jump

tools.name: Wulfrum Controller
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

weapons.name: Boomstick
weapons.source: Found in Ivy Chests and Jungle/Bramble Crates
weapons.why: Pre-Hardmode shotgun that fires a spread of bullets, found in the Jungle.
weapons.effect: It can be found in Ivy Chests (21.72% chance) in the Underground Jungle, and also in Jungle Crates (19/100 (19%) chance). When used, it fires a spread of 3–4 bullets, consuming one piece of ammunition.

weapons.name: Firestorm Cannon
weapons.effect: Like the Flare Gun, it uses Flares as ammunition and has a 33% chance to not consume ammo.

weapons.name: Magna Cannon
weapons.effect: While holding, the player channels a glowing blue orb at the tip of the gun and loads one crystal bolt every 0.15 seconds. After channeling for 2.3 seconds, the orb reaches maximum power, increasing the amount of loaded bolts to 20.

weapons.name: Opal Striker
weapons.effect: While holding, the player channels a glowing orange orb at the tip of the gun which reaches its maximum power after 1.47 seconds. Releasing while fully charged discharges a charged bolt which deals 500% damage and 300% knockback, inflicts the Hellfire debuff, and pierces twice.

weapons.name: Molten Fury
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Hellstone-tier bow that ignites the arrows it fires.
weapons.effect: When used, it converts Wooden Arrows into Flaming Arrows, causing them to inflict the On Fire! debuff on hit.

weapons.name: Spiky Ball
weapons.source: Dropped by all goblins during the Goblin Army event, and can be purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for 80 CC each
weapons.effect: If not destroyed, they will automatically vanish after 1 minute and 20 seconds. [ 1 ] They can also be directly thrown at enemies, but they have a very short arc and quickly fall to the ground. Spiky Balls have a 199/400 (49.75%) chance of being dropped by all goblins during the Goblin Army event (except for the Goblin Warlock), and can be purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for 80 CC each.

armor.name: Victide armor
armor.effect: When using any weapon you have a 10% chance to throw a returning seashell projectile · This seashell does true damage and does not benefit from any damage class · Provides increased underwater mobility and slightly reduces breath loss in the abyss
armor.desc: Victide armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: +1.5 HP/s life regen and 10% increased ranged damage while submerged in liquid

armor.name: Crimson armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Crimson worlds only. Greatly increased life regeneration.
armor.effect: Greatly increased life regeneration · This is increased the longer you are not damaged · Standing still also greatly increases life regeneration
armor.desc: Crimson armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crimson Helmet, Crimson Scalemail, and Crimson Greaves.

armor.name: Shadow armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Corruption worlds only. Increased movement speed and acceleration.
armor.effect: Increased movement speed and acceleration
armor.desc: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet, Shadow Scalemail, and Shadow Greaves.

buffs.name: Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It is the second tier of healing potion, succeeding the Lesser Healing Potion and preceding the Greater Healing Potion, Jungle Juice and Super Healing Potion.

buffs.name: Honeyfin
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It can also be used to craft Seafood Dinners.

buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron

buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

weapons.source: Dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons in the Underworld

weapons.effect: When used, it spawns 4 non-piercing flaming bats that go through tiles and quickly dissipate after spawning. The way the bats spawn depends on where the cursor spawns them.

items.name: Extra jump
items.why: Allows the player to perform a double-jump.
items.effect: Extra jumps allow the player to perform one or more extra mid-air jumps and are granted by five different accessories and four different mounts.

items.name: Fledgling Wings
items.source: Found in Azure Crate and 2 other sources
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
items.effect: The Fledgling Wings are the only pre-Hardmode wings. Like all wings, they grant the player the ability to fly and glide when equipped, as well as not take fall damage. At top speed, they allow traveling at 15 mph horizontally and 22 mph vertically.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.name: Lightning Boots
items.why: Sprint and flight movement in one slot, accelerating faster and reaching a higher top speed than Spectre Boots.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

items.name: Shield of Cthulhu
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eye of Cthulhu)
items.effect: While equipped, it grants 2 defense and allows the player to perform a dash attack by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right button, or the Dash button once. Dashing into an enemy deals damage to it, causes the player to bounce backward, and grants 0.07 seconds of invincibility frames and 0.17 seconds of immunity to contact damage from the hit enemy. [ 1 ] The cooldown between dashes is 0.5 seconds. [ 2 ]

items.name: Fungal Clump
items.effect: When equipped, it summons a Fungal Clump minion that attaches to enemies, damaging them and spawning blue healing orbs that home in on the player and heal them for 25% of the damage the minion deals.

items.name: Brain of Confusion
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Brain of Cthulhu)
items.effect: Has a chance to create illusions and dodge an attack · Temporarily increase critical chance and minion damage after dodge · May confuse nearby enemies after being struck

items.name: Crown Jewel
items.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.source: Purchased from the Shady Salesman for 25 gold during a Full Moon after the item has been found
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Unholy Tonic
items.why: Use which matches your world evil.
items.effect: When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Corruption. It also grants immunity to the Brain Rot debuff.

items.name: Vicious Tonic
items.why: Use which matches your world evil.
items.effect: When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Crimson. It also grants immunity to the Burning Blood debuff.

items.name: Worm Scarf

items.why: Reduces all damage taken by 17%.
items.effect: While equipped, it grants +17% damage reduction.

items.name: Batholith Bangle

tools.name: Brittle Star Staff
tools.effect: When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

tools.name: Wulfrum Controller
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil

weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Summons an Imp minion that fires On Fire! bolts; needs Underworld Hellstone.

weapons.name: Scab Ripper
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a tiny Blood Crawler minion that flies around and latches onto nearby enemies. When latched, it deals contact damage in addition to spawning 2 damaging blood particles from the sky that pierce once.

weapons.name: Vile Feeder
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a tiny Eater of Souls minion, which flies around and latches onto nearby enemies. When latched, it does not deal contact damage to enemies but releases several homing tiny eaters similar to the Scourge of the Corruptor.

weapons.name: Polyp Launcher
weapons.source: Purchased from Sea King for 2 gold
weapons.why: primary sentry option
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a grounded polyp sentry which inaccurately fires gravity-affected balls of coral at nearby enemies. On hit, the coral chunk bursts into 1-4 fragments which deals half as much damage and knockback.

weapons.name: Rusty Beacon Prototype
weapons.why: alternative sentry
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a stationary Rusty drone that bobs up and down. Every 2 seconds, starting 1 second after it is summoned, it fires a toxic wave pulse that inflicts the Irradiated debuff.

weapons.name: Snapthorn
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Jungle-material whip that inflicts Acid Venom and grants summon tag damage.
weapons.effect: 6 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies to gain whip attack speed

armor.effect: Increases whip range by 30% and speed by 15% · Increases summon damage by 15% · Grants immunity to fire blocks and temporary immunity to lava
armor.desc: Obsidian armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Obsidian Outlaw Hat, Obsidian Longcoat, and Obsidian Pants.

armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.effect: Increased movement speed and acceleration
armor.desc: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet, Shadow Scalemail, and Shadow Greaves.

armor.why: Corruption worlds only. Increased movement speed and acceleration.
armor.effect: Increased movement speed and acceleration
armor.desc: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet, Shadow Scalemail, and Shadow Greaves.

accessories.name: Lightning Boots
accessories.why: You still need top-tier horizontal movement because every mech fight punishes sloppy spacing.
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed

accessories.name: Yellow Horseshoe Balloon
accessories.effect: Grants an improved double jump · Increases jump height by 75% and negates fall damage

accessories.name: Fledgling Wings
accessories.source: Found in Azure Crate and 2 other sources
accessories.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
accessories.effect: Grants flight and gliding, and negates fall damage · At top speed, travels 15 mph horizontally and 22 mph vertically

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eye of Cthulhu)
accessories.effect: While equipped, it grants 2 defense and allows the player to perform a dash attack by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right button, or the Dash button once. Dashing into an enemy deals damage to it, causes the player to bounce backward, and grants 0.07 seconds of invincibility frames and 0.17 seconds of immunity to contact damage from the hit enemy. [ 1 ] The cooldown between dashes is 0.5 seconds. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Rotten Dogtooth
accessories.effect: Stealth strikes inflict Crumbling and deal 8% more damage

accessories.name: Ink Bomb
accessories.source: Dropped by Cuttlefish and Colossal Squids
accessories.effect: Stealth generates 7% faster · Throws several ink bombs when hit that explode into ink and confuse enemies · Gain a lot of stealth when struck · This effect has a 20 second cooldown before it can occur again

accessories.name: Silencing Sheath
accessories.effect: When equipped, it increases maximum rogue stealth by 10 and increases rogue stealth generation by 4%.

accessories.name: Raider's Talisman
accessories.effect: Stealth strikes grant 15% critical strike chance to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds

buffs.name: Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It is the second tier of healing potion, succeeding the Lesser Healing Potion and preceding the Greater Healing Potion, Jungle Juice and Super Healing Potion.

buffs.name: Honeyfin
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It can also be used to craft Seafood Dinners.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Shadow Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Shadow buff, which provides the following effects:

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Bounding Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Bounding buff, which increases jump speed by 5% and jump height by 20%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Extra jump
items.effect: Extra jumps allow the player to perform one or more extra mid-air jumps and are granted by five different accessories and four different mounts.

items.name: Fledgling Wings
items.source: Found in Azure Crate and 2 other sources
items.effect: The Fledgling Wings are the only pre-Hardmode wings. Like all wings, they grant the player the ability to fly and glide when equipped, as well as not take fall damage. At top speed, they allow traveling at 15 mph horizontally and 22 mph vertically.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.name: Lightning Boots
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

items.name: Shield of Cthulhu
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eye of Cthulhu)
items.effect: While equipped, it grants 2 defense and allows the player to perform a dash attack by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right button, or the Dash button once. Dashing into an enemy deals damage to it, causes the player to bounce backward, and grants 0.07 seconds of invincibility frames and 0.17 seconds of immunity to contact damage from the hit enemy. [ 1 ] The cooldown between dashes is 0.5 seconds. [ 2 ]

items.name: Fungal Clump
items.effect: When equipped, it summons a Fungal Clump minion that attaches to enemies, damaging them and spawning blue healing orbs that home in on the player and heal them for 25% of the damage the minion deals.

items.name: Brain of Confusion
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Brain of Cthulhu)
items.why: Dodges in Calamity are guaranteed on a cooldown.
items.effect: Has a chance to create illusions and dodge an attack · Temporarily increase critical chance and minion damage after dodge · May confuse nearby enemies after being struck

items.name: Crown Jewel
items.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.source: Purchased from the Shady Salesman for 25 gold during a Full Moon after the item has been found
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Unholy Tonic
items.why: Use which matches your world evil.
items.effect: When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Corruption. It also grants immunity to the Brain Rot debuff.

items.name: Vicious Tonic
items.why: Use which matches your world evil.
items.effect: When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Crimson. It also grants immunity to the Burning Blood debuff.

items.name: Worm Scarf
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eater of Worlds)
items.effect: While equipped, it grants +17% damage reduction.

items.name: Black Glass Band
items.effect: While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Coin of Deceit
items.effect: When equipped, it increases rogue critical strike chance by 6% and makes stealth strikes only require 90% of the player's maximum stealth to perform and consume 90% of the player's maximum stealth when performed.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
items.effect: While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
items.source: Dropped by Blood Zombie and 1 other source
items.effect: It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

items.name: Scuttler's Jewel
items.effect: When equipped, it causes rogue projectiles to spawn a stationary floating jewel spike on the first hit of a stealth strike that deals 16 rogue damage. It can also be used at an Extractinator to obtain gems.

items.name: Silencing Sheath
items.effect: When equipped, it increases maximum rogue stealth by 10 and increases rogue stealth generation by 4%.

items.name: Extra jump
items.why: Allows the player to perform a double-jump.
items.effect: Extra jumps allow the player to perform one or more extra mid-air jumps and are granted by five different accessories and four different mounts.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

tools.name: Brittle Star Staff
tools.effect: When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

tools.name: Wulfrum Controller
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

weapons.name: Aorta
weapons.effect: While deployed, it fires blood clots to enemies within 16 tiles, which first travel a short distance in that direction before homing in on the target; only then can they deal damage. The blood clots do not pierce or pass through tiles, and they deal 25% of the weapon's damage.

weapons.name: Bladecrest Oathsword
weapons.source: Dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons in The Underworld
weapons.effect: It throws a sword that sticks into enemies, with a max of 3 being able to be stuck into a single enemy. If another is stuck, the oldest one will be launched out.

weapons.name: Goldplume Spear
weapons.effect: At the peak of its thrust it fires a burst of 3 gravity-affected, non-piercing feathers that deal 50% of the weapon's damage.

weapons.name: Perfect Dark
weapons.effect: When swung, it fires a dark ball that sticks to any tile that it contacts. After sticking onto a tile for 4 seconds or upon hitting an enemy, it explodes, emitting purple particles and damaging all enemies in a small radius.

weapons.name: Vein Burster
weapons.effect: When swung, it fires a blood ball that sticks to any tile that it contacts. After sticking onto a tile for 4 seconds or upon hitting an enemy, it explodes, emitting red projectiles and damaging all enemies in a small radius.

weapons.name: Wind Blade
weapons.effect: When swung, it emits glowing blue dust particles and fires a wind cyclone that pierces once before disappearing on the second hit. The cyclone deals 60% of the sword's damage and drags non- boss enemies towards it for a short amount of time before disappearing.

armor.name: Aerospec armor
armor.effect: Taking over 25 damage in one hit will cause a spread of homing feathers to fall · Allows you to fall more quickly and disables fall damage
armor.desc: Aerospec armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.
armor.headpieceBonus: 5% increased movement speed and melee critical strike chance · Enemies are more likely to target you

armor.name: Molten armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: 10% extra melee damage, immunity to fire blocks, and you cannot be set on fire.
armor.effect: 7% extra melee damage and 10% extra true melee damage. Additionally grants immunity to fire blocks, and temporary immunity to lava.
armor.desc: Molten armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Molten Helmet, Molten Breastplate, and Molten Greaves.

armor.name: Crimson armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Crimson worlds only. Greatly increased life regeneration.
armor.effect: Greatly increased life regeneration · This is increased the longer you are not damaged · Standing still also greatly increases life regeneration
armor.desc: Crimson armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crimson Helmet, Crimson Scalemail, and Crimson Greaves.

armor.name: Shadow armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Corruption worlds only. Increased movement speed and acceleration.
armor.effect: Increased movement speed and acceleration
armor.desc: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet, Shadow Scalemail, and Shadow Greaves.

accessories.name: Terraspark Boots
accessories.source: Combined through the full boots crafting chain
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava

accessories.name: Skyline Wings
accessories.effect: When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide at a low height.

accessories.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
accessories.why: Provides substantial vertical mobility and acceleration. This accessory becomes easier to obtain in Hardmode, as the Blizzard in a Bottle and Sandstorm in a Bottle are now able to be crafted.
accessories.effect: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage

accessories.source: Found in Jungle Chests, Ivy Chests and Jungle Crates

accessories.effect: When equipped, it grants 2 defense and increases melee damage by 10%.

weapons.name: Firestorm Cannon
weapons.effect: Like the Flare Gun, it uses Flares as ammunition and has a 33% chance to not consume ammo.

The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

weapons.name: Dank Staff
weapons.why: highest minion damage at this tier
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a miniature Dank Creeper that attempts to latch onto enemies to deal damage and inflicts the Brain Rot debuff upon contact.

weapons.name: Hornet Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Summons a Hornet minion that inflicts Poisoned; Bee Wax drops from Queen Bee.
weapons.effect: It hovers above enemies, firing stingers that inflict the Poisoned debuff for 4–7 seconds and do not pierce.

weapons.name: Imp Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Summons an Imp minion that fires On Fire! bolts; needs Underworld Hellstone.
weapons.effect: It hovers near enemies, shooting fireballs that inflict the On Fire! debuff for 3–6 seconds and can pierce up to 4 enemies.

weapons.name: P-PMA: Aqueous Hunter Drone
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Wulfrum minion option
weapons.effect: It spends 4 minion slots to summon an arsenal shrimp minion that floats around the player. When an enemy is nearby, it will launch a burst of homing plasma missiles.

weapons.name: Houndius Shootius
weapons.why: Pre-Hardmode sentry dropped by Deerclops that shoots piercing fireballs.
weapons.effect: It shoots fireballs towards enemies, which dissipate upon contact with enemies or blocks. The Houndius Shootius has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Deerclops.

weapons.name: Polyp Launcher
weapons.source: Purchased from Sea King for 2 gold
weapons.why: alternative sentry
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a grounded polyp sentry which inaccurately fires gravity-affected balls of coral at nearby enemies. On hit, the coral chunk bursts into 1-4 fragments which deals half as much damage and knockback.

weapons.name: Snapthorn
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Jungle-material whip that inflicts Acid Venom and grants summon tag damage.
weapons.effect: 6 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies to gain whip attack speed

armor.name: Aerospec armor
armor.effect: Taking over 25 damage in one hit will cause a spread of homing feathers to fall · Allows you to fall more quickly and disables fall damage
armor.desc: Aerospec armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.
armor.headpieceBonus: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 11% increased summon damage · Summons a valkyrie to protect you

armor.name: Bee armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Summon damage +10%. No whip bonus, so it suits minion-led builds.
armor.effect: Increases summon damage by 10%
armor.desc: Bee armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Bee Headgear, Bee Breastplate, and Bee Greaves.

armor.name: Obsidian armor
armor.why: Whip range +30%, whip speed +15%, summon damage +15%.
armor.effect: Increases whip range by 30% and speed by 15% · Increases summon damage by 15% · Grants immunity to fire blocks and temporary immunity to lava
armor.desc: Obsidian armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Obsidian Outlaw Hat, Obsidian Longcoat, and Obsidian Pants.

armor.name: Crimson armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.effect: Greatly increased life regeneration · This is increased the longer you are not damaged · Standing still also greatly increases life regeneration
armor.desc: Crimson armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crimson Helmet, Crimson Scalemail, and Crimson Greaves.

armor.name: Shadow armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.effect: Increased movement speed and acceleration
armor.desc: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet, Shadow Scalemail, and Shadow Greaves.

accessories.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
accessories.why: Provides substantial vertical mobility and acceleration. This accessory becomes easier to obtain in Hardmode, as the Blizzard in a Bottle and Sandstorm in a Bottle are now able to be crafted.
accessories.effect: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage

accessories.name: Skyline Wings
accessories.effect: When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide at a low height.

accessories.name: Spirit Glyph
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Minion attacks provide various buffs · Hold Shift for more Spirit Power grants 10% increased summon damage · Spirit Defense grants 2 defense · Spirit Regen grants 0.5 HP/s life regeneration

accessories.name: Frog Leg
accessories.source: Fished up in any body of water
accessories.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
accessories.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

accessories.name: Lightning Boots
accessories.why: You still need top-tier horizontal movement because every mech fight punishes sloppy spacing.
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed

accessories.name: Magiluminescence
accessories.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Craw Carapace
accessories.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
accessories.effect: While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

accessories.name: Hive Pack
accessories.why: Increases the damage of friendly bees.
accessories.effect: While equipped, it grants a 1/2 (50%) chance of replacing friendly Bee projectiles with stronger Giant Bees. [ 1 ]

accessories.name: Pygmy Necklace
accessories.effect: It is purchased from the Witch Doctor for 20 GC at night.

accessories.name: Voltaic Jelly
accessories.source: Dropped by Ghost Bells after Desert Scourge has been defeated
accessories.effect: When equipped, it grants +1 minion slot and a 20% chance for minions to inflict the Static Discharge debuff. It does not stack with the Jelly-Charged Battery or its upgrades.

accessories.name: Brain of Confusion
accessories.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Brain of Cthulhu)
accessories.effect: Has a chance to create illusions and dodge an attack · Temporarily increase critical chance and minion damage after dodge · May confuse nearby enemies after being struck

accessories.name: Crown Jewel
accessories.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s

accessories.name: Honey Dew
accessories.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

accessories.name: Gladiator's Locket
accessories.source: Purchased from Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found
accessories.effect: When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

accessories.name: Worm Scarf
accessories.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eater of Worlds)
accessories.effect: While equipped, it grants +17% damage reduction.

buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It is the second tier of healing potion, succeeding the Lesser Healing Potion and preceding the Greater Healing Potion, Jungle Juice and Super Healing Potion.

buffs.name: Honeyfin
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It can also be used to craft Seafood Dinners.

buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.

buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Warmth Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 15 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.effect: Causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the On Fire! debuff for 3–6 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Flask of Poison
buffs.source: Brewed at Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.effect: Causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Poisoned debuff for 5–9 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The extra minion slot is too valuable to skip, even in the earliest summoner boss prep.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum number of minions by 1. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: War Table
buffs.source: Dropped by the Dark Mage and Ogre during the Old One's Army
buffs.why: Table buff that boosts minion damage.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Bounding Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Bounding buff, which increases jump speed by 5% and jump height by 20%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

weapons.why: first-listed spam rogue weapon, steady rapid damage

weapons.why: alternate spam thrown weapon
weapons.effect: When used, it throws honeycomb projectiles that are slightly affected by gravity and shatter into 2 fragments upon collision with an enemy or tile. The honeycomb fragments fly in random directions and deal 100% of the weapon's base damage.

weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: alternate spam thrown weapon
weapons.effect: When used, it releases a rocket fist which connects to the player via a wire. After 1 second, the fist begins to accelerate and home towards the cursor's position, leaving a fiery trail behind it.

weapons.effect: When thrown, the disk detects the nearest enemy and fires lasers towards them, accelerating further the longer it is out. items.effect: Has a chance to create illusions and dodge an attack · Temporarily increase critical chance and minion damage after dodge · May confuse nearby enemies after being struck

items.name: Crown Jewel
items.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s

items.name: Honey Dew
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.source: Purchased from the Shady Salesman for 25 gold during a Full Moon after the item has been found
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Worm Scarf
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eater of Worlds)
items.effect: While equipped, it grants +17% damage reduction.

items.name: Coin of Deceit
items.effect: When equipped, it increases rogue critical strike chance by 6% and makes stealth strikes only require 90% of the player's maximum stealth to perform and consume 90% of the player's maximum stealth when performed.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
items.effect: While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
items.source: Dropped by Blood Zombie and 1 other source
items.effect: It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

items.name: Filthy Glove
items.effect: When equipped, it makes stealth strikes deal 8% more damage and have +8 armor penetration.

items.name: Silencing Sheath
items.effect: When equipped, it increases maximum rogue stealth by 10 and increases rogue stealth generation by 4%.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.name: Lightning Boots
items.why: You still need top-tier horizontal movement because every mech fight punishes sloppy spacing.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

tools.name: Brittle Star Staff
tools.effect: When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

tools.name: Wulfrum Controller
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

weapons.name: Dark Lance
weapons.source: Found in Underworld Shadow Chests (Shadow Key) and Obsidian Lock Boxes
weapons.why: Underworld Shadow Chest spear opened with a Dungeon-found Shadow Key.
weapons.effect: The Dark Lance inflicts the Shadowflame debuff for 4–5 seconds and creates a small shockwave at its tip.

weapons.name: Fractured Ark
weapons.effect: Holding ⚒ Use / Attack (default: Left Click) performs a simple combo of a downwards slash followed by an upwards one.

weapons.name: Goldplume Spear
weapons.effect: At the peak of its thrust it fires a burst of 3 gravity-affected, non-piercing feathers that deal 50% of the weapon's damage.

weapons.name: Wind Blade
weapons.effect: When swung, it emits glowing blue dust particles and fires a wind cyclone that pierces once before disappearing on the second hit. The cyclone deals 60% of the sword's damage and drags non- boss enemies towards it for a short amount of time before disappearing.

armor.name: Molten armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: 10% extra melee damage, immunity to fire blocks, and you cannot be set on fire.
armor.effect: 7% extra melee damage and 10% extra true melee damage. Additionally grants immunity to fire blocks, and temporary immunity to lava.
armor.desc: Molten armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Molten Helmet, Molten Breastplate, and Molten Greaves.

armor.name: Statigel armor
armor.effect: Grants an extra jump and increased jump height · 12% increased jump speed
armor.desc: Statigel armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: Enemies are more likely to target you

accessories.name: Terraspark Boots
accessories.source: Combined through the full boots crafting chain
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava

accessories.name: Skyline Wings
accessories.effect: When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide at a low height.

accessories.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
accessories.why: Provides substantial vertical mobility and acceleration. This accessory becomes easier to obtain in Hardmode, as the Blizzard in a Bottle and Sandstorm in a Bottle are now able to be crafted.
accessories.effect: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage

accessories.name: Counter Scarf
accessories.source: Purchased from the Clothier for 20 gold
accessories.effect: It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys, with a base distance of 14 blocks.

accessories.name: Feral Claws
accessories.source: Found in Jungle Chests, Ivy Chests and Jungle Crates
accessories.why: The melee speed and autoswing boost noticeably improves several early melee weapons.
accessories.effect: 12% increased melee speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons

accessories.name: Bloody Worm Tooth
accessories.effect: When equipped, it grants 2 defense and increases melee damage by 10%.

accessories.name: Radiant Ooze
accessories.effect: While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

buffs.name: Honeyfin
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It can also be used to craft Seafood Dinners.

buffs.source: Found in Shadow Chests in the Underworld
buffs.effect: When used, it restores 90 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for only 45 seconds (rather than the usual 60 of health-restoring potions). The duration of Potion Sickness can be reduced to 33.75 seconds via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Inferno Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Flask of Fire
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.effect: Causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the On Fire! debuff for 3–6 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Flask of Poison
buffs.source: Brewed at Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.effect: Causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Poisoned debuff for 5–9 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Sharpening Station
buffs.source: Found in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle
buffs.why: The armor penetration bonus is one of the best class-specific pre-Hardmode melee boosts.
buffs.effect: In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Merchant for 10 GC.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Bounding Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Bounding buff, which increases jump speed by 5% and jump height by 20%.

buffs.name: Slice of Cake

items.effect: It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys, with a base distance of 14 blocks.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

items.name: Terraspark Boots
items.source: Combined through the full boots crafting chain
items.why: Even when wings are online, the best boots still improve the feel and consistency of a finished build.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava

items.name: Brain of Confusion
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Brain of Cthulhu)
items.effect: Has a chance to create illusions and dodge an attack · Temporarily increase critical chance and minion damage after dodge · May confuse nearby enemies after being struck

items.name: Crown Jewel
items.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s

items.name: Honey Dew
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.source: Purchased from the Shady Salesman for 25 gold during a Full Moon after the item has been found
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Obsidian Shield
items.why: Knockback immunity, fire block immunity and 2 defense.
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Grants immunity to fire blocks

items.name: Radiant Ooze
items.effect: While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

items.name: Bone Glove
items.why: Causes crossbone projectiles to be thrown from the player's weapon at a maximum of once every second.
items.effect: The crossbones projectiles ricochet off walls three times or pierce two enemies before being destroyed, deal 25 classless damage, and additionally have 25 armor penetration. The Bone Glove is always dropped from Skeletron 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
items.effect: While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Protolith Bangle
items.effect: While equipped, it releases a marble shatter upon enemy hits with ranged weapons that deals 30 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 7 second cooldown. The shatter's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

tools.name: Brittle Star Staff
tools.effect: When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

tools.name: Wulfrum Controller
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

ammo.name: Meteor Shot
ammo.effect: When fired, it can either bounce from a solid block once or pierce through one enemy.

ammo.name: Musket Ball
ammo.effect: It has no special properties and is used for crafting a variety of more advanced ammunition. When either Musket Balls or Tungsten Bullets are fired with certain guns, they will be converted into a special projectile (e.g. the Uzi converting them into High Velocity Bullets).

ammo.name: Tungsten Bullet
ammo.effect: It deals 2 more damage and is slightly faster than Musket Balls. When either Musket Balls or Tungsten Bullets are fired with certain guns, they will be converted into a special projectile (e.g. the Uzi converting them into High Velocity Bullets).

ammo.name: Shimmer Arrow
ammo.effect: It experiences reversed gravity when fired.

weapons.name: Abyssal Tome
weapons.why: first-listed primary magic weapon at this tier
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a slow-moving purple glob that passes through tiles and is not affected by gravity and will slowly decelerate before stopping in place. After hitting an enemy twice or after 5 seconds from being shot, it will explode, dealing damage in a small radius.

weapons.name: Aqua Scepter
weapons.source: Found in Gold Chests / Golden Lock Boxes
weapons.why: Sprays a stream of water droplets that pierce enemies.
weapons.effect: The water streams bounce upwards upon colliding with lava. They pierce infinitely after a bounce, move slower, are less affected by gravity and can last for a significantly longer time. [ 1 ]

weapons.name: Blood Bath
weapons.why: area magic weapon option
weapons.effect: When used, it spawns 2-3 blood raindrops from the sky that pierce once but cannot pass through tiles. The raindrops inflict the Burning Blood debuff.

weapons.name: Demon Scythe
weapons.source: Dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons in the Underworld
weapons.why: Fires accelerating sickle projectiles that pierce up to five enemies.
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a sickle projectile that is initially static before gradually accelerating. The sickles can hit up to five times before dissipating, and they cannot pass through blocks.

weapons.name: Eldritch Tome
weapons.why: homing magic weapon
weapons.effect: When used, it releases red tendrils which bend in random directions, similarly to the Shadowflame Hex Doll.

weapons.name: Night's Ray
weapons.source: Crafted at a Demon Altar or Crimson Altar
weapons.why: multi-star magic weapon with high DPS
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a purple beam that pierces ten times. When the beam hits an enemy, it spawns 4 four short-range particle beams to damage nearby enemies.

armor.name: Aerospec armor
armor.effect: Taking over 25 damage in one hit will cause a spread of homing feathers to fall · Allows you to fall more quickly and disables fall damage
armor.desc: Aerospec armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.
armor.headpieceBonus: 8% reduced mana cost · 5% increased movement speed and magic critical strike chance

armor.name: Meteor armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Space Gun costs 0 mana, so it pairs with that weapon specifically.
armor.effect: Reduces the mana cost of all magic guns to 33%
armor.desc: Meteor armor is a pre-Hardmode mage armor set consisting of the Meteor Helmet, Meteor Suit, and Meteor Leggings.

armor.name: Statigel armor
armor.effect: Grants an extra jump and increased jump height · 12% increased jump speed
armor.desc: Statigel armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set.

accessories.name: Terraspark Boots
accessories.source: Combined through the full boots crafting chain
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava

accessories.name: Skyline Wings
accessories.effect: When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide at a low height.

accessories.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
accessories.why: Provides substantial vertical mobility and acceleration. This accessory becomes easier to obtain in Hardmode, as the Blizzard in a Bottle and Sandstorm in a Bottle are now able to be crafted.
accessories.effect: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage

accessories.name: Counter Scarf
accessories.source: Purchased from the Clothier for 20 gold
accessories.effect: It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys, with a base distance of 14 blocks.

accessories.name: Magnet Flower
accessories.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Increases pickup range for mana stars

accessories.name: Mana Polarizer
accessories.effect: Increases maximum mana by 40 · Provides life regeneration and magic damage that scales based on how much mana you have · Lower mana means more life regeneration, but less magic damage · These scale from -2 to +2 HP/s, and 15% to 5% damage · The provided regeneration is halved when under Mana Sickness · Magic projectiles steal enemy life

accessories.name: Radiant Ooze
accessories.effect: While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

buffs.name: Honeyfin
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It can also be used to craft Seafood Dinners.

buffs.name: Restoration Potion
buffs.source: Found in Shadow Chests in the Underworld
buffs.effect: When used, it restores 90 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for only 45 seconds (rather than the usual 60 of health-restoring potions). The duration of Potion Sickness can be reduced to 33.75 seconds via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Mana Potion
buffs.source: Crafted, or found in most Crates
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: They are also sold by the Merchant in Hardmode for 2 SC 50 CC.

buffs.name: Inferno Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff casts a spinning ring of fire around the player that deals 20 damage per second and inflicts the Hellfire debuff for 2 seconds to all enemies inside of it while also giving off light. Critters and other passive NPCs are unaffected.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases magic damage by 20%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the rate at which the player's mana regenerates. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Bounding Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Bounding buff, which increases jump speed by 5% and jump height by 20%.

buffs.name: Slice of Cake
buffs.source: Obtained by being the first player to talk to the Party Girl during a randomly occurring Party
buffs.effect: Player-initiated Parties (caused by a Party Center), or the Party initiated at the creation of Celebration Mk 10 or Zenith worlds will not cause her to give players the Slice of Cake.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

weapons.name: Dank Staff
weapons.why: highest minion damage at this tier
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a miniature Dank Creeper that attempts to latch onto enemies to deal damage and inflicts the Brain Rot debuff upon contact.

weapons.name: Flesh of Infidelity
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a flesh ball that jumps around erratically near the player. When an enemy is nearby, it jumps around near that enemy and fires a burst of 2 blood particles upwards every 3 jumps, which homes in on enemies but does not pierce nor pass through tiles.

weapons.name: Imp Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Summons an Imp minion that fires On Fire! bolts; needs Underworld Hellstone.
weapons.effect: It hovers near enemies, shooting fireballs that inflict the On Fire! debuff for 3–6 seconds and can pierce up to 4 enemies.

weapons.name: Staff of Necrosteocytes
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a small skeleton minion that runs along the ground to target nearby enemies. When it moves, the skeleton will occasionally emit damaging bone cells that linger for a short time.

weapons.name: Houndius Shootius
weapons.why: Pre-Hardmode sentry dropped by Deerclops that shoots piercing fireballs.
weapons.effect: It shoots fireballs towards enemies, which dissipate upon contact with enemies or blocks. The Houndius Shootius has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Deerclops.

weapons.name: Polyp Launcher
weapons.source: Purchased from Sea King for 2 gold
weapons.why: primary sentry recommendation
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a grounded polyp sentry which inaccurately fires gravity-affected balls of coral at nearby enemies. On hit, the coral chunk bursts into 1-4 fragments which deals half as much damage and knockback.

weapons.name: Spinal Tap
weapons.why: Crafted from Bones and offers long range with piercing.
weapons.effect: 7 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Performs better against multiple targets than most whips · 'This goes to eleven'

armor.name: Bee armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Summon damage +10%. No whip bonus, so it suits minion-led builds.
armor.effect: Increases summon damage by 10%
armor.desc: Bee armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Bee Headgear, Bee Breastplate, and Bee Greaves.

armor.name: Obsidian armor
armor.why: Whip range +30%, whip speed +15%, summon damage +15%.
armor.effect: Increases whip range by 30% and speed by 15% · Increases summon damage by 15% · Grants immunity to fire blocks and temporary immunity to lava
armor.desc: Obsidian armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Obsidian Outlaw Hat, Obsidian Longcoat, and Obsidian Pants.
