buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Dungeon
buffs.why: A free extra minion remains part of every serious endgame summoner setup.
buffs.effect: In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Witch Doctor for 10 GC if the Wizard is present. It emits light when placed.

buffs.name: Flask of Fire
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.effect: Causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the On Fire! debuff for 3–6 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Flask of Poison
buffs.source: Brewed at Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.effect: Causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Poisoned debuff for 5–9 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The extra minion slot is too valuable to skip, even in the earliest summoner boss prep.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum number of minions by 1. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: War Table
buffs.source: Dropped by the Dark Mage and Ogre during the Old One's Army
buffs.why: Table buff that boosts minion damage.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Bounding Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Bounding buff, which increases jump speed by 5% and jump height by 20%.

buffs.name: Slice of Cake
buffs.source: Obtained by being the first player to talk to the Party Girl during a randomly occurring Party
buffs.effect: Player-initiated Parties (caused by a Party Center), or the Party initiated at the creation of Celebration Mk 10 or Zenith worlds will not cause her to give players the Slice of Cake.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
items.why: Provides substantial vertical mobility and acceleration. This accessory becomes easier to obtain in Hardmode, as the Blizzard in a Bottle and Sandstorm in a Bottle are now able to be crafted.
items.effect: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage

items.name: Skyline Wings
items.effect: When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide at a low height.

items.name: Counter Scarf
items.source: Purchased from the Clothier for 20 gold
items.effect: It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys, with a base distance of 14 blocks.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

items.name: Terraspark Boots
items.source: Combined through the full boots crafting chain
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava

items.name: Brain of Confusion
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Brain of Cthulhu)
items.effect: Has a chance to create illusions and dodge an attack · Temporarily increase critical chance and minion damage after dodge · May confuse nearby enemies after being struck

items.name: Crown Jewel
items.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s

items.name: Honey Dew
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.source: Purchased from the Shady Salesman for 25 gold during a Full Moon after the item has been found
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Obsidian Shield
items.why: Knockback immunity, fire block immunity and 2 defense.
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Grants immunity to fire blocks

items.name: Radiant Ooze
items.effect: While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

items.name: Bone Glove
items.why: Causes crossbone projectiles to be thrown from the player's weapon at a maximum of once every second.
items.effect: The crossbones projectiles ricochet off walls three times or pierce two enemies before being destroyed, deal 25 classless damage, and additionally have 25 armor penetration. The Bone Glove is always dropped from Skeletron 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

items.name: Jelly-Charged Battery
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 1, and summon damage by 7% · Minion attacks create charged orbs

items.name: Pygmy Necklace
items.why: +1 minion slot.
items.effect: It is purchased from the Witch Doctor for 20 GC at night.

weapons.name: Feather Knife
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: homing thrown knives with strong spam DPS
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a gravity affected knife that periodically releases homing explosive feathers. The feather and explosion deal 5% and 50% of the weapon's damage respectively.

weapons.name: Glaive
weapons.why: returning thrown polearm; stealth strike splits into projectiles
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a glaive that ricochets towards nearby enemies upon contact with tiles or enemies, and pierces three times. Each struck enemy will reduce the damage of the glaive by 10%.

weapons.name: Lionfish
weapons.source: Obtained from Ancient Treasure Chests in the Abyss
weapons.why: inflicts venom on hit; venom-inflicting stealth strike
weapons.effect: When used, it hurls a Lionfish which travels in a straight line for a long distance before being affected by gravity. Lionfish projectiles will explode upon hitting a tile or after being stuck to an enemy for several seconds.

weapons.name: Slick Cane
weapons.why: fast-firing thrown option
weapons.effect: When used, it thrusts out a short-ranged cane in front of the player which ignores enemy immunity frames. Each time it hits an enemy while being swung, that enemy will drop a small amount of coins proportional to the amount the enemy drops upon death.

weapons.name: Shinobi Blade
weapons.why: high single-target stealth-strike damage
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a fast dagger that is unaffected by gravity and does not pierce or pass through tiles. Enemies killed by the dagger spawn homing blue orbs that heal the player for 5 health.

armor.name: Statigel armor
armor.effect: Grants an extra jump and increased jump height · 12% increased jump speed
armor.desc: Statigel armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: +90 maximum stealth

tools.name: Brittle Star Staff
tools.effect: When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

tools.name: Wulfrum Controller
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

ammo.name: Gold Coin
ammo.effect: Coins are the main unit of currency in Terraria, primarily used for transactions with NPCs. The currency comprises four different metals, making four types of coins: Copper Coins, Silver Coins, Gold Coins, and Platinum Coins. Coins can also be used as ammunition for the Coin Gun.

weapons.name: Bananarang
weapons.source: Dropped by Clowns during a Hardmode Blood Moon
weapons.why: Multiple can be thrown at once; dropped by Hardmode Clowns.
weapons.effect: Unlike most boomerangs, it does not have to return to the player before being fired, with a maximum of ten Bananarangs that can be thrown out at one time.

weapons.name: Chain Guillotines
weapons.why: Launched flail dropped by Corrupt Mimics in Hardmode.
weapons.effect: When used, they fire two blades attached to chains in rapid succession, with a maximum range of 32 tiles. They can pierce enemies that are very close by.

weapons.name: Comet Quasher
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: high-damage melee hammer
weapons.effect: On use, it swings in a full circle around the player. Hitting an enemy launches them away from the player and rains a barrage of 4 meteors on them that deals 150% base damage.

weapons.name: Shadowflame Knife
weapons.source: Dropped by Goblin Warlocks during a Hardmode Goblin Army
weapons.why: Throws ricocheting knives that inflict the Shadowflame debuff.
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a small gravity-affected knife projectile that can bounce off enemies up to two times, but dissipates upon contact with blocks. It inflicts the Shadowflame debuff for 1–3 seconds on hit.

weapons.name: Storm Saber
weapons.why: solid melee sword
weapons.effect: It has a chance to be dropped from Cloud Elementals. When swung, it fires a slow and homing glowing sword-like projectile from the blade, and another from the sky towards the cursor.

armor.name: Cobalt armor
armor.desc: Cobalt armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Cobalt Breastplate and Cobalt Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Cobalt Helmet, Cobalt Mask, and Cobalt Hat, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
armor.headpieceBonus: 15% increased melee speed
armor.effect: 10% increased max speed and acceleration · You gain a damage and critical strike chance boost relative to your current movement speed, up to 10%

armor.name: Palladium armor
armor.effect: Greatly increases life regeneration after striking an enemy
armor.desc: Palladium armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Palladium Breastplate and Palladium Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Palladium Mask, Palladium Helmet, and Palladium Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall

buffs.name: Wrath Potion

items.name: Angel Wings
items.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
items.why: Provides substantial vertical mobility and acceleration. This accessory becomes easier to obtain in Hardmode, as the Blizzard in a Bottle and Sandstorm in a Bottle are now able to be crafted.
items.effect: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage

items.name: Demon Wings

items.effect: When equipped, it negates the slow movement speed while submerged in water. It also allows the player to double-tap the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys to perform a short dash with a base distance of 9 blocks, which can be used in rapid succession.

items.name: Fairy Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee

items.name: Terraspark Boots
items.source: Combined through the full boots crafting chain
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.name: Amalgamated Brain
items.effect: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%

items.name: Bloody Worm Scarf
items.effect: When equipped, it provides 2 defense, and increases damage reduction and melee damage by 10%.

items.name: Frost Flare

items.name: Grand Gelatin
items.effect: 12% increased movement speed and jump speed · Using a healing potion creates a cleansing aura which lasts for 30 seconds · Entering the aura removes all debuffs one time and grants +2 HP/s life regen

items.name: Charm of Myths

items.name: Frost Barrier

items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 10% increased damage reduction and 10% reduced dash velocity · Taking a hit restores dash velocity and reduces defense and damage reduction for 3 seconds

items.name: Honey Dew
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Radiant Ooze
items.effect: While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

items.name: Star Veil

items.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage

items.name: Power Glove
items.effect: Increases melee knockback · 12% increased melee speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons · Increases the size of melee weapons

items.why: Increases melee damage by 15%.
items.effect: It has a 1/4 (25%) chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Daedalus Stormbow
weapons.why: Fires arrows that rain down from the sky.
weapons.effect: When used, it causes a wide spread of arrows to rain from the sky, directed towards the cursor. It fires two to four arrows per use, while only consuming a single arrow from the player's inventory.

weapons.name: Dart Pistol
weapons.why: Crimson counterpart of the Dart Rifle.
weapons.effect: It has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Crimson Mimics.

weapons.name: Dart Rifle
weapons.why: Corruption dart weapon; pairs with Crystal or Cursed Darts.
weapons.effect: It has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Corrupt Mimics.

weapons.name: Needler
weapons.why: high fire-rate ranged option
weapons.effect: If Musket Balls are used as ammo, bullets are converted into needles that stick to enemies and tiles which explode after a delay and inflict the Acid Venom debuff.

weapons.name: Polaris Parrotfish
weapons.why: Calamity gun option
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly fires pink and blue lasers that vanish in a star-shaped flash after traveling a fixed distance or upon hitting enemies or tiles. It will also gain firing speed depending on how close the player is to an enemy, with the maximum modifier being 2x its standard firing speed.

weapons.name: Uzi
weapons.source: Dropped by Angry Trappers in the Hardmode Underground Jungle
weapons.why: Rapid-fire gun dropped by Angry Trappers, which spawn in the Hardmode Jungle.
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly fires bullets at a high velocity. It also converts Musket Balls and Tungsten Bullets (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) into High Velocity Bullets, giving them the special effects but not affecting their damage.

armor.effect: 10% increased max speed and acceleration · You gain a damage and critical strike chance boost relative to your current movement speed, up to 10%

ammo.name: Cursed Arrow
ammo.effect: It inflicts the Cursed Inferno debuff for 7 seconds upon contact with enemies.

ammo.name: Ichor Arrow
ammo.effect: It inflicts the Ichor debuff for 10 seconds upon contact with enemies.

ammo.name: Cursed Bullet
ammo.effect: It inflicts the Cursed Inferno debuff for 7 seconds on hit, causing damage over time that cannot be extinguished by water (unlike the On Fire! debuff).

ammo.name: Ichor Bullet
ammo.effect: It inflicts the Ichor debuff on hit for 10 seconds (15 seconds in PvP), decreasing the enemy's defense by 15. Combined with the bullet's base damage, it effectively deals a total of 21 damage.

ammo.name: Cursed Dart
ammo.effect: As it travels, it releases cursed flames that fall and land on blocks, lingering for 2 seconds before dissipating. The Cursed Dart can hit up to 2 targets. [ 1 ] The cursed flames cannot pierce enemies and deal 80% of the Cursed Dart's damage and 50% of its knockback. [ 2 ] The darts and flames both inflict the Cursed Inferno debuff for 3–6 seconds on hit.

ammo.name: Ichor Dart
ammo.effect: It can pierce infinitely when initially fired. After traveling for a random duration between 0.1 seconds to 0.5 seconds, the Ichor Dart splits into 3–5 non-piercing darts (average of 3.75 darts). [ 1 ] Ichor Darts inflict the Ichor debuff for 7–14 seconds.

ammo.name: Endless Musket Pouch
ammo.why: An infinite stack of Musket Balls, so ammo never runs out.
ammo.effect: While in the inventory, it acts as an infinite source of Musket Balls.

ammo.name: Exploding Bullet
ammo.effect: It explodes on impact with enemies or blocks, dealing damage and knockback within an area.

ammo.name: Unholy Arrow
ammo.effect: It can pierce 4 enemies, and its damage decreases by 5% per enemy pierced.

items.name: Fairy Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee

items.name: Terraspark Boots
items.source: Combined through the full boots crafting chain
items.why: Even when wings are online, the best boots still improve the feel and consistency of a finished build.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.name: Amalgamated Brain
items.effect: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%

items.name: Frost Flare
items.effect: All attacks and projectiles inflict Frostbite · Being above 50% life grants 10% increased damage · Being below 50% life grants 10 defense and 15% increased max movement speed and acceleration · Grants resistance against cold attacks, Frostburn , Chilled and Frozen

items.name: Grand Gelatin
items.effect: 12% increased movement speed and jump speed · Using a healing potion creates a cleansing aura which lasts for 30 seconds · Entering the aura removes all debuffs one time and grants +2 HP/s life regen

items.name: Charm of Myths
items.why: Combines the effects of a Philosopher's Stone with a Band of Regeneration:
items.effect: When equipped, it regenerates 1 health every second and decreases the Potion Sickness debuff duration by 25%. This debuff normally imposes a 60-second cooldown after consuming a recovery potion; the Charm of Myths reduces it to 45 seconds.

items.name: Frost Barrier
items.why: This should be used for Cryogen.
items.effect: You will freeze nearby enemies when you are struck · Grants immunity to Chilled and Frostburn

items.name: Giant Tortoise Shell
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 10% increased damage reduction and 10% reduced dash velocity · Taking a hit restores dash velocity and reduces defense and damage reduction for 3 seconds

items.name: Honey Dew
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Radiant Ooze
items.effect: While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Doubles the length of the player's immunity frames (to 4/3 of a second), and summons falling stars when the player is hit.
items.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage

items.name: Magic Quiver
items.why: Grants the following boosts to weapons that fire arrows (or Stakes):
items.effect: Increases arrow damage by 10% and greatly increases arrow speed · 20% chance to not consume arrows

items.name: Putrid Scent
items.why: Increases damage by 5% and critical strike chance by 5%, and decreases the player's aggro by 400.
items.effect: While equipped, it increases the player's damage and critical strike chance by 5% and decreases aggro by 400.

items.name: Ranger Emblem
items.why: Increases ranged damage by 15%.
items.effect: It has a 1/4 (25%) chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

items.name: Angel Wings
items.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Demon Wings
items.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Blood Thorn
weapons.source: Dropped by Hemogoblin Sharks (Blood Moon in Hardmode Crimson)
weapons.why: Fires a thorny projectile that splits into homing spikes.
weapons.effect: It has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Hemogoblin Sharks.

weapons.name: Death Valley Duster
weapons.why: sandnado area damage
weapons.effect: When used, it casts a large blast of damaging dust particles that can travel through tiles and pierce up to five times before dissipating on the sixth. Using it at full mana and with no Mana Sickness gives the player, and any player that touches the dust particles, the Sand's Wind buff for 12 seconds which increases defense by 4, damage by 12%, and mana regeneration.

weapons.name: Meteor Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Calls a meteor down from the sky at the cursor for direct impact damage.
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly summons meteors from the sky which fall in the direction of the cursor and explode upon impact with an enemy or block.

weapons.name: Nimbus Rod
weapons.source: Dropped by Angry Nimbus during rain in Hardmode
weapons.why: Spawns up to two lasting storm clouds that drop damaging rain projectiles below them.
weapons.effect: When cast, a cloud projectile is fired from the Nimbus Rod and travels towards the cursor. Upon reaching its destination or colliding with a solid block, the cloud stops and starts sending damaging raindrop particles downward, each dealing the weapon's stated damage.

weapons.name: Poseidon
weapons.source: Dropped by the Giant Clam mini boss
weapons.why: piercing water sickles off enemies
weapons.effect: It shoots a circular Poseidon typhoon sigil that inflicts the Eutrophication debuff while homing in on enemies, lingering on top of them for a short duration, repeatedly dealing damage until it dissipates. Poseidon typhoons will pierce up to 5 times, dissipating on the sixth hit.

weapons.name: Shadowflame Hex Doll
weapons.source: Dropped by Goblin Warlocks (Hardmode Goblin Army)
weapons.why: Fires homing shadowflame bolts that inflict the Shadowflame debuff.
weapons.effect: While it only fires three tentacles per use, it can be fired continuously to have up to nine projectiles at once. The third tentacle fired in each use is always aimed directly towards the cursor, but the first two keep their random spread.

armor.name: Cobalt armor
armor.desc: Cobalt armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Cobalt Breastplate and Cobalt Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Cobalt Helmet, Cobalt Mask, and Cobalt Hat, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
armor.headpieceBonus: 14% reduced mana costs
armor.effect: 10% increased max speed and acceleration · You gain a damage and critical strike chance boost relative to your current movement speed, up to 10%

armor.name: Palladium armor
armor.effect: Greatly increases life regeneration after striking an enemy
armor.desc: Palladium armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Palladium Breastplate and Palladium Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Palladium Mask, Palladium Helmet, and Palladium Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

armor.name: Crystal Assassin armor
armor.effect: Allows the ability to dash · +10% damage and critical strike chance · +90 maximum stealth
armor.desc: Crystal Assassin armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crystal Assassin Hood, Crystal Assassin Shirt, and Crystal Assassin Pants. Queen Slime always drops one piece / two pieces upon defeat.

buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Super Mana Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: It is the most potent of all mana restoration items.

buffs.name: Candles
buffs.effect: Emit light.

buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.

This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Wizard
buffs.why: Free Clairvoyance remains a baseline endgame mage habit before any serious fight.
buffs.effect: It is purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC. Pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on a placed Crystal Ball grants the Clairvoyance buff and opens its crafting menu.

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases magic damage by 20%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the rate at which the player's mana regenerates. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.

This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.source: Placed station buff
buffs.why: Endgame ranger still wants free ammo efficiency before every serious fight.
buffs.effect: It can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 10 GC in Hardmode.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Ammo consumption adds up quickly on the strongest guns, so this stretches your best supplies further.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff reduces the chance of consuming any ammunition by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Archery Potion

buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.

This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. items.name: Butterfly Wings
items.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Flame Wings
items.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Evasion Scarf
items.effect: It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys, with a base distance of 24 blocks.

items.name: Deep Diver
items.effect: When equipped, it negates the slow movement speed while submerged in water. It also allows the player to double-tap the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys to perform a short dash with a base distance of 9 blocks, which can be used in rapid succession.

items.name: Fairy Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee

items.name: Terraspark Boots
items.source: Combined through the full boots crafting chain
items.why: Even when wings are online, the best boots still improve the feel and consistency of a finished build.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.name: Amalgamated Brain
items.effect: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%

items.name: Frost Flare
items.effect: All attacks and projectiles inflict Frostbite · Being above 50% life grants 10% increased damage · Being below 50% life grants 10 defense and 15% increased max movement speed and acceleration · Grants resistance against cold attacks, Frostburn , Chilled and Frozen

items.name: Moon Stone
items.source: Dropped by Vampire and 1 other source
items.why: In respect to survivability, the Moon Stone increases the player's defense by 4 and health regeneration by 1 HP/s, from 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM.
items.effect: It grants the same stat bonuses as the Sun Stone, but these bonuses will only activate during the night or during a Solar Eclipse.

items.name: Giant Tortoise Shell
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 10% increased damage reduction and 10% reduced dash velocity · Taking a hit restores dash velocity and reduces defense and damage reduction for 3 seconds

items.name: Honey Dew
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Radiant Ooze
items.effect: While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Doubles the length of the player's immunity frames (to 4/3 of a second), and summons falling stars when the player is hit.
items.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage

items.name: Magic Quiver
items.why: Grants the following boosts to weapons that fire arrows (or Stakes):
items.effect: Increases arrow damage by 10% and greatly increases arrow speed · 20% chance to not consume arrows

items.why: Increases ranged damage by 15%.
items.effect: It has a 1/4 (25%) chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

ammo.name: Cursed Arrow
ammo.effect: It inflicts the Cursed Inferno debuff for 7 seconds upon contact with enemies.

ammo.name: Ichor Arrow
ammo.effect: It inflicts the Ichor debuff for 10 seconds upon contact with enemies.

ammo.name: Cursed Dart
ammo.effect: As it travels, it releases cursed flames that fall and land on blocks, lingering for 2 seconds before dissipating. The Cursed Dart can hit up to 2 targets. [ 1 ] The cursed flames cannot pierce enemies and deal 80% of the Cursed Dart's damage and 50% of its knockback. [ 2 ] The darts and flames both inflict the Cursed Inferno debuff for 3–6 seconds on hit.

ammo.name: Ichor Dart
ammo.effect: It can pierce infinitely when initially fired. After traveling for a random duration between 0.1 seconds to 0.5 seconds, the Ichor Dart splits into 3–5 non-piercing darts (average of 3.75 darts). [ 1 ] Ichor Darts inflict the Ichor debuff for 7–14 seconds.

ammo.name: Ichor Bullet
ammo.effect: It inflicts the Ichor debuff on hit for 10 seconds (15 seconds in PvP), decreasing the enemy's defense by 15. Combined with the bullet's base damage, it effectively deals a total of 21 damage.

ammo.name: Cursed Bullet
ammo.effect: It inflicts the Cursed Inferno debuff for 7 seconds on hit, causing damage over time that cannot be extinguished by water (unlike the On Fire! debuff).

ammo.name: Unholy Arrow
ammo.effect: It can pierce 4 enemies, and its damage decreases by 5% per enemy pierced.

weapons.name: Blood Thorn
weapons.source: Dropped by Hemogoblin Sharks (Blood Moon in Hardmode Crimson)
weapons.why: Fires a thorny projectile that splits into homing spikes.
weapons.effect: It has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Hemogoblin Sharks.

weapons.name: Brimrose Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: reliable homing magic damage
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a single short laser beam that instantly splits into two beams, with the resulting beams also splitting into two more beams. There are a total of four splits, resulting in an immediate flower of 16 beam-endings being created a short distance from the player in the direction fired.

weapons.name: Nimbus Rod
weapons.source: Dropped by Angry Nimbus during rain in Hardmode
weapons.why: Spawns up to two lasting storm clouds that drop damaging rain projectiles below them.
weapons.effect: When cast, a cloud projectile is fired from the Nimbus Rod and travels towards the cursor. Upon reaching its destination or colliding with a solid block, the cloud stops and starts sending damaging raindrop particles downward, each dealing the weapon's stated damage.

weapons.name: R-GSS: Vulcan
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: solid sustained magic damage
weapons.effect: When used, it winds up to rapidly fire gauss blasts with a brief downtime in between. Right-clicking fires an extremely fast harpoon that deals 500% base damage on a 3 second cooldown.

weapons.name: Snowstorm Staff
weapons.why: good area coverage
weapons.effect: When used, it spawns a large flying snowflake that is controlled with the cursor, staying close to it in a similar manner to the Flying Knife. The snowflake can pass through tiles and pierce infinity but will disappear after 4.67 seconds.

weapons.name: Unholy Trident
weapons.why: Fires a spectral trident that passes through blocks.
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly fires high-velocity purple tridents that pierce two enemies. A trident's damage is reduced by 10% each time it pierces an enemy.

armor.name: Apprentice armor
armor.source: Purchased from Tavernkeep for a total of 450000* 45 after defeating any mechanical boss
armor.why: class-specific magic set at this tier
armor.effect: Increases your max number of sentries by 1 · Flameburst field of view and range are dramatically increased
armor.desc: Apprentice armor is a Hardmode mage/summoner armor set consisting of the Apprentice's Hat, Apprentice's Robe, and Apprentice's Trousers. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of 450000* 45 after defeating any mechanical boss.

armor.name: Mythril armor
armor.why: class-specific melee armor at this tier
armor.desc: Mythril armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Mythril Chainmail and Mythril Greaves, as well as three different headpieces: the Mythril Helmet, Mythril Hat, and Mythril Hood, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
armor.headpieceBonus: 17% reduced mana costs
armor.effect: Enemy hits release mythril flares, which home in on enemies after a short delay. Mythril flares deal 30% of the damage of the attack that spawned them, softcapped at 40 damage, and have a 12 frame delay before another can be spawned

armor.name: Orichalcum armor
armor.effect: Flower petals will fall on your target for extra damage
armor.desc: Orichalcum armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Orichalcum Breastplate and Orichalcum Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Orichalcum Mask, Orichalcum Helmet, and Orichalcum Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

armor.name: Crystal Assassin armor
armor.effect: Allows the ability to dash · +10% damage and critical strike chance · +90 maximum stealth
armor.desc: Crystal Assassin armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crystal Assassin Hood, Crystal Assassin Shirt, and Crystal Assassin Pants. Queen Slime always drops one piece / two pieces upon defeat.

accessories.effect: Increases maximum mana by 40 and reduces mana cost by 15% · +0.5 HP/s life regen below half health, +1 HP/s when below 25% health and +2 HP/s when below 10% health · +3 HP/s life regen while afflicted with any fire debuff · You will survive fatal damage and revive with 30% life on a 3 minute cooldown · You are encased in an ice barrier for 3 seconds when revived

weapons.why: solid broadsword projectile option
weapons.effect: When swung, it fires a blue or purple blade that starts off slow before accelerating at full speed but will lose velocity as it goes through tiles and fade out before disappearing. The blades pierce twice and function similarly to the Death Sickle 's scythes.

weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: viable melee spear option

weapons.effect: When used, it fires a flak shell that erupts into 4 sludge shrapnel projectiles upon contact with enemies or the cursor. Each shrapnel projectile deals 60% of the weapon's damage, which is reduced to 20% if the flak shell hits an enemy directly.

weapons.name: Hellborn
weapons.why: powerful but difficult to use effectively
weapons.effect: When used, the player twirls the gun in their hand, dealing 8% base damage to enemies. Each hit with the gun itself adds 1 charge to the gun, up to a maximum of 12.

weapons.name: Megashark
weapons.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Post-Destroyer upgrade to the Minishark requiring Souls of Might from a mechanical boss.
weapons.effect: When used, it fires bullets very rapidly in a small spread. It also has a 50% chance not to consume ammunition.

weapons.name: Phantom Phoenix
weapons.source: Dropped by the Ogre (Tier 2 Old One's Army)
weapons.why: Periodically fires an extra spectral phoenix arrow.
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a slight spread of two arrows, alongside a large Phoenix projectile on every third use. The weapon only consumes 1 arrow per use, and its use time is increased by 50% after firing a Phoenix projectile (base use time of 27 (Average)) but returns to normal after firing arrows.

armor.name: Adamantite armor
armor.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.headpieceBonus: +22% ranged damage, +17% ranged critical strike chance, +25% ammo conservation and +5% movement speed.
armor.desc: Adamantite armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Adamantite Breastplate and Adamantite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Adamantite Helmet, Adamantite Mask, and Adamantite Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.
armor.effect: 25% of your current damage reduction is added to your critical strike chance · Continuously doing damage makes you gradually gain more and more defense, up to a maximum of 10 · When not doing damage, this bonus gradually decays over 3.5 seconds · This added defense can be broken by defense damage

armor.name: Orichalcum armor
armor.effect: Flower petals will fall on your target for extra damage
armor.desc: Orichalcum armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Orichalcum Breastplate and Orichalcum Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Orichalcum Mask, Orichalcum Helmet, and Orichalcum Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

accessories.name: Angel Treads
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'

accessories.name: Flame Wings
accessories.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil

accessories.name: Molten Quiver
accessories.effect: Increases arrow damage by 10% and greatly increases arrow speed · 20% chance not to consume arrows · Lights wooden arrows ablaze · 'Quiver in fear!'

accessories.name: Ranger Emblem
accessories.effect: It has a 1/4 (25%) chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback and fire blocks · Grants immunity to most debuffs

accessories.name: Charm of Myths
accessories.why: Combines the effects of a Philosopher's Stone with a Band of Regeneration:
accessories.effect: When equipped, it regenerates 1 health every second and decreases the Potion Sickness debuff duration by 25%. This debuff normally imposes a 60-second cooldown after consuming a recovery potion; the Charm of Myths reduces it to 45 seconds.

buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.effect: Emit light.

buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.source: Placed station buff
buffs.why: Endgame ranger still wants free ammo efficiency before every serious fight.
buffs.effect: It can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 10 GC in Hardmode.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Ammo consumption adds up quickly on the strongest guns, so this stretches your best supplies further.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff reduces the chance of consuming any ammunition by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage of arrow -firing weapons by 10%, as well as the velocity of arrows by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

ammo.name: Cinder Arrow
ammo.effect: They create a small explosion on hit, dealing 40% damage to all nearby enemies. They also additionally burst into three gravity-affected flaming pieces of shrapnel which do not pierce, deal 6% damage, and inflict Brimstone Flames.

ammo.name: Holy Arrow
ammo.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
ammo.why: Calls down falling stars on impact.
ammo.effect: Upon contact with enemies or blocks, two Hallow Star projectiles will fall from the sky to the impact location. The stars deal 1/3 (33.33%) of the combined damage of the arrow and weapon, and do not pierce.

ammo.name: Ichor Bullet
ammo.effect: It inflicts the Ichor debuff on hit for 10 seconds (15 seconds in PvP), decreasing the enemy's defense by 15. Combined with the bullet's base damage, it effectively deals a total of 21 damage.

ammo.name: Cursed Bullet
ammo.effect: It inflicts the Cursed Inferno debuff for 7 seconds on hit, causing damage over time that cannot be extinguished by water (unlike the On Fire! debuff).

ammo.name: Rocket I
ammo.source: Dropped by Plantera when it drops the Grenade Launcher
ammo.effect: The Rocket I variant is also dropped by Plantera when it drops the Grenade Launcher. Most launchers use Rockets as ammunition.

ammo.name: Unholy Arrow
ammo.effect: It can pierce 4 enemies, and its damage decreases by 5% per enemy pierced.

items.name: Frost Flare

items.source: Dropped by Vampire and 1 other source

items.name: Honey Dew

items.name: Radiant Ooze

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Brimrose Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: piercing crystal shards for crowds
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a single short laser beam that instantly splits into two beams, with the resulting beams also splitting into two more beams. There are a total of four splits, resulting in an immediate flower of 16 beam-endings being created a short distance from the player in the direction fired.

weapons.name: Frigidflash Bolt
weapons.why: bouncing bolt option
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a slow-moving ball of flash-freezing magma that travels in a straight line, is unaffected by gravity, inflicts the Frostburn and Hellfire debuffs on hit, and can pierce and bounce off blocks four times before dissipating.

weapons.name: Ion Blaster
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: homing energy bolts, strong versatility
weapons.effect: When used, it fires continuously accelerating ion blasts that increase in damage with the player's current mana. The projectile damage is multiplied by 0.2 added to 1.4 times of the player's mana ratio, dealing 20% damage at 0 mana and 160% damage at full mana.

weapons.name: Nimbus Rod
weapons.source: Dropped by Angry Nimbus during rain in Hardmode
weapons.why: Spawns up to two lasting storm clouds that drop damaging rain projectiles below them.
weapons.effect: When cast, a cloud projectile is fired from the Nimbus Rod and travels towards the cursor. Upon reaching its destination or colliding with a solid block, the cloud stops and starts sending damaging raindrop particles downward, each dealing the weapon's stated damage.

weapons.name: R-GSS: Vulcan
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: high sustained magic DPS at this tier
weapons.effect: When used, it winds up to rapidly fire gauss blasts with a brief downtime in between. Right-clicking fires an extremely fast harpoon that deals 500% base damage on a 3 second cooldown.

weapons.name: Unholy Trident
weapons.why: Fires a spectral trident that passes through blocks.
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly fires high-velocity purple tridents that pierce two enemies. A trident's damage is reduced by 10% each time it pierces an enemy.

items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).

weapons.effect: When used, a gravity affected flask is thrown that breaks upon contact with enemies and blocks. Upon breaking, the flask releases five bubbles that travel in multiple directions away from where the flask broke.

weapons.name: Palladium Javelin
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: spam option; stealth option
weapons.effect: It throws a javelin that pierces twice, travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Biome Blade
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: versatile melee weapon with multiple usable attunements
weapons.effect: By default, it does not fire any projectile nor does it have any special effects. However, if the player stands still on flat ground while holding ⚷ Open / Activate (default: Right Click) for 2 seconds, they will strike the sword into the ground, attuning it to the surrounding biome, which will let them perform unique attacks.

weapons.name: Chlorophyte Partisan
weapons.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Chlorophyte spear that releases homing leaf crystals.
weapons.effect: When thrust, it fires a Spore Cloud projectile that deals the weapon's damage and knockback, lasts for a short time, can pass through blocks, and pierces an infinite number of enemies.

weapons.name: Darklight Greatsword
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: broadsword firing light projectiles
weapons.effect: When swung, it fires a blue or purple blade that starts off slow before accelerating at full speed but will lose velocity as it goes through tiles and fade out before disappearing. The blades pierce twice and function similarly to the Death Sickle 's scythes.

weapons.name: Pwnagehammer
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: returning hammer with strong area damage
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a slow gravity-affected hammer which cannot pass through tiles and will travel a short distance before falling. Upon hitting an enemy, it releases a small explosion, dealing 50% of the weapon's damage to all enemies within its radius.

weapons.name: True Excalibur
weapons.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Fires a projectile on swing; needs post-Plantera Broken Hero Sword.
weapons.effect: When swung, a large yellow aura with a pink edge follows the swing, reaching about twice the distance of the sword itself. The aura can hit up to six enemies.

armor.name: Chlorophyte armor
armor.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.why: Spawns a leaf crystal that shoots at nearby enemies on its own.
armor.headpieceBonus: +21% melee damage, +21% melee critical strike chance and +5% damage reduction.
armor.effect: Summons a powerful leaf crystal to shoot at nearby enemies
armor.desc: Chlorophyte armor is a Hardmode, post- mechanical bosses armor set consisting of the Chlorophyte Plate Mail and Chlorophyte Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Chlorophyte Mask, Chlorophyte Helmet, Chlorophyte Headgear, and Chlorophyte Visor, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, magic and summon damage type respectively.

armor.effect: Become immune after striking an enemy

items.effect: It grants the same stat bonuses as the Sun Stone, but these bonuses will only activate during the night or during a Solar Eclipse.

items.name: Giant Tortoise Shell
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 10% increased damage reduction and 10% reduced dash velocity · Taking a hit restores dash velocity and reduces defense and damage reduction for 3 seconds

items.name: Honey Dew
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Radiant Ooze
items.effect: While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Doubles the length of the player's immunity frames (to 4/3 of a second), and summons falling stars when the player is hit.
items.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage

items.name: Abaddon
items.effect: When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Bane deals a base of 20 damage per second, and its damage is increased by 3% for each point of critical strike chance the player has.

items.name: Mechanical Glove
items.why: Effectively combines the effects of an Avenger Emblem with a Power Glove by providing a +12% damage buff, but only to melee weapons (instead of universally, as the Avenger Emblem does).
items.effect: Increases melee knockback · 12% increased melee damage and speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons · Increases the size of melee weapons

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Animosity
weapons.why: reliable rapid-fire gun
weapons.effect: When used with its primary fire (left-click), it fires a narrow spread of 6 bullets that inflicts the Brimstone Flames debuff regardless of what ammo type was used. When used with its secondary fire (right-click), it fires a brimstone round with 900% damage, 200% velocity, and 1.35x the critical strike chance, at the cost of halving the rate of fire.

weapons.name: Chlorophyte Shotbow
weapons.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Can fire up to four arrows at once when held.
weapons.effect: When used, it fires 2–3 arrows per shot, consuming one piece of ammunition.

weapons.name: Hellborn
weapons.why: powerful but difficult to use effectively
weapons.effect: When used, the player twirls the gun in their hand, dealing 8% base damage to enemies. Each hit with the gun itself adds 1 charge to the gun, up to a maximum of 12.

weapons.name: Pulse Bow
weapons.source: Purchased from the Traveling Merchant after defeating all three mechanical bosses
weapons.why: Fires a piercing pulse arrow that bounces off blocks.
weapons.effect: When used, it converts any type of arrow into a high-velocity Pulse Bolt. The Pulse Bolt is unaffected by gravity, can either pierce enemies or bounce off blocks up to five times, and travels for 3.33 seconds before dissipating.

armor.name: Chlorophyte armor
armor.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.why: Spawns a leaf crystal that shoots at nearby enemies on its own.
armor.effect: Summons a powerful leaf crystal to shoot at nearby enemies
armor.desc: Chlorophyte armor is a Hardmode, post- mechanical bosses armor set consisting of the Chlorophyte Plate Mail and Chlorophyte Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Chlorophyte Mask, Chlorophyte Helmet, Chlorophyte Headgear, and Chlorophyte Visor, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, magic and summon damage type respectively.
armor.headpieceBonus: +21% ranged damage, +15% critical strike chance and +20% ammo conservation.

armor.name: Hallowed armor
armor.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.why: Brief immunity after striking an enemy.
armor.effect: Become immune after striking an enemy
armor.desc: Hallowed armor is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss armor set consisting of the Hallowed Plate Mail and Hallowed Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Hallowed Mask, Hallowed Helmet, Hallowed Headgear, and Hallowed Hood, providing bonuses for melee, ranged, magic, and summon damage type respectively.
armor.headpieceBonus: +22% ranged damage and +15% ranged critical strike chance.

accessories.name: Angel Treads
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'

accessories.name: Flame Wings
accessories.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
accessories.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.effect: Allows the ability to dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

accessories.name: Stalker's Quiver
accessories.effect: Increases arrow damage by 10% and greatly increases arrow speed · 20% chance not to consume arrows · Enemies are less likely to target you

accessories.name: Grand Gelatin
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: 12% increased movement speed and jump speed · Using a healing potion creates a cleansing aura which lasts for 30 seconds · Entering the aura removes all debuffs one time and grants +2 HP/s life regen

accessories.name: Molten Quiver
accessories.effect: Increases arrow damage by 10% and greatly increases arrow speed · 20% chance not to consume arrows · Lights wooden arrows ablaze · 'Quiver in fear!'

accessories.name: Ranger Emblem
accessories.effect: It has a 1/4 (25%) chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback and fire blocks · Grants immunity to most debuffs

accessories.name: Charm of Myths
accessories.why: Combines the effects of a Philosopher's Stone with a Band of Regeneration:
accessories.effect: When equipped, it regenerates 1 health every second and decreases the Potion Sickness debuff duration by 25%. This debuff normally imposes a 60-second cooldown after consuming a recovery potion; the Charm of Myths reduces it to 45 seconds.

buffs.name: Archery Potion

buffs.name: Soaring Potion

buffs.station: Alchemy Table

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

ammo.effect: When hitting enemies, it marks them, causing the enemy to emit star particles for 1.5 seconds before exploding, dealing additional flat damage. The explosion damage can be increased if additional Verium Bolts hit the target within the 1.5 second window.

weapons.why: solid alternative magic weapon
weapons.effect: Consumes Souls as ammo · Ejects orbs of unstable, concentrated soulpower that linger and explode · Orbs emit seeking souls and lingering pickup souls after collapse · Orbs have varying effects depending on Soul type used · [SOUL DESCRIPTION] · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to use the machine as a vacuum, pulling in lingering souls · Once released, a torrent of soul lasers is discharged scaling with the number of souls pulled in · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to eject the currently loaded Soul · Tales of legends past radiate around you... · Hold Shift to listen closer 'Though soul-powered machines were a near failure, potential remained in souls as a form of fuel. · To avoid my last experiments' main flaw, the Soul-Harnessing Plasma Cannon was designed to expel souls as projectiles before they exert control over the weapon. · Each soul type appears to react differently to the base plasma. Yet, lacking volunteers, obtaining potential ammunition is currently too difficult to undergo further testing. · A shame, for a weapon that could have practically unlimited ammunition in the battlefield. Perhaps some day, its potential can be truly tested.'

items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).

items.name: Fairy Boots

ammo.name: Soul of Sight
ammo.effect: The Soul of Sight is one of the six souls that can be obtained in Hardmode. It is a crafting material dropped by The Twins.

weapons.name: Daedalus Golem Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: primary minion recommendation
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a Daedalus Golem that follows the player.

weapons.name: Dormant Brimseeker
weapons.why: strong empowered-state minion alternative
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a Brimseeker that charges towards enemies in a straight line to deal damage and it is able to target and attack enemies through tiles.

weapons.name: Vengeful Sun Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: high-damage minion option
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a Vengeful Solar Spirit above the player's head that fires yellow non-piercing beams at nearby enemies. Unlike most minions, only one Vengeful Solar Spirit can be summoned at a time.

weapons.name: Cryogenic Staff
weapons.source: Purchased from Archmage for 35 after defeating all the Mechanical Bosses
weapons.why: primary sentry recommendation
weapons.effect: When summoned, the ice sentry fires an ice ball that inflicts the Frostbite debuff, as well as their rate increasing the longer an enemy is targeted. After targeting an enemy for three seconds, the sentry goes into a frenzied state, spinning around rapidly and firing ice balls with significantly increased fire rate as well as icicles in all directions.

weapons.name: Orthocera Shell
weapons.why: alternative sentry option
weapons.effect: It summons a stationary flying Orthocera sentry that shoots streams of acid at nearby enemies. The acid streams pierce up to two enemies along with inflicting the Acid Venom and Irradiated debuffs.

weapons.name: Durendal
weapons.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Hallowed Bar whip with fast use time that boosts minion attack speed.
weapons.effect: 9 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies to gain whip attack speed

armor.effect: Become immune after striking an enemy

weapons.why: strong spam-oriented rogue option; viable stealth option

weapons.why: solid stealth alternative

weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: solid stealth alternative
weapons.effect: It throws a javelin that pierces twice, travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity.
