armor.desc: Umbraphile armor is a Hardmode rogue armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a motion blur afterimage while they are moving.

accessories.name: Angel Treads

weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: primary true-melee sword recommendation

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Doubles the length of the player's immunity frames (to 4/3 of a second), and summons falling stars when the player is hit.
items.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage

items.name: Mechanical Glove
items.why: Effectively combines the effects of an Avenger Emblem with a Power Glove by providing a +12% damage buff, but only to melee weapons (instead of universally, as the Avenger Emblem does).
items.effect: Increases melee knockback · 12% increased melee damage and speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons · Increases the size of melee weapons

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Bladedge Railbow
weapons.effect: It fires out 4 arrows at once, quickly followed by a pair of leaves. The leaves inflict no knockback and deal 70% of the weapon's base damage.

weapons.name: Blossom Flux
weapons.effect: It has two modes of attack: its primary fire (left-click) will shoot leaf arrows at a very high rate, and its secondary fire (right-click) launches a spore orb that travels in a wave pattern and explodes into spore clouds upon impact.

weapons.name: Hydra
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a spread of 3 toxic bullets which inflicts the Acid Venom debuff upon contact. While the weapon is in use, it will summon a gun-head every 3 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 gun-heads can exist at a time.

weapons.name: Megalodon
weapons.effect: When used, it loads a magazine of 30 shots, then alternates between firing bullets and pressurized water jets that pierce once and inflict the Riptide debuff. After exhausting the entire magazine, the gun fires a homing rocket that inflicts Crush Depth before having to reload again, repeating the process.

weapons.name: Wildfire Bloom
weapons.effect: It uses Gel for ammunition, with a 50% chance to not consume ammo. When used, it fires a long burst of green flames at a moderate range.

armor.name: Hallowed armor
armor.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.why: Brief immunity after striking an enemy.
armor.effect: Become immune after striking an enemy
armor.desc: Hallowed armor is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss armor set consisting of the Hallowed Plate Mail and Hallowed Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Hallowed Mask, Hallowed Helmet, Hallowed Headgear, and Hallowed Hood, providing bonuses for melee, ranged, magic, and summon damage type respectively.
armor.headpieceBonus: +22% ranged damage and +15% ranged critical strike chance.

armor.name: Shroomite armor
armor.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.why: Standing still puts you in stealth, raising ranged damage and making enemies less likely to target you.
armor.effect: Not moving puts you in stealth, · increasing ranged ability and reducing chance for enemies to target you
armor.desc: Shroomite armor is a Hardmode, post- Plantera ranged armor set consisting of the Shroomite Breastplate and Shroomite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Shroomite Headgear, Shroomite Mask, and Shroomite Helmet, providing bonuses for ranged weapons using a specific type of ammunition.
armor.headpieceBonus: Headgear: Increases bow damage by 12%; 5% increased ranged critical strike chance · Mask: Increases gun damage by 12%; 5% increased ranged critical strike chance · Helmet: Increases specialist ranged damage by 12%; These are launchers, dartguns, or anything else that doesn't shoot arrows/bullets; 5% increased ranged critical strike chance

armor.name: Reaver armor
armor.desc: Reaver armor is a Hardmode armor set.

buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.effect: It can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 10 GC in Hardmode.

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

ammo.name: Venom Bullet

weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: used with Souls of Sight ammo
weapons.effect: Consumes Souls as ammo · Ejects orbs of unstable, concentrated soulpower that linger and explode · Orbs emit seeking souls and lingering pickup souls after collapse · Orbs have varying effects depending on Soul type used · [SOUL DESCRIPTION] · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to use the machine as a vacuum, pulling in lingering souls · Once released, a torrent of soul lasers is discharged scaling with the number of souls pulled in · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to eject the currently loaded Soul · Tales of legends past radiate around you... · Hold Shift to listen closer 'Though soul-powered machines were a near failure, potential remained in souls as a form of fuel. · To avoid my last experiments' main flaw, the Soul-Harnessing Plasma Cannon was designed to expel souls as projectiles before they exert control over the weapon. · Each soul type appears to react differently to the base plasma. Yet, lacking volunteers, obtaining potential ammunition is currently too difficult to undergo further testing. · A shame, for a weapon that could have practically unlimited ammunition in the battlefield. Perhaps some day, its potential can be truly tested.'

items.effect: It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

items.name: Amalgamated Brain
items.effect: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%

items.name: Hallowed Rune
items.effect: Minion attacks provide various buffs · Does not stack with downgrades · Hold Shift for more Hallowed Power grants 10% increased summon damage and rains stars on enemies · Hallowed Defense grants 5 defense · Hallowed Regen grants +1 HP/s life regen

items.name: Moon Stone
items.source: Dropped by Vampire and 1 other source
items.why: In respect to survivability, the Moon Stone increases the player's defense by 4 and health regeneration by 1 HP/s, from 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM.
items.effect: It grants the same stat bonuses as the Sun Stone, but these bonuses will only activate during the night or during a Solar Eclipse.

items.name: Bloom Stone
items.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'

items.name: Frozen Shield
items.why: Essentially an upgraded version of the Frozen Turtle Shell which provides 6 defense, reduces all damage taken by the player by 25% if the player is below 50% max HP, and grants immunity to knockback.
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25% · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life

items.name: Hero Shield
items.why: Provides 10 defense, increases the player's aggro by 400, and provides immunity to knockback.
items.effect: Furthermore, it increases defense by 10, increases aggro by 400, and grants immunity to knockback.

items.name: Living Dew
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x and makes it generate 100% faster while equipped.

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Doubles the length of the player's immunity frames (to 4/3 of a second), and summons falling stars when the player is hit.
items.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage

items.name: Jelly-Charged Battery
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 1, and summon damage by 7% · Minion attacks create charged orbs

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

items.name: Starbuster Core
items.source: Dropped by Stellar Culex after Astrum Aureus has been defeated
items.effect: While equipped, it grants 1 minion slot and causes all minion attacks to spawn a small astral explosion on enemy hits, dealing 40 summon damage and inflicting the Astral Infection debuff for 3 seconds. The effect has a 1 second cooldown.

items.name: The First Shadowflame
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Minion attacks inflict Shadowflame , and grants immunity to Shadowflame

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Defective Sphere
weapons.why: primary spam rogue weapon at this tier
weapons.effect: They can be thrown up to five times. Spheres thrown can become one of four variants, listed below.

weapons.name: Fantasy Talisman
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: strong spam alternative
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a talisman card that sticks onto enemies, periodically releasing homing souls that deal 50% of the weapon's base damage. Up to 3 talismans can stick to an enemy at a time.

weapons.name: Leviathan Teeth
weapons.why: additional spam option; solid stealth alternative
weapons.effect: When used, they rapidly throw an inaccurate tight spread of 2 gravity-affected teeth that inflict the Heavy Bleeding debuff on contact with enemies and stick to them. After sticking for 2 seconds, teeth will launch out the other side of the enemy, dealing an additional burst of damage.

weapons.name: Phantasmal Ruin
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: additional spam option; additional stealth option
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a fast ghost lance that goes through tiles and explodes into 4 homing spirits on enemy hits while disappearing on direct hit.

weapons.name: Samsara Slicer
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: additional spam option; additional stealth option
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a disk that quickly returns to the player after hitting an enemy or after traveling for a short distance. The disk can pass through blocks and pierce infinitely, and has a chance to fire 6 smaller disks outwards from it when an enemy is nearby, which linger for a short time before dissipating.

weapons.name: Stellar Knife
weapons.source: Dropped by Aries after Astrum Aureus is defeated
weapons.why: additional spam option; additional stealth option
weapons.effect: When thrown, it moves and rapidly spins in the direction it was initially thrown, slowly decelerating and losing spin speed over time. Once the knife fully decelerates, it then remains still until an enemy is within its detection range for it to home in.

weapons.name: Duststorm in a Bottle
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: primary stealth-strike weapon
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a bottle that shatters into a dust cloud after a delay, or when hitting an enemy. Holding down left-click charges the weapon, generating stealth but causing it to shatter sooner.

armor.name: Umbraphile armor
armor.effect: +110 maximum stealth · Rogue weapons have a chance to create explosions on hit · Stealth strikes always create an explosion
armor.desc: Umbraphile armor is a Hardmode rogue armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a motion blur afterimage while they are moving.

armor.name: Reaver armor
armor.desc: Reaver armor is a Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you; Reduces the life regen lost from damage over time debuffs by 20%; 30% decreased movement speed and flight time; Grants Reaver Rage for 5 seconds after taking damage · Visage: Grants immunity to fall damage and allows constant jumping; 10% increased flight time and horizontal wing speed; Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 50% faster; Reduces the cooldown of dashes by 33% · Headgear: Emits light and shows the location of treasure and ore; Enemies are less likely to target you and grants underwater breathing; Greatly enhances visibility in the abyss; Increased block placement & tool range by 7; Increases pickup range for items

accessories.name: Angel Treads
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'

accessories.name: Tattered Fairy Wings
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall

accessories.name: Festive Wings
accessories.source: Dropped by the Everscream during the Frost Moon
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall

accessories.name: Asgard's Valor
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

accessories.name: Ruin Medallion
accessories.effect: Stealth strikes only expend 75% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance

accessories.name: Vampiric Talisman
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: When equipped, it causes rogue critical hits to steal 1.5% of their damage (rounded down) in health. Additionally, it increases stealth strike damage by 8% and causes all stealth strikes to inflict Armor Crunch for 2.5 seconds and Heavy Bleeding for 5 seconds.

accessories.name: Abyssal Mirror
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss · Generate stealth 25% faster when standing still and 12% faster while moving · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a cloud that damages and stuns nearby enemies · 'Light does not reach the depths of the ocean'

accessories.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

accessories.name: Glove of Precision
accessories.source: Purchased from Bandit for 48 after Plantera has been defeated
accessories.effect: Decreases rogue attack speed by 15% · Increases rogue damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and velocity by 15%

accessories.name: Glove of Recklessness
accessories.source: Purchased from the Bandit for 48 gold after Plantera has been defeated
accessories.effect: Increases rogue attack speed by 15%, but decreases damage by 10% and crit by 5% · 15% increased stealth regeneration · Makes rogue weapons slightly inaccurate

buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.station: Alchemy Table

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion

buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Brimstone buff, which causes melee, whip, and rogue weapons to inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff.

buffs.name: Flask of Venom
buffs.source: Brewed at Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.effect: Causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Acid Venom debuff on hit for 5–9 seconds, which deals 30 damage per second to enemies and prevents health regeneration. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Shadow Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Shadow buff, which provides the following effects:

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Hadal Mantle
items.effect: While equipped, it allows the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Spectre Wings
items.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Angel Treads
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'

items.name: Fairy Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee

items.name: Asgard's Valor
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

items.name: Master Ninja Gear
items.why: Dash, wall climbing, and a 10% chance to dodge an attack.
items.effect: It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

items.name: Shield of the High Ruler
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'

items.name: Interstellar Stompers
items.effect: 6% increased movement speed, 20% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Hold ▼ Down to increase your maximum fall speed · Pressing Interstellar Stompers Hotkey while midair charges up a superspeed slam over 0.33 seconds · While falling, you ram through enemies and don't take contact damage · Once you hit the ground, you create an explosion at your feet · The explosion scales in both damage and size the longer you slam for · Temporary 40% increased jump speed after slamming into the ground

items.name: Leviathan Ambergris
items.source: Dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita
items.effect: 100% increased initial dash velocity, 33% faster dash cooldown, and greatly increased dash deceleration · Your dashes are empowered by water, knocking back and damaging enemies with vicious currents · Visual effects are reduced if visibility is disabled

items.name: Bloody Worm Scarf
items.effect: When equipped, it provides 2 defense, and increases damage reduction and melee damage by 10%.

items.name: Celestial Shell
items.why: All-round stats, plus werewolf at night and merfolk in water.
items.effect: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night · Turns the holder into a merfolk when entering water · Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback

items.name: Bloom Stone
items.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'

items.name: Frozen Shield
items.why: Essentially an upgraded version of the Frozen Turtle Shell which provides 6 defense, reduces all damage taken by the player by 25% if the player is below 50% max HP, and grants immunity to knockback.
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25% · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life

items.name: Living Dew
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x and makes it generate 100% faster while equipped.

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Doubles the length of the player's immunity frames (to 4/3 of a second), and summons falling stars when the player is hit.
items.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage

items.name: Apollyon
items.effect: When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Additionally, critical strikes spread all debuffs inflicted on the hit enemy that are weaker than Bane to up to 10 enemies within an 87.5-tile range, and critical strikes deal 3% increased damage for every debuff inflicted on the enemy.

items.name: Eye of the Golem
items.source: Dropped by Golem and 1 other source
items.effect: It has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Golem.

items.name: Fire Gauntlet
items.why: Melee damage, speed and knockback, and sets enemies on fire. Upgrades from Mechanical Glove.
items.effect: Increases melee knockback and melee attacks inflict fire damage · 12% increased melee damage and speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons · Increases the size of melee weapons

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Electrosphere Launcher
weapons.source: Dropped by the Martian Saucer during Martian Madness (post-Golem)
weapons.why: Fires rockets that leave a lingering electrified damage field.
weapons.effect: When used, it consumes rockets and fires blue missiles that form an Electrosphere upon impact with blocks, enemies, or reaching the cursor's position when fired. Electrospheres deal damage repeatedly and last for 5 seconds, but do not inflict any knockback.

weapons.name: Nullification Pistol
weapons.source: Dropped by the Martian Walker during the Martian Madness event
weapons.why: strong alternative primary weapon
weapons.effect: It does not use any ammo.

weapons.name: Snowman Cannon
weapons.source: Dropped by the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires homing rockets that track the nearest enemy.
weapons.effect: When used, it consumes rockets and fires homing snowman-shaped rockets that explode on impact with enemies. The Snowman Cannon is dropped from the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon event with a 5.19%–10.37% (15.56%–31.11%) chance depending on the current wave. [ 1 ]

weapons.name: Stynger
weapons.why: Fires Stynger Bolts that burst into shrapnel on impact.
weapons.effect: When used, it fires high-velocity Stynger Bolts that explode upon contact with enemies or blocks. The explosion additionally releases 2–5 shrapnel fragments that spread out in random directions and can also explode, each dealing the weapon's full damage and knockback.

weapons.name: Xenopopper
weapons.source: Dropped by the Martian Saucer (Martian Madness)
weapons.why: Fires a spread of bullets and drops from the Martian Saucer during post-Golem Martian Madness.
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a burst of 4–5 purple bubbles, consuming one bullet. The bubbles deal no damage and will bounce off solid blocks, but pop after a 0.5-second delay, each firing a bullet directly towards the cursor.

armor.name: Hydrothermic armor
armor.why: melee set with brimstone offensive bonuses
armor.effect: Inferno effect when below 50% life · You emit a blazing explosion when you are hit
armor.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: You fire a homing chaos flare when using ranged weapons every 0.33 seconds

armor.name: Plague Reaper armor

armor.desc: Plague Reaper armor is a Hardmode ranger armor set. If the entire set is visible (regardless of whether it is equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura.

armor.name: Shroomite armor
armor.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.why: Standing still puts you in stealth, raising ranged damage and making enemies less likely to target you.
armor.effect: Not moving puts you in stealth, · increasing ranged ability and reducing chance for enemies to target you
armor.desc: Shroomite armor is a Hardmode, post- Plantera ranged armor set consisting of the Shroomite Breastplate and Shroomite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Shroomite Headgear, Shroomite Mask, and Shroomite Helmet, providing bonuses for ranged weapons using a specific type of ammunition.
armor.headpieceBonus: Headgear: Increases bow damage by 12%; 5% increased ranged critical strike chance · Mask: Increases gun damage by 12%; 5% increased ranged critical strike chance · Helmet: Increases specialist ranged damage by 12%; These are launchers, dartguns, or anything else that doesn't shoot arrows/bullets; 5% increased ranged critical strike chance

armor.name: Reaver armor

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

items.name: Sniper Scope
items.why: 10% ranged damage and crit, and zooms out when you right-click with a gun.
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance

items.name: Celestial Shell
items.why: All-round stats, plus werewolf at night and merfolk in water.
items.effect: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night · Turns the holder into a merfolk when entering water · Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback

items.name: Spectre Wings
items.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Master Ninja Gear
items.why: Dash, wall climbing, and a 10% chance to dodge an attack.
items.effect: It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

ammo.name: Bubonic Round
ammo.effect: They burst into a virulent plague upon contact which inflicts the Plague debuff and they ignore 10% of the enemy's defense.

ammo.name: Chlorophyte Bullet
ammo.effect: It strongly homes in on the nearest enemy.

ammo.name: Cluster Rocket I
ammo.effect: Unlike the Cluster Rocket II, it does not destroy tiles. Upon exploding, cluster rockets shoot out 6 shrapnels that create secondary explosions upon hitting enemies or after a short time, each of which deals 50% of the rocket's damage. [ 1 ]

ammo.name: Hailstorm Bullet
ammo.effect: The bullets pierce once and drastically slow down when fired, quickly becoming stationary before vanishing. On hit, the bullets inflict the Frostbite debuff, while critical hits additionally inflict the Frozen debuff on non-boss enemies and cause a flash freeze that deals 50% of the bullet's damage.

ammo.name: Rocket III
ammo.source: Dropped by Plantera when it drops the Grenade Launcher
ammo.effect: The Rocket I variant is also dropped by Plantera when it drops the Grenade Launcher. Most launchers use Rockets as ammunition.

weapons.name: Alula Australis
weapons.why: strong homing star magic weapon, listed first
weapons.effect: When used, it fires an aurora beam which travels in a cosine pattern. As the beam travels, homing astral stars trail with the beam and rain down from the sky.

weapons.name: Bat Scepter
weapons.why: Fires a spread of homing bats at nearby enemies.
weapons.effect: Summons bats to attack your enemies

weapons.name: Charged Blaster Cannon
weapons.why: Charges up to fire a large piercing laser beam.
weapons.effect: It possesses multiple firing modes with escalating speed, damage, and method of attack depending on how long the ⚒ Use / Attack key is held while firing it. [ 1 ]

weapons.name: Rainbow Gun
weapons.source: Found in Hallowed Chest in the Dungeon (opened with a Hallowed Key)
weapons.why: Launches a lasting rainbow that damages enemies along its arc.
weapons.effect: Enemies touching the rainbow take damage repeatedly, approximately five times per second. The Rainbow Gun is always found in the Dungeon 's Hallowed Chest, which can only be unlocked with a Hallowed Key after Plantera has been defeated.

weapons.name: Razorpine
weapons.why: Rapidly fires piercing pine-needle projectiles.
weapons.effect: The needles become affected by gravity after traveling a medium distance.

weapons.name: Wingman
weapons.source: Dropped by Martian Engineers during the Martian Madness event
weapons.why: homing shots plus healing capability
weapons.effect: When used with its primary fire (left-click), it summons two Wingmen to the sides of the player perpendicular to the direction of the cursor, that each switch sides and fire lasers towards the cursor that travel through tiles and pierce once. The Wingmen gradually increase in firing rate and laser velocity the longer it is held for, reaching a full speed of 6 lasers per second after 6 shots.

armor.name: Brimflame armor
armor.effect: 8% increased damage and magic critical strike chance · Brimflame Frenzy - Armor Set Bonus for 10 seconds of 40% increased magic damage · However, this inflicts rapid life loss and disables mana regeneration and mana potions · This effect can be toggled off and has a cooldown of 30 seconds
armor.desc: Brimflame armor is a Hardmode mage armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a tiny pulsating aura around them.

armor.name: Hydrothermic armor
armor.why: melee set with brimstone offensive bonuses
armor.effect: Inferno effect when below 50% life · You emit a blazing explosion when you are hit
armor.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: Magic attacks summon damaging and healing flare orbs on hit

armor.name: Reaver armor
armor.desc: Reaver armor is a Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you; Reduces the life regen lost from damage over time debuffs by 20%; 30% decreased movement speed and flight time; Grants Reaver Rage for 5 seconds after taking damage · Visage: Grants immunity to fall damage and allows constant jumping; 10% increased flight time and horizontal wing speed; Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 50% faster; Reduces the cooldown of dashes by 33% · Headgear: Emits light and shows the location of treasure and ore; Enemies are less likely to target you and grants underwater breathing; Greatly enhances visibility in the abyss; Increased block placement & tool range by 7; Increases pickup range for items

accessories.name: Angel Treads
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'

accessories.name: Fishron Wings
accessories.why: Flight, and faster movement in rain and water.
accessories.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Festive Wings
accessories.source: Dropped by the Everscream during the Frost Moon
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall

accessories.name: Asgard's Valor
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

accessories.name: Arcane Flower
accessories.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Enemies are less likely to target you

accessories.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

accessories.name: Permafrost's Concoction
accessories.effect: Increases maximum mana by 40 and reduces mana cost by 15% · +0.5 HP/s life regen below half health, +1 HP/s when below 25% health and +2 HP/s when below 10% health · +3 HP/s life regen while afflicted with any fire debuff · You will survive fatal damage and revive with 30% life on a 3 minute cooldown · You are encased in an ice barrier for 3 seconds when revived

accessories.name: Chaos Stone
accessories.effect: Disables automatic potion consumption · Items that consume mana can be used even without the required mana amount · Mana usage can overflow into negative mana, causing you to both receive and inflict Mana Burn · The lower your mana, the more intense the manafire burns · Negative Mana is capped at your maximum mana amount · Current maximum intensity with your maximum mana: -[REGEN] HP/s, and burns enemies for [DAMAGE]% of dealt damage

accessories.name: Celestial Emblem
accessories.why: 15% magic damage and a larger mana star pickup range.
accessories.effect: Increases pickup range for mana stars · 15% increased magic damage

buffs.name: Greater Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Super Mana Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: It is the most potent of all mana restoration items.

buffs.name: Candles
buffs.effect: Emit light.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Wizard
buffs.why: Free Clairvoyance remains a baseline endgame mage habit before any serious fight.
buffs.effect: It is purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC. Pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on a placed Crystal Ball grants the Clairvoyance buff and opens its crafting menu.

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases magic damage by 20%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the rate at which the player's mana regenerates. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

weapons.source: Dropped by the majority of enemies that spawn during the Martian Madness event
weapons.why: strong area explosive damage; large stealth-strike explosion

weapons.why: rapid plague-based projectile spam

weapons.why: plague grenade with good crowd damage; plague stealth-strike area damage
weapons.effect: It is an explosive projectile that release 20 plague-infected bees upon explosion. Both the explosion and the bees inflict the Plague debuff on contact.

weapons.source: Dropped by Aries after Astrum Aureus is defeated
weapons.why: homing knives with high sustained single-target DPS; boosted stealth-strike knives
weapons.effect: When thrown, it moves and rapidly spins in the direction it was initially thrown, slowly decelerating and losing spin speed over time. Once the knife fully decelerates, it then remains still until an enemy is within its detection range for it to home in.

weapons.name: Leviathan Teeth
weapons.why: homing stealth-strike projectiles
weapons.effect: When used, they rapidly throw an inaccurate tight spread of 2 gravity-affected teeth that inflict the Heavy Bleeding debuff on contact with enemies and stick to them. weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: high stealth-strike burst damage

items.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee

items.name: Asgard's Valor
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

items.name: Master Ninja Gear
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

items.name: Shield of the High Ruler
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'

items.name: Interstellar Stompers
items.effect: 6% increased movement speed, 20% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Hold ▼ Down to increase your maximum fall speed · Pressing Interstellar Stompers Hotkey while midair charges up a superspeed slam over 0.33 seconds · While falling, you ram through enemies and don't take contact damage · Once you hit the ground, you create an explosion at your feet · The explosion scales in both damage and size the longer you slam for · Temporary 40% increased jump speed after slamming into the ground

items.name: Leviathan Ambergris
items.source: Dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita
items.effect: 100% increased initial dash velocity, 33% faster dash cooldown, and greatly increased dash deceleration · Your dashes are empowered by water, knocking back and damaging enemies with vicious currents · Visual effects are reduced if visibility is disabled

items.name: Celestial Shell
items.effect: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night · Turns the holder into a merfolk when entering water · Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback

items.name: Bloom Stone
items.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'

items.name: Frozen Shield
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25% · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life

items.name: Living Dew
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x and makes it generate 100% faster while equipped.

items.name: Star Veil
items.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage

items.name: Apollyon
items.effect: When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Additionally, critical strikes spread all debuffs inflicted on the hit enemy that are weaker than Bane to up to 10 enemies within an 87.5-tile range, and critical strikes deal 3% increased damage for every debuff inflicted on the enemy.

items.name: Destroyer Emblem
items.effect: 10% increased damage · 8% increased critical strike chance

items.name: Eye of the Golem
items.source: Dropped by Golem and 1 other source
items.why: This grants critical strike damage.
items.effect: It has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Golem.

items.name: Ruin Medallion
items.effect: Stealth strikes only expend 75% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

items.name: Abyssal Mirror
items.effect: Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss · Generate stealth 25% faster when standing still and 12% faster while moving · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a cloud that damages and stuns nearby enemies · 'Light does not reach the depths of the ocean'

items.name: Glove of Precision
items.source: Purchased from the Bandit for 48 gold after Plantera has been defeated
items.effect: Decreases rogue attack speed by 15% · Increases rogue damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and velocity by 15%

items.name: Vampiric Talisman
items.effect: When equipped, it causes rogue critical hits to steal 1.5% of their damage (rounded down) in health. Additionally, it increases stealth strike damage by 8% and causes all stealth strikes to inflict Armor Crunch for 2.5 seconds and Heavy Bleeding for 5 seconds.

items.name: Celestial Shell
items.why: All-round stats, plus werewolf at night and merfolk in water.
items.effect: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night · Turns the holder into a merfolk when entering water · Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback

items.name: Spectre Wings
items.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Master Ninja Gear
items.why: Dash, wall climbing, and a 10% chance to dodge an attack.
items.effect: It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Briny Baron
weapons.why: versatile sword with strong projectile damage
weapons.effect: When used with its primary fire (left-click), it will swing, and deal damage in a normal manner. Striking an enemy with the sword spawns a shortly lingering typhoon that deals 50% of the weapon's damage in rapid successions and only one typhoon can exist at a time.

weapons.name: Exalted Oathblade
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: solid melee sword alternative
weapons.effect: When used with its primary function (left-click), it throws a sword that sticks into enemies and reduces their speed, with a max of 4 being able to be stuck into a single enemy. If another is stuck, the oldest one will be launched out.

weapons.name: Flying Dragon
weapons.source: Dropped by Betsy (Old One's Army Tier 3)
weapons.why: Fires a red crescent-shaped projectile on each swing.
weapons.effect: When swung, it fires red crescent-shaped projectiles every 20 ticks [ 1 ] [ 2 ], which pierce four enemies, pass through blocks, and dissipate after one second.

weapons.name: Galvanizing Glaive
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: reliable spear-type melee option
weapons.effect: When used, the player swings a spear around similarly to the Ghastly Glaive, and releases five gauss energy projectiles, each dealing 40% of the weapon's damage. If the target is struck by the spear itself, there is a 1/12 chance per hit for an energy flux to spawn on the enemy, which continuously deals the weapon's damage.

weapons.name: Lucrecia
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: strong melee weapon alternative
weapons.effect: When used, it swings back and forth in front of the player, firing a darklight shard that pierces infinitely but cannot pass through tiles with each swing. Hitting with the sword itself builds up Darklight Energy, a resource that dissipates slowly over time, but briefly stops anytime it is gained.

armor.name: Beetle armor
armor.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.why: Beetles either raise melee damage and speed or absorb damage, depending on the chestplate you wear.
armor.desc: Beetle armor is a Hardmode, post- Golem melee armor set consisting of the Beetle Helmet and Beetle Leggings, as well as two different chestpieces: the Beetle Scale Mail and Beetle Shell, providing offensive and defensive bonuses respectively.
armor.headpieceBonus: Beetles increase your melee damage and speed
armor.effect: Effect of the beetles is reduced to increase melee speed by 5%/10%/15% · Effect of the beetles is reduced to increase damage reduction by 10%/20%/30% and is additive

armor.name: Hydrothermic armor
armor.why: melee set with brimstone offensive bonuses
armor.effect: Inferno effect when below 50% life · You emit a blazing explosion when you are hit
armor.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: Enemies are more likely to target you · Melee attacks and projectiles cause chaos flames to erupt on enemy hits

armor.name: Valhalla Knight armor
armor.source: Dropped by the Old One's Army, tier 3
armor.effect: Increases your max number of sentries by 1 · Greatly enhances Ballista effectiveness
armor.desc: Valhalla Knight armor is a Hardmode, post- Golem melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Valhalla Knight's Helm, Valhalla Knight's Breastplate, and Valhalla Knight's Greaves. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of 1500000* 150.

armor.name: Reaver armor
armor.desc: Reaver armor is a Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you; Reduces the life regen lost from damage over time debuffs by 20%; 30% decreased movement speed and flight time; Grants Reaver Rage for 5 seconds after taking damage · Visage: Grants immunity to fall damage and allows constant jumping; 10% increased flight time and horizontal wing speed; Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 50% faster; Reduces the cooldown of dashes by 33% · Headgear: Emits light and shows the location of treasure and ore; Enemies are less likely to target you and grants underwater breathing; Greatly enhances visibility in the abyss; Increased block placement & tool range by 7; Increases pickup range for items

accessories.name: Angel Treads
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'

accessories.name: Fishron Wings
accessories.why: Flight, and faster movement in rain and water.
accessories.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Asgard's Valor
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

accessories.name: Shield of the High Ruler

accessories.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'

accessories.name: Fire Gauntlet
accessories.why: Melee damage, speed and knockback, and sets enemies on fire. Upgrades from Mechanical Glove.
accessories.effect: Increases melee knockback and melee attacks inflict fire damage · 12% increased melee damage and speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons · Increases the size of melee weapons

accessories.name: Blood Pact
accessories.effect: When equipped, it increases the player's maximum health by 25%, grants immunity to the Bleeding, Burning Blood & Heavy Bleeding debuffs, and increases the amount of health restored from drinking healing potions by 33%.

accessories.name: The Community
accessories.effect: When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

accessories.name: Soaring Insignia
accessories.source: Dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess
accessories.effect: Grants infinite wing and rocket boot flight · Increases flight and jump mobility

buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Candles
buffs.effect: Emit light.

buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Flask of Brimstone
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.why: adds brimstone damage to melee hits
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Brimstone buff, which causes melee, whip, and rogue weapons to inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff.

buffs.name: Flask of Venom
buffs.source: Brewed at Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.effect: Causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Acid Venom debuff on hit for 5–9 seconds, which deals 30 damage per second to enemies and prevents health regeneration. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Sharpening Station
buffs.source: Found in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle
buffs.why: The armor penetration bonus is one of the best class-specific pre-Hardmode melee boosts.
buffs.effect: In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Merchant for 10 GC.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. armor.name: Reaver armor
armor.desc: Reaver armor is a Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you; Reduces the life regen lost from damage over time debuffs by 20%; 30% decreased movement speed and flight time; Grants Reaver Rage for 5 seconds after taking damage · Visage: Grants immunity to fall damage and allows constant jumping; 10% increased flight time and horizontal wing speed; Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 50% faster; Reduces the cooldown of dashes by 33% · Headgear: Emits light and shows the location of treasure and ore; Enemies are less likely to target you and grants underwater breathing; Greatly enhances visibility in the abyss; Increased block placement & tool range by 7; Increases pickup range for items

accessories.name: Angel Treads
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'

accessories.name: Fishron Wings
accessories.why: Flight, and faster movement in rain and water.
accessories.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Asgard's Valor
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

accessories.name: Shield of the High Ruler
accessories.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
accessories.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'

accessories.name: Blood Pact
accessories.effect: When equipped, it increases the player's maximum health by 25%, grants immunity to the Bleeding, Burning Blood & Heavy Bleeding debuffs, and increases the amount of health restored from drinking healing potions by 33%.

accessories.name: Deadshot Brooch
accessories.effect: 12% increased ranged damage, 7% increased ranged critical strike chance and 20% reduced ammo usage · Pressing Ammo Cycle Hotkey will automatically swap the order of ammos in your ammo slots · The ammo type swapped depends on the ammo of the weapon you are holding

accessories.name: Recon Scope
accessories.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance · Enemies are less likely to target you · 'Enemy spotted'

buffs.name: Greater Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Candles
buffs.effect: Emit light.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.source: Placed station buff
buffs.why: Endgame ranger still wants free ammo efficiency before every serious fight.
buffs.effect: It can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 10 GC in Hardmode.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Ammo consumption adds up quickly on the strongest guns, so this stretches your best supplies further.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff reduces the chance of consuming any ammunition by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage of arrow -firing weapons by 10%, as well as the velocity of arrows by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Betsy's Wings
items.why: This should be used with Angel Treads
items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Empress Wings
items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Fishron Wings
