items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Angel Treads
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'

items.name: Fairy Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee

items.name: Asgard's Valor
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

items.name: Master Ninja Gear
items.why: In respect to mobility, the Master Ninja Gear enables the player to dash. Compared to the Shield of Cthulhu, the Master Ninja Gear's dash is twice as long and does not have any effect if the player collides with an enemy.
items.effect: It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

items.name: Shield of the High Ruler
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'

items.name: Interstellar Stompers
items.effect: 6% increased movement speed, 20% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Hold ▼ Down to increase your maximum fall speed · Pressing Interstellar Stompers Hotkey while midair charges up a superspeed slam over 0.33 seconds · While falling, you ram through enemies and don't take contact damage · Once you hit the ground, you create an explosion at your feet · The explosion scales in both damage and size the longer you slam for · Temporary 40% increased jump speed after slamming into the ground

items.name: Soaring Insignia
items.why: This no longer grants infinite flight.
items.effect: Grants infinite wing and rocket boot flight · Increases flight and jump mobility

items.name: Celestial Shell
items.why: All-round stats, plus werewolf at night and merfolk in water.
items.effect: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night · Turns the holder into a merfolk when entering water · Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback

items.name: Blood Pact
items.why: This should be used with Bloom Stone
items.effect: When equipped, it increases the player's maximum health by 25%, grants immunity to the Bleeding, Burning Blood & Heavy Bleeding debuffs, and increases the amount of health restored from drinking healing potions by 33%.

items.name: Bloom Stone
items.why: This should be used with Blood Pact
items.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'

items.name: Frozen Shield
items.why: Essentially an upgraded version of the Frozen Turtle Shell which provides 6 defense, reduces all damage taken by the player by 25% if the player is below 50% max HP, and grants immunity to knockback.
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25% · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life

items.name: Living Dew
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x and makes it generate 100% faster while equipped.

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Doubles the length of the player's immunity frames (to 4/3 of a second), and summons falling stars when the player is hit.
items.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage

items.name: Alchemical Decanter
items.effect: All attacks inflict the Plague and reduces damage taken from the Plague by 50% · Projectiles spawn plague seekers on enemy hits · Releases plague bees and douses you in Honey when damaged

items.name: Apollyon
items.effect: When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Additionally, critical strikes spread all debuffs inflicted on the hit enemy that are weaker than Bane to up to 10 enemies within an 87.5-tile range, and critical strikes deal 3% increased damage for every debuff inflicted on the enemy.

items.name: Deadshot Brooch
items.effect: 12% increased ranged damage, 7% increased ranged critical strike chance and 20% reduced ammo usage · Pressing Ammo Cycle Hotkey will automatically swap the order of ammos in your ammo slots · The ammo type swapped depends on the ammo of the weapon you are holding

items.name: Recon Scope
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance · Enemies are less likely to target you · 'Enemy spotted'

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

items.name: Sniper Scope
items.why: 10% ranged damage and crit, and zooms out when you right-click with a gun.
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance

items.name: Celestial Shell
items.why: All-round stats, plus werewolf at night and merfolk in water.
items.effect: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night · Turns the holder into a merfolk when entering water · Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback

items.name: Master Ninja Gear
items.why: Dash, wall climbing, and a 10% chance to dodge an attack.
items.effect: It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

tools.name: Betsy's Wrath
tools.source: Dropped by Betsy (Old One's Army Tier 3, post-Golem)
tools.effect: When used, it fires three fireballs that travel in arcs. The fireballs explode upon impact with an enemy or a block and inflict the Betsy's Curse debuff, which adds 40 armor penetration against affected entities for 10 seconds.

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

ammo.name: Rocket III
ammo.source: Dropped by Plantera when it drops the Grenade Launcher
ammo.effect: The Rocket I variant is also dropped by Plantera when it drops the Grenade Launcher. Most launchers use Rockets as ammunition.

ammo.name: Venom Arrow
ammo.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
ammo.effect: It has the highest base damage of all arrows and inflicts the Acid Venom debuff for 10 seconds upon hitting enemies.

weapons.name: Bubble Gun
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron (summonable in early Hardmode, no boss prerequisite)
weapons.why: Rapidly fires a short-range spread of bubbles.
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly fires a large spread of short-range bubbles, with three bubbles per use. Bubble projectiles gradually slow down and dissipate upon contact with an enemy or block, or after 1.67 seconds.

weapons.name: Hematemesis
weapons.why: strong homing single-target DPS
weapons.effect: When used, it fires 10 blood bolts that spawn from below the screen and move upwards at high speed near the cursor's position. The blood bolts can pass through tiles but cannot pierce.

weapons.name: Plague Staff
weapons.why: homing plague bees with good DPS
weapons.effect: It shoots out a spread of 4 plague fangs while one is always directed at the cursor, which are colored green and are trailed by pink light. The player can tighten the spread of the projectiles by aiming the cursor further away.

weapons.name: Rainbow Gun
weapons.source: Found in Hallowed Chest in the Dungeon (opened with a Hallowed Key)
weapons.why: Launches a lasting rainbow that damages enemies along its arc.
weapons.effect: Enemies touching the rainbow take damage repeatedly, approximately five times per second. The Rainbow Gun is always found in the Dungeon 's Hallowed Chest, which can only be unlocked with a Hallowed Key after Plantera has been defeated.

weapons.name: Stellar Tune
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light (summoned post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires homing star projectiles that pass through blocks and explode on impact.
weapons.effect: Star projectiles will have their damage reduced by 25% (down to 63 base damage) when the line of sight between the player and the projectiles' point of impact is obstructed. [ 1 ] It also plays an acoustic guitar chord when fired based on the distance between the player and the cursor (in a similar fashion to the Magical Harp). There are a total of six chords, and each one spans about a four-block distance from the player, except for the last one, which is played at a distance of 21 blocks or more.

weapons.name: Wingman
weapons.source: Dropped by Martian Engineers during the Martian Madness event
weapons.why: secondary lower-priority option
weapons.effect: When used with its primary fire (left-click), it summons two Wingmen to the sides of the player perpendicular to the direction of the cursor, that each switch sides and fire lasers towards the cursor that travel through tiles and pierce once. The Wingmen gradually increase in firing rate and laser velocity the longer it is held for, reaching a full speed of 6 lasers per second after 6 shots.

armor.name: Brimflame armor
armor.effect: 8% increased damage and magic critical strike chance · Brimflame Frenzy - Armor Set Bonus for 10 seconds of 40% increased magic damage · However, this inflicts rapid life loss and disables mana regeneration and mana potions · This effect can be toggled off and has a cooldown of 30 seconds
armor.desc: Brimflame armor is a Hardmode mage armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a tiny pulsating aura around them.

armor.name: Hydrothermic armor
armor.why: melee set with brimstone offensive bonuses
armor.effect: Inferno effect when below 50% life · You emit a blazing explosion when you are hit
armor.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: Magic attacks summon damaging and healing flare orbs on hit

accessories.effect: Increases maximum mana by 40 and reduces mana cost by 15% · +0.5 HP/s life regen below half health, +1 HP/s when below 25% health and +2 HP/s when below 10% health · +3 HP/s life regen while afflicted with any fire debuff · You will survive fatal damage and revive with 30% life on a 3 minute cooldown · You are encased in an ice barrier for 3 seconds when revived

tools.why: Fires a projectile that reduces enemy defense and creates homing shards.

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.why: support weapon usable by all classes
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Fuel Cell Bundle
weapons.why: strong homing rocket minions
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a small gravity-affected flask that deals no damage but summons a small and armed miniature Plaguebringer minion upon tile contact. The mini Plaguebringer stays at a certain distance from enemies to fire explosive plague missiles and occasionally a homing plague missile.

weapons.name: Infected Remote
weapons.why: solid controllable minion
weapons.effect: Summons a humanoid-hybrid Plaguebringer, codenamed 'Virili', to aid you in battle · Virili can only be summoned once · Virili uses a variety of attacks which she cycles through on a timer · All attacks spread the Plague , as was her original design intention · 'There's a single label on the back: · WARNING: Subject is extremely corrosive and contagious. Avoid direct contact.'

weapons.name: Resurrection Butterfly
weapons.why: reliable single-target minion
weapons.effect: When used with 2 or more minion slots, it summons two butterflies of different colors. The purple butterfly will charge into enemies with a short delay between charges, while the pink butterfly will fire 2 bullets towards enemies every 2-4 seconds that deal 85% of the weapon's base damage and last for 3.5 seconds.

weapons.name: Wither Blossoms Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: debuffing minion option
weapons.effect: When used, it summons up to four dark-colored flowers that orbit around the player, and fire homing bolts at nearby targets. The bolts travel through terrain, disappearing shortly after hitting an enemy and inflicting the Plague debuff.

weapons.source: Dropped by the Martian Saucer during Martian Madness
weapons.why: Summons UFO minions with instantaneous non-missing attacks; event is post-Golem.
weapons.effect: It hovers above enemies, firing blue lasers that hit the target instantaneously. If an enemy is 18.75 to 50 tiles away, it will instantly teleport above it.

weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: high-DPS mine sentry
weapons.effect: It summons a stationary mine base that summons mines on nearby tiles which home in on enemies. When an enemy comes in contact with a mine, it will blow up.

weapons.name: Spikecrag Staff
weapons.why: area-denial sentry
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a Spikecrag sentry that attacks enemies by firing an intense upward spray of gravity-affected spikes; a total of 1 to 2 spikes are fired every 1/6th of a second.

tools.name: Betsy's Wrath

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled

accessories.name: Hide of Astrum Deus
accessories.effect: True melee strikes drop astral stars from the sky · Releases an explosion and temporarily increases true melee damage by 30% when damaged · Boost duration scales with the amount of damage you took, up to 10 seconds · Nullifies the Astral Infection

buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion

buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.

This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Flask of Brimstone
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.why: adds brimstone damage to melee hits
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Brimstone buff, which causes melee, whip, and rogue weapons to inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff.

buffs.name: Flask of Venom
buffs.source: Brewed at Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.effect: Causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Acid Venom debuff on hit for 5–9 seconds, which deals 30 damage per second to enemies and prevents health regeneration. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Sharpening Station
buffs.source: Found in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle
buffs.why: The armor penetration bonus is one of the best class-specific pre-Hardmode melee boosts.
buffs.effect: In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Merchant for 10 GC.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Soaring Potion

buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

items.name: Betsy's Wings
items.why: This should be used with Angel Treads
items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Empress Wings
items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Fishron Wings
items.why: Flight, and faster movement in rain and water.

items.name: Angel Treads
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'

items.name: Asgard's Valor
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

items.name: Master Ninja Gear
items.why: Dash, wall climbing, and a 10% chance to dodge an attack.
items.effect: It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

items.name: Shield of the High Ruler
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'

items.name: Interstellar Stompers
items.effect: 6% increased movement speed, 20% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Hold ▼ Down to increase your maximum fall speed · Pressing Interstellar Stompers Hotkey while midair charges up a superspeed slam over 0.33 seconds · While falling, you ram through enemies and don't take contact damage · Once you hit the ground, you create an explosion at your feet · The explosion scales in both damage and size the longer you slam for · Temporary 40% increased jump speed after slamming into the ground

items.name: Soaring Insignia
items.why: This no longer grants infinite flight.
items.effect: Grants infinite wing and rocket boot flight · Increases flight and jump mobility

items.name: Celestial Shell
items.why: All-round stats, plus werewolf at night and merfolk in water.
items.effect: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night · Turns the holder into a merfolk when entering water · Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback

items.name: Hide of Astrum Deus

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

items.name: Ambrosial Ampoule

items.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'

items.name: Deific Amulet

items.name: Frozen Shield
items.why: Essentially an upgraded version of the Frozen Turtle Shell which provides 6 defense, reduces all damage taken by the player by 25% if the player is below 50% max HP, and grants immunity to knockback.
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25% · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life

items.name: Infected Jewel
items.why: Use on Astrum Deus.
items.effect: +1 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 4 HP/s · Jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · 'A beautiful gemstone tarnished by spaceborne rot'

items.name: Apollyon
items.effect: When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Additionally, critical strikes spread all debuffs inflicted on the hit enemy that are weaker than Bane to up to 10 enemies within an 87.5-tile range, and critical strikes deal 3% increased damage for every debuff inflicted on the enemy.

items.name: Eye of the Golem
items.source: Dropped by Golem and 1 other source
items.effect: It has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Golem.

items.name: Fire Gauntlet
items.why: Melee damage, speed and knockback, and sets enemies on fire. Upgrades from Mechanical Glove.
items.effect: Increases melee knockback and melee attacks inflict fire damage · 12% increased melee damage and speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons · Increases the size of melee weapons

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

tools.name: Betsy's Wrath
tools.source: Dropped by Betsy (Old One's Army Tier 3, post-Golem)
tools.effect: When used, it fires three fireballs that travel in arcs. The fireballs explode upon impact with an enemy or a block and inflict the Betsy's Curse debuff, which adds 40 armor penetration against affected entities for 10 seconds.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: B-GSS: Nidhogg
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: first-listed primary ranged weapon at this tier
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly fires instant-traveling gauss shots with very slight inaccuracy. Gauss shots create a small lingering magnetic implosion which pulls in non-boss enemies, though only one can exist at a time.

weapons.name: Dead Sun's Wind
weapons.why: strong alternative primary weapon
weapons.effect: When used, it fires high-velocity blasts of cosmic plasma that cause explosions on enemy hits, each explosion dealing 150% of the weapon's damage and increasing in size with consecutive hits. The plasma blasts can also ricochet off tiles, after which they gain the ability to home in aggressively on nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Plague Tainted SMG
weapons.why: solid sustained-DPS gun option
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used with its primary fire (⚒ Use / Attack), it converts all bullets into plague bullets that inflict the Plague debuff on hit, dealing 150% damage and knockback if the target is within 50 tiles of the player. Critical strikes from plague bullets fire a plague drone that homes in on enemies and explodes upon contact with an enemy or block, with a 75% chance to critically strike if the target is afflicted with the Plague debuff.

weapons.name: Vortexpopper
weapons.why: high-fire-rate ranged option
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a spread of bubbles from the gun, and extra bubbles off-screen from any direction. After a short delay, the bubbles will pop and fire a bullet towards the cursor.

armor.name: Hydrothermic armor
armor.why: melee set with brimstone offensive bonuses
armor.effect: Inferno effect when below 50% life · You emit a blazing explosion when you are hit
armor.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: You fire a homing chaos flare when using ranged weapons every 0.33 seconds

armor.name: Lunic Corps armor

armor.desc: Lunic Corps armor is a Hardmode ranger armor set.

armor.name: Plague Reaper armor
armor.effect: 5% increased flight time · Enemies afflicted by the Plague take 1.1x damage from ranged projectiles · Plague Blackout - Armor Set Bonus to greatly empower your damage but completely blind yourself · 60% increased ranged damage and 20% increased ranged critical strike chance while blacked out · This effect lasts 5 seconds and has a cooldown of 25 seconds
armor.desc: Plague Reaper armor is a Hardmode ranger armor set. If the entire set is visible (regardless of whether it is equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura.

armor.name: Astral armor
armor.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 3 · 10% increased damage and critical strike chance · Whenever you crit an enemy, a barrage of stars will rain down · This effect has a 1 second cooldown before it can trigger again
armor.desc: Astral armor is a Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits an afterimage effect.

armor.name: Reaver armor
armor.desc: Reaver armor is a Hardmode armor set.

armor.headpieceBonus: Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you; Reduces the life regen lost from damage over time debuffs by 20%; 30% decreased movement speed and flight time; Grants Reaver Rage for 5 seconds after taking damage · Visage: Grants immunity to fall damage and allows constant jumping; 10% increased flight time and horizontal wing speed; Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 50% faster; Reduces the cooldown of dashes by 33% · Headgear: Emits light and shows the location of treasure and ore; Enemies are less likely to target you and grants underwater breathing; Greatly enhances visibility in the abyss; Increased block placement & tool range by 7; Increases pickup range for items

accessories.name: Betsy's Wings
accessories.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Empress Wings
accessories.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Fishron Wings
accessories.why: Flight, and faster movement in rain and water.
accessories.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Celestial Shell
accessories.why: All-round stats, plus werewolf at night and merfolk in water.
accessories.effect: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night · Turns the holder into a merfolk when entering water · Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback

accessories.name: Heart of the Elements
accessories.effect: It will summon all of the Elementals to assist the player and attack enemies.

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

accessories.name: Angel Treads
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'

accessories.name: Asgard's Valor
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.why: Dash, wall climbing, and a 10% chance to dodge an attack.
accessories.effect: It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

accessories.name: Shield of the High Ruler
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'

accessories.name: Interstellar Stompers
accessories.effect: 6% increased movement speed, 20% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Hold ▼ Down to increase your maximum fall speed · Pressing Interstellar Stompers Hotkey while midair charges up a superspeed slam over 0.33 seconds · While falling, you ram through enemies and don't take contact damage · Once you hit the ground, you create an explosion at your feet · The explosion scales in both damage and size the longer you slam for · Temporary 40% increased jump speed after slamming into the ground

accessories.name: Soaring Insignia
accessories.source: Dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess
accessories.effect: Grants infinite wing and rocket boot flight · Increases flight and jump mobility

accessories.name: Papyrus Scarab
accessories.effect: When equipped, it increases the damage of summon weapons by 15%, increases their knockback by 2, and increases the player's maximum number of minions by one.

accessories.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

accessories.name: Star-Tainted Generator
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 2, and summon damage by 7% · Minion attacks spawn astral explosions and inflict several debuffs · Grants immunity to Irradiated · Does not stack with downgrades

accessories.name: Statis' Curse
accessories.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 3, and summon damage by 12% · Increased minion knockback · Minion attacks inflict Shadowflame , and grants immunity to Shadowflame · Does not stack with downgrades

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled

accessories.name: Blood Pact
accessories.effect: When equipped, it increases the player's maximum health by 25%, grants immunity to the Bleeding, Burning Blood & Heavy Bleeding debuffs, and increases the amount of health restored from drinking healing potions by 33%.

accessories.name: Bloom Stone
accessories.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'

accessories.name: Deific Amulet
accessories.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

accessories.name: Frozen Shield
accessories.why: Essentially an upgraded version of the Frozen Turtle Shell which provides 6 defense, reduces all damage taken by the player by 25% if the player is below 50% max HP, and grants immunity to knockback.
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25% · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life

accessories.name: Infected Jewel
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: +1 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 4 HP/s · Jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · 'A beautiful gemstone tarnished by spaceborne rot'

buffs.name: Super Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Candles
buffs.effect: Emit light.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Dungeon
buffs.why: A free extra minion remains part of every serious endgame summoner setup.
buffs.effect: In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Witch Doctor for 10 GC if the Wizard is present. It emits light when placed.

buffs.name: Flask of Brimstone
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.why: adds brimstone damage to melee hits
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Brimstone buff, which causes melee, whip, and rogue weapons to inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff.

buffs.name: Flask of Venom
buffs.source: Brewed at Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.effect: Causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Acid Venom debuff on hit for 5–9 seconds, which deals 30 damage per second to enemies and prevents health regeneration. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The extra minion slot is too valuable to skip, even in the earliest summoner boss prep.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum number of minions by 1. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: War Table
buffs.source: Dropped by the Dark Mage and Ogre during the Old One's Army
buffs.why: Table buff that boosts minion damage.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

tools.name: Betsy's Wrath
tools.source: Dropped by Betsy (Old One's Army Tier 3, post-Golem)
tools.effect: When used, it fires three fireballs that travel in arcs. The fireballs explode upon impact with an enemy or a block and inflict the Betsy's Curse debuff, which adds 40 armor penetration against affected entities for 10 seconds.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Plaguenade
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: plague-infused grenade with area damage
weapons.effect: It is an explosive projectile that release 20 plague-infected bees upon explosion. Both the explosion and the bees inflict the Plague debuff on contact.

weapons.name: Radiant Star
weapons.why: rapid star-shard spam damage
weapons.effect: When used, it throws an astral dagger that is not affected by gravity and pierces 3 times. Shortly after it is thrown, it causes a lingering explosion and splits into 3 copies of itself that home in on the closest enemy and deal half of the weapon's damage.

weapons.name: Regulus Riot
weapons.why: high sustained thrown DPS; powerful stealth-strike option
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a spinning disk towards the cursor's position, traveling a moderate distance before dissipating. If there are enemies nearby, the disk will charge towards the nearest enemy and hit up to 3 times.

weapons.name: Shard of Antumbra
weapons.why: homing shadow shards, strong single-target; homing shards on stealth strike
weapons.effect: It pierces infinitely and travels significant distances before being affected by gravity. Its damage is decreased by 10% every time it pierces an enemy.

weapons.name: Star of Destruction
weapons.why: explosive burst damage, and a heavy stealth-strike burst
weapons.effect: On use, it throws a large spread of cosmic bolts which converge into a bomb. The bomb weakly follows the cursor, exploding when it hits an enemy or after 5 seconds.

weapons.name: Duke's Decapitator
weapons.why: strong homing stealth strike
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a fast-spinning axe that slowly decelerates to a stop and breaks shortly after. It will stick onto an enemy upon contact, dealing damage.

weapons.name: Leviathan Teeth
weapons.why: thrown teeth with stealth spread
weapons.effect: When used, they rapidly throw an inaccurate tight spread of 2 gravity-affected teeth that inflict the Heavy Bleeding debuff on contact with enemies and stick to them. After sticking for 2 seconds, teeth will launch out the other side of the enemy, dealing an additional burst of damage.

armor.name: Hydrothermic armor
armor.why: melee set with brimstone offensive bonuses
armor.effect: Inferno effect when below 50% life · You emit a blazing explosion when you are hit
armor.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: +110 maximum stealth · Rogue weapons unleash a volley of homing chaos flames around the player every 2 seconds

armor.desc: Astral armor is a Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits an afterimage effect.

weapons.effect: Holding left-click will fire four barracudas that latch on to enemies and deal continuous damage as long as left-click is held down. After an enemy dies, the barracudas will automatically latch onto other enemies in range.

weapons.name: Clockwork Bow
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: strong bow alternative
weapons.effect: When used, it slowly loads up to 6 precision bolts. Each bolt loaded reduces the time taken to load the next bolt by 5%.

weapons.name: Planetary Annihilation
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: high-damage ranged option
weapons.effect: It converts Wooden Arrows into rainbow blasts that home in on enemies. Each set of bolts consists of a Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo, and Violet bolt which all act identically to each other and are fired in a random order from the sky.

weapons.name: Prideful Hunter's Planar Ripper
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: solid ranged alternative
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly fires bullets. Musket balls turn into fast lightning bolts which do not pierce enemies or tiles, inflict the Electrified debuff, and explode when enemies are killed.

weapons.name: Superradiant Slaughterer
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: solid ranged alternative
weapons.effect: When held, it charges up a handheld buzzsaw which deals 150% damage on contact. As continuously held, the buzzsaw grows to a medium size after 0.5 seconds and full size after 2 seconds, as well as linearly scaling from 100% to 500% damage and 1 to 6 pierce over 2 seconds.

armor.name: Lunic Corps armor
armor.effect: 20% increased jump speed · MJOLNIR Shield - Projects a bubble shield that absorbs up to 50 damage · Halves Adrenaline lost on hit if the shield fully absorbs the hit · The shield starts recharging 5 seconds after being hit · Recharging from zero to full charge takes 2 seconds · Being hit again while recharging restarts the charge timer · 'Finish the fight'
armor.desc: Lunic Corps armor is a Hardmode ranger armor set.

armor.name: Vortex armor
armor.why: Toggle stealth to raise ranged damage and make enemies less likely to target you.
armor.effect: Double tap ▼ Down to toggle stealth, · increasing ranged ability and reducing chance for enemies to target you but slowing movement speed
armor.desc: Vortex armor is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord ranged armor set consisting of the Vortex Helmet, Vortex Breastplate, and Vortex Leggings.

armor.name: Astral armor
armor.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 3 · 10% increased damage and critical strike chance · Whenever you crit an enemy, a barrage of stars will rain down · This effect has a 1 second cooldown before it can trigger again
armor.desc: Astral armor is a Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits an afterimage effect.

accessories.name: Moon Walkers
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 2.67 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Great · Max vertical speed: Great · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Good · 24% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Hee hee!'

accessories.name: Vortex Booster
accessories.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Deadshot Brooch
accessories.effect: 12% increased ranged damage, 7% increased ranged critical strike chance and 20% reduced ammo usage · Pressing Ammo Cycle Hotkey will automatically swap the order of ammos in your ammo slots · The ammo type swapped depends on the ammo of the weapon you are holding

accessories.name: Asgard's Valor
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

accessories.name: Statis' Ninja Belt
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 10% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.6x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws

accessories.name: Recon Scope
accessories.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance · Enemies are less likely to target you · 'Enemy spotted'

accessories.name: Blood Pact
accessories.effect: When equipped, it increases the player's maximum health by 25%, grants immunity to the Bleeding, Burning Blood & Heavy Bleeding debuffs, and increases the amount of health restored from drinking healing potions by 33%.

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled

accessories.name: Dynamo Stem Cells
accessories.effect: 10% increased ranged damage and movement speed · Ranged weapons fire a powerful mini swarmer every 3 seconds · Reduces damage taken from Dragonfire

buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.source: Placed station buff
buffs.why: Endgame ranger still wants free ammo efficiency before every serious fight.
buffs.effect: It can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 10 GC in Hardmode.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Ammo consumption adds up quickly on the strongest guns, so this stretches your best supplies further.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff reduces the chance of consuming any ammunition by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage of arrow -firing weapons by 10%, as well as the velocity of arrows by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.why: The fastest wings in the game, with the longest flight time.
items.effect: In addition to granting remarkable flight capabilities, it has both hover and upwards boost capability. At its top speed, it travels at 82 mph horizontal, 115 mph vertical, and 51 mph while falling.

items.name: Daawnlight Spirit Origin
items.effect: All ranged weapons can supercrit when critical strike chance is over 100% · Marks enemies and bosses with bullseyes which boost critical strike chance when hit · Extra critical strike chance quickly fades over time · Summons a heroic spirit from another world if visibility is on or in vanity slots · 'A strand of a lost cosmos remains, waiting for its master'

items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance

items.name: Warbanner of the Righteous
items.why: This requires being close to the boss to perform well.
items.effect: While equipped, it increases all damage depending on how close the player is to an enemy. The boost scales from -15% to +15%.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Relic of Deliverance
tools.effect: When used, it mounts the player on the spear, which can be freely turned. Right-clicking dismounts the spear.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

ammo.name: Endless Musket Pouch
ammo.why: An infinite stack of Musket Balls, so ammo never runs out.
ammo.effect: While in the inventory, it acts as an infinite source of Musket Balls.

ammo.name: Venom Arrow
ammo.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
ammo.effect: It has the highest base damage of all arrows and inflicts the Acid Venom debuff for 10 seconds upon hitting enemies.

ammo.name: Wooden Arrow
ammo.source: Sold by the Merchant, or dropped by Skeletons and Zombies
ammo.effect: It has no special properties and is used for crafting a variety of more advanced ammunition. When fired with certain bows, Wooden Arrows will be converted into a special projectile (e.g. the Molten Fury converting them into Flaming Arrows).

weapons.name: Chronomancer's Scythe
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: primary recommended magic weapon, high homing DPS
weapons.effect: When used with its primary fire (left-click), the player will swing a scythe towards the cursor rapidly with a tiny range, similarly to the Terragrim. Every 0.083 seconds, a small icicle is inaccurately fired with 120% damage.

weapons.name: Genesis
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: strong versatile magic option
weapons.effect: When used, it fires an array of eight lasers that pierce once and decrease in their spread on successive shots. Every 6th shot, the weapon instead fires a powerful splitting beam in a Y-shape, which deals 900% damage and resets the laser spread for the following set of shots.

weapons.name: Nuclear Fury
weapons.why: solid piercing damage
weapons.effect: When used, it fires 8 cosmic typhoons evenly distributed in a circle around the player. The typhoons home in on nearby enemies, pass through tiles and pierce twice.

weapons.name: Nucleosynthesis
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: alternative magic weapon
weapons.effect: Casts four celestial beams near the player · Solar beams explode into fire on enemy hits · Nebula beams sweep a little bit over time · Vortex beams act like fast lightning and electrify enemies on hit · Stardust beams release small stars that home on enemy hits

weapons.name: Rouge Slash
weapons.why: alternative magic weapon
weapons.effect: When used, it fires three curved waves out from the player, which each vary in their size and speed and pass through tiles. The waves each pierce twice and disappear upon contact with a third.

items.name: Asgard's Valor

items.name: Statis' Ninja Belt

items.name: The Community
items.effect: When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

items.name: Ambrosial Ampoule

items.name: Bloom Stone
items.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'

items.name: Deific Amulet

items.name: Frozen Shield

items.name: Arcane Flower
items.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Enemies are less likely to target you

items.name: Destroyer Emblem
items.effect: 10% increased damage · 8% increased critical strike chance

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

items.name: Sigil of Calamitas
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 60 · 15% increased magic damage · Increases pickup range for mana stars

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Relic of Deliverance
tools.effect: When used, it mounts the player on the spear, which can be freely turned. Right-clicking dismounts the spear.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Flowers of Mortality
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: solid minion alternative
weapons.effect: When used, it summons up to 5 rainbow flowers that orbit around the player. The flowers attack nearby enemies by firing homing swirling rainbow bolts that occasionally burst into shrapnel on enemy hits.

weapons.name: Legion of Celestia
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: primary minion recommendation
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a Celestial Axe minion that floats around the player and attacks nearby enemies by aggressively dashing through them to deal damage and inflict the Elemental Mix debuff. The Celestial Axe minions constantly rotate through various colors.

weapons.name: Tactical Plague Engine
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: solid minion alternative
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a Plague Jet minion that fires and consumes bullets. It will attempt to fire from above, and will occasionally fire homing missiles instead of bullets, which inflict the Plague debuff and deal 150% of the weapon's base damage.

weapons.name: Lunar Portal Staff
weapons.why: Post-Moon Lord sentry summoning a floating portal that fires sweeping piercing beams.
weapons.effect: It continuously fires beams that sweep across enemies, which pierce infinite enemies but cannot pass through blocks. Unlike most sentries, the Lunar Portal floats midair.

weapons.name: Rainbow Crystal Staff
weapons.why: Post-Moon Lord sentry summoning a floating crystal that fires exploding light beams.
weapons.effect: It fires spreads of three multicolored light beams towards enemies, but cannot target through blocks. Each beam releases a star that explodes shortly after.

weapons.name: Sanctified Spark
weapons.why: solid sentry alternative
weapons.effect: When used, it summons an Impious Immolator sentry that slowly follows the player and rapidly fires flame bursts at the nearest enemy which inflicts the Holy Flames debuff. It will briefly pause between attacks, during which it will fire one healing orb that heals 5 health each for every 4 minion slots the player has.

weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light (summoned after Plantera)

weapons.effect: 20 summon tag damage · 10% summon tag critical strike chance · Your summons will focus struck enemies

weapons.name: Stellar Contempt

items.name: Elysian Aegis
items.source: Dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess

items.name: Statis' Ninja Belt

items.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
items.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled

items.name: Deific Amulet

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Blunder Booster

items.name: Dark Matter Sheath
items.effect: +10 maximum stealth · Stealth generation is boosted while moving if not attacking · Stealth strikes only expend 50% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance

items.name: Destroyer Emblem
items.effect: 10% increased damage · 8% increased critical strike chance

items.name: Abyssal Mirror

items.name: Glove of Precision

items.name: Spectral Veil
items.why: This is difficult and risky to use.
items.effect: While equipped, it makes stealth generate 15% faster.

items.name: Vampiric Talisman
items.effect: When equipped, it causes rogue critical hits to steal 1.5% of their damage (rounded down) in health. Additionally, it increases stealth strike damage by 8% and causes all stealth strikes to inflict Armor Crunch for 2.5 seconds and Heavy Bleeding for 5 seconds.

tools.name: Claret Cannon
tools.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
tools.effect: It fires a small claret round that explodes into 20 small floating blood orbs upon hitting an enemy. When collected by the player, each orb reduces the duration of the Potion Sickness debuff by 0.33 seconds.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Relic of Deliverance
tools.effect: When used, it mounts the player on the spear, which can be freely turned. Right-clicking dismounts the spear.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Banshee Hook
weapons.effect: It is swung in front of the player at an odd angle, similarly to the Ghastly Glaive, and releases a line of five projectiles at once, each dealing 85% of the weapon's damage. Hitting an enemy directly with the weapon causes a ghostly explosion, rapidly dealing 25% of the weapon's damage.

weapons.name: Crescent Moon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it spins a flail around the player, throwing out the flail towards the cursor when the attack button is released and creating homing crescent moon projectiles as it travels. While spinning the flail, homing crescents are spawned and the weapon generates Starburst, a unique resource with a cap of 100; the player's current Starburst amount is tracked on the Cooldown Rack and is shared among weapons.

weapons.name: Death's Ascension
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Holding ⚒ Use / Attack (default: Left Click) swings the scythe back and forth in front of the player. Holding ⚷ Open / Activate (default: Right Click) instead swings the scythe in a similar manner to a broadsword, and a large spread of four homing scythes are fired.

weapons.name: Galileo Gladius
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used with ⚒ Use / Attack (default: Left Click), the weapon rapidly stabs in front of the player with slightly varying angles, like the Gladius. Glowing blue energy extends a short distance from the weapon's tip with every stab, improving its range.

weapons.name: Neptune's Bounty
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a gravity-affected spinning abyssal sword that pierces infinitely. While spinning, the sword releases infinitely piercing water blasts which deal 16.67% damage in random directions, or towards nearby enemies if any are present.
