weapons.name: Halley's Inferno
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: It uses Gel for ammunition, with a 50% chance to not consume ammo. When used with its primary fire (⚒ Use / Attack), it fires a rapid burst of five blue comets that pierce four times.

weapons.name: Monsoon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When firing Wooden Arrows, four of the five arrows are converted into sharks, and the fifth, middle arrow is converted into a Typhoon Arrow. Typhoon Arrows erupt into a swirling typhoon on contact with enemies or tiles, dealing damage over time in a wide area.

weapons.name: Sulphuric Acid Cannon
weapons.source: Dropped by the Mauler miniboss in the Tier 3 Acid Rain
weapons.effect: When used, it slowly fires acid rockets which home in on enemies and stick to them. After being stuck to an enemy for 3.33 seconds, the acid rocket creates a large sulphuric mist explosion, dealing 200% base damage and inflicting the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff.

weapons.name: Tau Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: It is one of the final upgrades to the Magna Cannon and Opal Striker, alongside the Ontological Despoiler. While holding, the player channels a glowing blue orb at the tip of the cannon which increases in charge level every second, as indicated by a pulse.

armor.name: Bloodflare armor
armor.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.effect: Enemies below 50% life drop a heart when struck · This effect has a 5 second cooldown
armor.desc: Bloodflare armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit faint pulses.
armor.headpieceBonus: Armor Set Bonus to unleash the lost souls of polterghast[ sic ] to destroy your enemies · This effect has a 30 second cooldown · Ranged weapons fire bloodsplosion orbs every 2.5 seconds

armor.name: Omega Blue armor
armor.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 2 · Short-ranged tentacles heal you by sucking enemy life · Abyssal Madness - Armor Set Bonus to go berserk for 5 seconds · While active, tentacles attack with greater range and aggression, and always critically strike · This also grants 10% increased damage and critical strike chance · This effect has a 25 second cooldown
armor.desc: Omega Blue armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit a pulsating aura around them.

accessories.name: Void Striders
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 36% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Ludicrous speed!'

accessories.name: Elysian Wings
accessories.effect: When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

accessories.name: Deadshot Brooch
accessories.effect: 12% increased ranged damage, 7% increased ranged critical strike chance and 20% reduced ammo usage · Pressing Ammo Cycle Hotkey will automatically swap the order of ammos in your ammo slots · The ammo type swapped depends on the ammo of the weapon you are holding

accessories.name: Recon Scope
accessories.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance · Enemies are less likely to target you · 'Enemy spotted'

accessories.name: Elysian Aegis
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to dash, empowered by holy fire · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage · 'Blessed by the Profaned Flame'

accessories.name: Affliction
accessories.source: Dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode
accessories.effect: While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

accessories.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

accessories.name: Dynamo Stem Cells
accessories.effect: 10% increased ranged damage and movement speed · Ranged weapons fire a powerful mini swarmer every 3 seconds · Reduces damage taken from Dragonfire

accessories.name: Blood Pact
accessories.effect: When equipped, it increases the player's maximum health by 25%, grants immunity to the Bleeding, Burning Blood & Heavy Bleeding debuffs, and increases the amount of health restored from drinking healing potions by 33%.

accessories.name: The Community
accessories.effect: When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

accessories.name: Quiver of Nihility
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: While equipped, it grants +5% ranged critical strike chance. It also summons four void fields that orbit around the player.

buffs.name: Supreme Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: It is also dropped from Providence, the Profaned Goddess, Ceaseless Void, Storm Weaver, Signus, Polterghast, and The Old Duke.

buffs.name: Candles
buffs.effect: Emit light.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.source: Placed station buff
buffs.why: Endgame ranger still wants free ammo efficiency before every serious fight.
buffs.effect: It can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 10 GC in Hardmode.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Ammo consumption adds up quickly on the strongest guns, so this stretches your best supplies further.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff reduces the chance of consuming any ammunition by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage of arrow -firing weapons by 10%, as well as the velocity of arrows by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

ammo.name: Bloodfire Bullet
ammo.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
ammo.effect: They can pass through tiles and accelerate the player's natural life regeneration rate by 3 on enemy hits. Additionally, their damage is increased by the player's current life regeneration, which calculates when the enemy gets hit up to a maximum of 1.1x increased flat damage.

ammo.name: Holy Fire Bullet
ammo.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
ammo.effect: They deal up to 15% increased damage based on how close it is to the player, as well as explode upon collision with any enemy or tile, creating explosions which deal 33% of the bullet's damage and inflicting the Holy Flames debuff. Explosions shrink the longer the bullet has remained in the air, reducing down to half size after 0.27 seconds, and cannot hit enemies the bullet has hit.

ammo.name: Luminite Bullet
ammo.why: The highest base damage of any bullet.
ammo.effect: The Luminite Bullet can hit an infinite number of targets. The damage of the Luminite Bullet decreases by 4% each time it hits a target.

ammo.name: Mini Nuke I
ammo.effect: Unlike the Mini Nuke II, it does not destroy tiles. It is a direct upgrade to the Rocket III, dealing more damage over a larger blast radius, but with lower knockback.

ammo.name: Wooden Arrow
ammo.source: Sold by the Merchant, or dropped by Skeletons and Zombies
ammo.effect: It has no special properties and is used for crafting a variety of more advanced ammunition. When fired with certain bows, Wooden Arrows will be converted into a special projectile (e.g. the Molten Fury converting them into Flaming Arrows).

items.name: Elysian Wings
items.source: Dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess
items.why: This is faster than the other wings.
items.effect: When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Tarragon Wings
items.effect: While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Void Striders
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 36% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Ludicrous speed!'

items.name: Ascendant Insignia
items.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown

items.name: Elysian Aegis
items.source: Dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to dash, empowered by holy fire · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage · 'Blessed by the Profaned Flame'

items.name: Statis' Ninja Belt
items.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 10% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.6x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws

items.name: Leviathan Ambergris
items.source: Dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita
items.effect: 100% increased initial dash velocity, 33% faster dash cooldown, and greatly increased dash deceleration · Your dashes are empowered by water, knocking back and damaging enemies with vicious currents · Visual effects are reduced if visibility is disabled

items.name: Affliction
items.source: Dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode
items.effect: While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

items.name: The Community
items.effect: When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

items.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
items.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled

items.name: Deific Amulet
items.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Daawnlight Spirit Origin
items.effect: All ranged weapons can supercrit when critical strike chance is over 100% · Marks enemies and bosses with bullseyes which boost critical strike chance when hit · Extra critical strike chance quickly fades over time · Summons a heroic spirit from another world if visibility is on or in vanity slots · 'A strand of a lost cosmos remains, waiting for its master'

items.name: Quiver of Nihility
items.why: This is difficult to use and should be used with Monsoon
items.effect: While equipped, it grants +5% ranged critical strike chance. It also summons four void fields that orbit around the player.

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Recon Scope
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance · Enemies are less likely to target you · 'Enemy spotted'

items.name: Sniper Scope
items.why: 10% ranged damage and crit, and zooms out when you right-click with a gun.
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance

tools.name: Claret Cannon
tools.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
tools.effect: It fires a small claret round that explodes into 20 small floating blood orbs upon hitting an enemy. When collected by the player, each orb reduces the duration of the Potion Sickness debuff by 0.33 seconds.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

tools.name: Stratus Sphere
tools.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires a massive planetary stratus orb that can pass through tiles.

weapons.name: Dark Spark
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it initially fires a single black beam of light that splits into six different beams as it charges. Over 6 seconds, these beams will change to white and, after another 4 seconds, various colors.

weapons.name: Phantasmal Fury
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a swirling vortex of souls around the player. While swirling around the player, souls deal 30% base damage but have twice as much knockback.

weapons.name: Shadowbolt Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a shadowbolt that can pass through tiles. After traveling far enough or hitting an enemy, the shadowbolt creates a platform that it rebounds off of after a delay.

weapons.name: Venusian Trident
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it fires an infernal trident that causes a very large explosion upon hitting a tile or an enemy, releasing four to nine flaming shards that fall to the floor and deal 2% of the weapon's damage. The tridents, explosions, and flaming shards inflict the Daybroken debuff, and always critically strike.

weapons.name: Vitriolic Viper
weapons.effect: When used, it charges up to fire a spread of radioactive beams that inflict the Irradiated debuff, whose spread gets tighter the longer it is charged. After 1 second to fully charge, it instead fires a large spread of 33 short-range fangs that inflict the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff.

items.name: Arcane Flower
items.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Enemies are less likely to target you

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace

items.name: Sigil of Calamitas
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 60 · 15% increased magic damage · Increases pickup range for mana stars

tools.name: Claret Cannon
tools.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
tools.effect: It fires a small claret round that explodes into 20 small floating blood orbs upon hitting an enemy. When collected by the player, each orb reduces the duration of the Potion Sickness debuff by 0.33 seconds.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

tools.name: Stratus Sphere
tools.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires a massive planetary stratus orb that can pass through tiles.

weapons.name: Dragonblood Disgorger
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a large skeleton dragon minion accompanied by her two children. The main dragon wanders around and breathes bloodfire at nearby enemies which inflict the Burning Blood debuff on enemy hits, while the children violently charge at enemies and spit blood shots that spawn blood orbs which reduce the Potion Sickness cooldown by 0.2 seconds.

weapons.name: Ethereal Subjugator
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a Phantom minion that follows the player and attacks enemies by releasing 3 ghastly particles that home in on the closest enemy after a short time.

weapons.name: King of Constellations, Tenryū
weapons.effect: It consumes four minion slots to summon two Celestial Dragons which follow the player. Each dragon contains 22 segments with 20 body segments.

weapons.name: Mutated Truffle
weapons.effect: It summons a Baby Boomer minion that cycles between through three attacks, starting out by charging rapidly at enemies, shooting tooth balls which explode into homing teeth projectiles after 2 seconds, and then spinning around while summoning a large vortex that slowly chase enemies to deal damage. The minion deals 125% base damage while charging at enemies.

weapons.name: Virid Vanguard
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it alternates between summoning giant axes and blades that orbit around the player, inflicting Sage Poison which deals 50 damage per second, per summoned Virid Vanguard. Using it again with full minion slots can activate a special attack.

weapons.name: Cadaverous Carrion
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a grounded Old Duke head sentry that rapidly fires homing sulphurous sharks at nearby enemies which inflicts the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff.

weapons.name: Lunar Portal Staff
weapons.why: Post-Moon Lord sentry summoning a floating portal that fires sweeping piercing beams.
weapons.effect: It continuously fires beams that sweep across enemies, which pierce infinite enemies but cannot pass through blocks. Unlike most sentries, the Lunar Portal floats midair.

weapons.name: Sanctified Spark
weapons.effect: When used, it summons an Impious Immolator sentry that slowly follows the player and rapidly fires flame bursts at the nearest enemy which inflicts the Holy Flames debuff. It will briefly pause between attacks, during which it will fire one healing orb that heals 5 health each for every 4 minion slots the player has.

weapons.name: Kaleidoscope
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light (summoned after Plantera)
weapons.why: Empress of Light drop giving one of the largest summon tag damage bonuses.
weapons.effect: 20 summon tag damage · 10% summon tag critical strike chance · Your summons will focus struck enemies

weapons.effect: It throws a rapid stratus spear that breaks upon hitting a tile and explodes upon striking an enemy, releasing 4 stratus stars that inflict Nightwither. These stars can pierce for a short amount of time and the explosion from the spear will not be triggered if the spear doesn't strike an enemy.

weapons.name: Twisting Thunder
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: It automatically throws a gravity-defying lightning bolt that does not pierce and travels faster while raining. When it hits an enemy, lightning strikes vertically from the sky which pierces indefinitely and can pass through tiles.

buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.

buffs.station: Alchemy Table

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

ammo.name: Bloodfire Bullet

ammo.name: Holy Fire Bullet
ammo.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
ammo.effect: They deal up to 15% increased damage based on how close it is to the player, as well as explode upon collision with any enemy or tile, creating explosions which deal 33% of the bullet's damage and inflicting the Holy Flames debuff. ammo.name: Mini Nuke I

ammo.name: Venom Arrow

ammo.effect: It has the highest base damage of all arrows and inflicts the Acid Venom debuff for 10 seconds upon hitting enemies.

items.name: Silva Wings
items.effect: While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Void Striders
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 36% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Ludicrous speed!'

items.name: Ascendant Insignia
items.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown

items.name: Asgardian Aegis
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash, empowered by a cosmic inferno · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

items.name: Statis' Void Sash
items.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 20% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.85x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws

items.name: Affliction
items.source: Dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode
items.effect: While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

items.name: Dark Sun Ring
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased damage · +0.5 HP/s life regen and +2 max minions · Increased minion knockback · Grants various buffs as the day goes on · 'Contains the power of the dark sun'

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

items.name: The Amalgam
items.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert

items.name: The Community
items.effect: When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

items.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
items.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled

items.name: Bloom Stone
items.why: This should be used with Chalice of the Blood God
items.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'

items.name: Chalice of the Blood God
items.why: This should be used with Bloom Stone
items.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'

items.name: Deific Amulet
items.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

items.name: The Sponge
items.effect: After eight seconds of equipping the item without taking damage, a barrier covers its user, which grants 10% damage reduction. As the barrier is formed, it builds up to 120 shield durability at a rate of 12 durability per second.

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Ethereal Talisman
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 60 and 8% reduced mana cost · 15% increased magic damage and 5% increased magic critical strike chance · Increases pickup range for mana stars · You automatically use mana potions when needed · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate in your inventory to toggle Mana Flower's effect

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Sigil of Calamitas
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 60 · 15% increased magic damage · Increases pickup range for mana stars

tools.name: Claret Cannon
tools.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
tools.effect: It fires a small claret round that explodes into 20 small floating blood orbs upon hitting an enemy. When collected by the player, each orb reduces the duration of the Potion Sickness debuff by 0.33 seconds.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

tools.name: Stratus Sphere
tools.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires a massive planetary stratus orb that can pass through tiles.

weapons.name: Corvid Harbinger Staff
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a dark raven minion that flies around and rapidly charges towards enemies, occasionally teleporting near them and leaving a ring of dust before continuing its charge.

weapons.name: Ethereal Subjugator
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a Phantom minion that follows the player and attacks enemies by releasing 3 ghastly particles that home in on the closest enemy after a short time.

weapons.name: Mirror of Kalandra
weapons.effect: When used, it summons the following weapons respectively: Atziri's Disfavor, Starforge, Paradoxica, Wind Ripper, and Hope Shredder. Only 1 of each weapon can be summoned at a time, each taking up 1 minion slot.

weapons.name: Sirius
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a star which hovers over the player and fires homing fireballs at enemies.

weapons.name: Void Eater Marionette
weapons.source: Dropped by The Devourer of Gods
weapons.effect: Upon use, it summons a flying mechanical worm that charges, fires lasers, teleports onto enemies to inflict them with the God Slayer Inferno debuff and ignores immunity frames. The mechworm is in constant flight and can travel through tiles.

weapons.name: Cadaverous Carrion
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a grounded Old Duke head sentry that rapidly fires homing sulphurous sharks at nearby enemies which inflicts the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff.

weapons.name: Sanctified Spark
weapons.effect: When used, it summons an Impious Immolator sentry that slowly follows the player and rapidly fires flame bursts at the nearest enemy which inflicts the Holy Flames debuff. It will briefly pause between attacks, during which it will fire one healing orb that heals 5 health each for every 4 minion slots the player has.

weapons.name: Kaleidoscope
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light (summoned after Plantera)
weapons.why: Empress of Light drop giving one of the largest summon tag damage bonuses.
weapons.effect: 20 summon tag damage · 10% summon tag critical strike chance · Your summons will focus struck enemies

armor.name: Fearmonger armor
armor.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 2 · Minions no longer deal less damage while wielding non-summoner weapons · Immunity to all but the strongest forms of frost and flame · Minion attacks grant +2.5 HP/s life regen and massively accelerate life regen
armor.desc: Fearmonger armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set and the direct upgrade to the Spooky armor. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura and a motion blur afterimage while moving.

armor.name: Silva armor
armor.effect: +3 HP/s life regen · 5% increased max run speed and acceleration · Taking fatal damage will revive you and make you invulnerable to all damage for 5 seconds · This effect has a 5 minute cooldown, which does not decrement if any bosses or events are active
armor.desc: The Silva armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. It is the mage/summoner counterpart to God Slayer armor. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.
armor.headpieceBonus: Increases your max number of minions by 3 · 40% increased summon damage · Summons an ancient leaf prism to blast your enemies with life energy

items.name: Seraph Tracers
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.17 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 50% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava and damaging tiles, including Auric Ore · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Taking speed EVEN FURTHER BEYOND!'

items.name: Wings of Rebirth
items.source: Dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth
items.effect: When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Ascendant Insignia
items.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown

items.name: Asgardian Aegis
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash, empowered by a cosmic inferno · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

items.name: Statis' Void Sash
items.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 20% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.85x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws

items.name: Affliction
items.source: Dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode
items.effect: While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

items.name: Dark Sun Ring
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased damage · +0.5 HP/s life regen and +2 max minions · Increased minion knockback · Grants various buffs as the day goes on · 'Contains the power of the dark sun'

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

items.name: The Amalgam
items.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert

items.name: The Community
items.effect: When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

items.name: Chalice of the Blood God
items.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'

items.name: Radiance
items.effect: +1 to +4 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Reduces damage over time taken by 10 HP/s and jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit shining blue light if visibility is enabled · 'A once putrid crystal, now glimmering with immaculate purity'

items.name: Rampart of Deities
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Releases a blast of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health or taking high damage attacks · Reduces damage taken by 25% when below 50% life · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when you are above 25% life · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

items.name: The Sponge
items.effect: After eight seconds of equipping the item without taking damage, a barrier covers its user, which grants 10% damage reduction. As the barrier is formed, it builds up to 120 shield durability at a rate of 12 durability per second.

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Badge of Bravery
items.effect: When equipped, it increases melee damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and armor penetration by 5.

items.name: Elemental Gauntlet
items.effect: Melee attacks and projectiles inflict Elemental Mix · 15% increased melee damage and melee speed · 5% increased melee critical strike chance · 20% increased true melee damage and increased melee knockback · Enables auto swing for melee weapons and increases their size · Does not stack with downgrades

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Ace's High
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a line of four playing cards in the order of a heart, club, diamond, and spade, with a mild delay between each set. Each of the cards has varying effects.

weapons.name: Chicken Cannon
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly fires chicken rockets that bounce straight up when hitting the ground before causing a gigantic explosion after a short delay, inflicting the Dragonfire debuff. The explosion lingers for a few seconds and ignores immunity frames.

weapons.name: Dragon's Breath
weapons.effect: It uses Gel for ammunition, with an 80% chance to not consume ammo. When used, it fires a stream of fireballs that pierce infinitely but lose 5% damage per hit.

weapons.name: Starmada
weapons.effect: These attacks can be used independently. Timing these attacks together increases damage and reduces the spread of star shots, while boosting the number of star shots fired.

weapons.name: Tyranny's End
weapons.effect: When used with its primary fire (⚒ Use / Attack), it converts Musket Balls into high-velocity bullets, which inflict the Marked for Death debuff on hit and ignore enemy defense if it is less than 1,000. If the main shot critically strikes, six bullets will appear from the sides of the target and will be fired towards it, each dealing 17.5% of the weapon's damage.

armor.name: Auric Tesla armor
armor.effect: Inherited Universal Set Bonuses: Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · Increased heart pickup range · Enemies have a chance to drop extra hearts on death · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · Enemies below 50% life drop a heart when struck · This effect has a 5 second cooldown · Inherited God Slayer Set Bonus (if applicable): · Press Dimensional Drive to Dimensional Drive towards your cursor for 1.25 seconds · Enemies you dash through take massive damage · During Dimensional Drive you are immune to damage and most debuff · Dimensional Drive has a 45 second cooldown · Inherited Silva Set Bonus (if applicable): · +3 HP/s life regen · 5% increased max run speed and acceleration · Taking fatal damage will revive you and make you invulnerable to all damage for 5 seconds · This effect has a 5 minute cooldown, which does not decrement if any bosses or events are active
armor.desc: The Auric Tesla armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is equipped, the player will emit afterimages and release a trail of golden sparkles while moving.
armor.headpieceBonus: Ranged Tarragon, Bloodflare and God Slayer armor effects · Hold Shift to view these set bonus details and press Shift repeatedly to cycle through them Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · Ranged projectiles spawn homing life energy and leaves on enemy hits · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · Armor Set Bonus to unleash the lost souls of polterghast to destroy your enemies · This effect has a 30 second cooldown · Ranged weapons fire bloodsplosion orbs every 2.5 seconds · Inherited God Slayer Set Bonus: · Ranged weapons fire a god killer shrapnel round every 2.5 seconds

items.effect: After eight seconds of equipping the item without taking damage, a barrier covers its user, which grants 10% damage reduction. As the barrier is formed, it builds up to 120 shield durability at a rate of 12 durability per second.

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Daawnlight Spirit Origin
items.effect: All ranged weapons can supercrit when critical strike chance is over 100% · Marks enemies and bosses with bullseyes which boost critical strike chance when hit · Extra critical strike chance quickly fades over time · Summons a heroic spirit from another world if visibility is on or in vanity slots · 'A strand of a lost cosmos remains, waiting for its master'

items.name: Planebreaker's Pouch
items.effect: 15% increased ranged damage, 7% increased ranged critical strike chance and 20% reduced ammo usage · Grants a 20% chance to not consume arrows · Pressing Ammo Cycle Hotkey will automatically swap the ammos in your ammo slots · The ammo type swapped depends on the ammo of the weapon you are holding

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Sniper Scope
items.why: 10% ranged damage and crit, and zooms out when you right-click with a gun.
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Aetherflux Cannon
weapons.effect: When used, it spins up for about 0.5 seconds before rapidly firing pairs of fast yellow lasers which travel in a double helix pattern. The lasers pierce twice and go through tiles.

weapons.name: Hyperdeath Rift Scepter
weapons.source: Dropped by The Devourer of Gods
weapons.effect: It fires down a large beam at the cursor's position to disintegrate nearly anything it is aimed at. The laser can pierce infinitely, losing small chunks of damage for every few enemies it pierces, and will phase through blocks.

weapons.name: Primordial Ancient
weapons.effect: When used, it fires 5 dust blows that pass through tiles and converge at the cursor into an explosion of dust that inflicts the Armor Crunch debuff. Using it at full health and with no Mana Sickness gives the player, and any player that touches the dust particles, the Aeolian Earth buff which increases damage reduction by 8%, damage by 15%, and mana regeneration.

weapons.name: Void Vortex
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a circular spread of 12 tile-ignoring electric orbs along with a larger orb in the center of the ring at the cursor's position that deals 400% of the weapon's damage. The outer orbs quickly converge into the larger orb and space out from each other upon collision, causing the larger orb to explode into 12 homing smaller orbs that deal 66% of the weapon's damage and can pass through tiles.

weapons.name: Yharim's Crystal
weapons.effect: When used, it fires six red and orange beams that converge into one yellow beam as it charges, dealing massive damage and inflicting the Dragonfire debuff on contact. Yharim's Crystal cannot deal any knockback.

armor.name: Auric Tesla armor
armor.effect: Inherited Universal Set Bonuses: Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · Increased heart pickup range · Enemies have a chance to drop extra hearts on death · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · Enemies below 50% life drop a heart when struck · This effect has a 5 second cooldown · Inherited God Slayer Set Bonus (if applicable): · Press Dimensional Drive to Dimensional Drive towards your cursor for 1.25 seconds · Enemies you dash through take massive damage · During Dimensional Drive you are immune to damage and most debuff · Dimensional Drive has a 45 second cooldown · Inherited Silva Set Bonus (if applicable): · +3 HP/s life regen · 5% increased max run speed and acceleration · Taking fatal damage will revive you and make you invulnerable to all damage for 5 seconds · This effect has a 5 minute cooldown, which does not decrement if any bosses or events are active
armor.desc: The Auric Tesla armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is equipped, the player will emit afterimages and release a trail of golden sparkles while moving.

accessories.name: Wings of Rebirth
accessories.effect: When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

accessories.name: Asgardian Aegis

accessories.name: Yharim's Gift
accessories.source: Dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Increases damage by 10% and movement speed by 20% · All attacks inflict Auric Rebuke · Flaming meteors rain down while invincible · 'The power to kill a god pulses from within this artifact'

buffs.name: Omega Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: It is also dropped from the Primordial Wyrm, The Devourer of Gods, each individual Exo Mech, Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth and Supreme Witch, Calamitas.

buffs.name: Supreme Mana Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it restores 400 mana and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff.

buffs.name: Candles
buffs.effect: Emit light.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Wizard
buffs.why: Free Clairvoyance remains a baseline endgame mage habit before any serious fight.
buffs.effect: It is purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC. Pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on a placed Crystal Ball grants the Clairvoyance buff and opens its crafting menu.

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases magic damage by 20%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the rate at which the player's mana regenerates. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

weapons.effect: When used, it summons a grounded Old Duke head sentry that rapidly fires homing sulphurous sharks at nearby enemies which inflicts the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff.

weapons.name: Sanctified Spark
weapons.effect: When used, it summons an Impious Immolator sentry that slowly follows the player and rapidly fires flame bursts at the nearest enemy which inflicts the Holy Flames debuff. items.name: Eclipse Mirror
items.effect: +10 maximum stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance · Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss · Stealth generates 25% faster when standing still and is boosted while moving if not attacking · Stealth strikes only expend 50% of your max stealth · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a burst of highly damaging darksun light · 'Its reflection shows naught but darkness'

items.name: Nanotech
items.effect: Rogue projectiles create nanoblades as they travel · Stealth strikes summon nanobeams and sparks on enemy hits · Stealth strikes have lifesteal, +15 armor penetration, deal 5% more damage · 15% increased rogue damage and 15% increased rogue velocity · Stealth strikes grant lifesteal and 10% critical strike chance to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Glove of Precision
items.source: Purchased from the Bandit for 48 gold after Plantera has been defeated
items.effect: Decreases rogue attack speed by 15% · Increases rogue damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and velocity by 15%

items.name: Spectral Veil
items.why: This is difficult and risky to use.
items.effect: While equipped, it makes stealth generate 15% faster.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Draconic Destruction
weapons.effect: When swung, it fires a high-velocity sword beam that pierces infinitely, passes through tiles, and splits into 8 more sword beams in a circular formation on enemy hits. The split beams move out for a quick moment before erratically flying up and down constantly while spacing away from each other as they travel before dissipating.

weapons.name: Earth
weapons.effect: When used, the sword is rapidly swung in a circular motion around the player, leaving behind a rainbow trail, before swinging towards the cursor with a larger slash. The larger slash spawns 3 rainbow gaia meteors from the sky that deal 120% base damage and explode on hit, dealing an additional 75% base damage.

weapons.name: Illustrious Knives
weapons.effect: When used, the weapon launches a spread of 4-8 slow moving green knives, similar to the Vampire Knives. The knives are destroyed upon contact with tiles but will rapidly accelerate and home in on nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Ozzathoth
weapons.effect: While deployed, it constantly fires roughly-stationary cosmic orbs. The cosmic orbs do not pass through tiles, and they deal 40% of the weapon's damage and have an innate 100 armor penetration.

weapons.name: Red Sun
weapons.effect: When it is swung, a large number of solar flares fall from the sky at varying speeds and angles. The flares explode after some time or upon hitting an enemy, releasing multiple homing fragments when they do.

weapons.name: Triactis' True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of Might
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a heavy, gravity-affected hammer that will return to the player after striking an enemy. Every hit of the hammer spawns a prismatic light flare which orbits around the struck enemy.

armor.name: Auric Tesla armor
armor.effect: Inherited Universal Set Bonuses: Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · Increased heart pickup range · Enemies have a chance to drop extra hearts on death · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · Enemies below 50% life drop a heart when struck · This effect has a 5 second cooldown · Inherited God Slayer Set Bonus (if applicable): · Press Dimensional Drive to Dimensional Drive towards your cursor for 1.25 seconds · Enemies you dash through take massive damage · During Dimensional Drive you are immune to damage and most debuff · Dimensional Drive has a 45 second cooldown · Inherited Silva Set Bonus (if applicable): · +3 HP/s life regen · 5% increased max run speed and acceleration · Taking fatal damage will revive you and make you invulnerable to all damage for 5 seconds · This effect has a 5 minute cooldown, which does not decrement if any bosses or events are active
armor.desc: The Auric Tesla armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is equipped, the player will emit afterimages and release a trail of golden sparkles while moving.
armor.headpieceBonus: Enemies are more likely to target you · Melee Tarragon, Bloodflare and God Slayer effects · Hold Shift to view these set bonus details and press Shift repeatedly to cycle through them Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · Taking damage gives Tarra Life, which gives +1.5 HP/s life regen · Armor Set Bonus to cloak yourself in life energy that heavily reduces enemy contact damage for 10 seconds · This has a 30 second cooldown · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · After striking an enemy 15 times with true melee you will enter a blood frenzy for 5 seconds · During this you will gain 25% increased melee damage, critical strike chance, and 50% reduced contact damage · This effect has a 30 second cooldown · Inherited God Slayer Set Bonus: · Releases a swarm of god killer darts when taking over 80 damage in one hit

armor.name: Gem Tech armor
armor.effect: Power Gems - Six gem fragments idly orbit you; one for each class, and a base gem · Each active gem provides a bonus for its respective class, while the defensive gem grants defensive boosts · Powerful enemy hits will dislodge gems, launching them into the nearest enemy for huge damage · Losts gems regenerate after a while · The lost gem is the same class as the weapon you are using, so better prepare for some weapon switching action! · Hold Shift to see an expanded description A gem is lost when you take more than 100 damage in a single hit · The type of game lost is the same as the class of the most recently used weapon · If said gem has already been lost, the base gem is lost instead · When a gem is lost, it breaks off and homes towards the nearest enemy or boss, dealing a base of 40000 damage · Gems have a 30 second delay before they appear again · The red gem grants 130 maximum stealth, increased rogue stats, and makes stealth only consumable by rogue weapons · The yellow gem provides increased melee stats and makes melee attacks release shards on hit with a cooldown. This cooldown is shorter for true melee attacks · The green gem provides increased ranged stats and causes flechettes to fly swiftly towards targets when they are damaged by a ranged projectile · The blue gem grants 4 maximum minions, increased summon damage, and negates the summon damage penalty while wielding non-summoner weapons · The violet gem grants 100 maximum mana, increased magic stats, and makes mana rapidly regenerate when holding a non-magic weapon · The pink base gem grants 75 defense, increased damage reduction, movement speed, jump speed, and +1 HP/s life regen · When all gems exist simultaneously, hitting a target with any weapon grants you +1 HP/s life regen for 8 seconds · This is increased to +1.5 HP/s life regen if a weapon of another class is used during that 8 second period for 2.5 seconds
armor.desc: Gem Tech armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set.

accessories.name: Seraph Tracers
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.17 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 50% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava and damaging tiles, including Auric Ore · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Taking speed EVEN FURTHER BEYOND!'

accessories.name: Wings of Rebirth
accessories.effect: When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

accessories.name: Rampart of Deities
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Releases a blast of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health or taking high damage attacks · Reduces damage taken by 25% when below 50% life · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when you are above 25% life · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

accessories.name: Radiance
accessories.effect: +1 to +4 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Reduces damage over time taken by 10 HP/s and jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit shining blue light if visibility is enabled · 'A once putrid crystal, now glimmering with immaculate purity'

accessories.name: Asgardian Aegis
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash, empowered by a cosmic inferno · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

accessories.name: Statis' Void Sash
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 20% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.85x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws

accessories.name: Elemental Gauntlet
accessories.effect: Melee attacks and projectiles inflict Elemental Mix · 15% increased melee damage and melee speed · 5% increased melee critical strike chance · 20% increased true melee damage and increased melee knockback · Enables auto swing for melee weapons and increases their size · Does not stack with downgrades

accessories.name: Chalice of the Blood God
accessories.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'

accessories.name: Draedon's Heart
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 15% reduced contact damage from enemies · Replaces Adrenaline with the Nanomachines meter · Unlike Adrenaline, you lose no Nanomachines when you take damage, but they stop accumulating for 1 second · With full Nanomachines, press Adrenaline Mode to heal 180 health over 2 seconds · While healing you take [DR]% less damage · 'Nanomachines, son'

accessories.name: Shattered Community
accessories.effect: Increases damage, max health, and movement speed by 10% · Increases defense by 10, and life regen by 1 HP/s · Increases critical strike chance and damage reduction by 5%, and flight time by 20% · You generate rage over time and rage does not fade out of combat · Gain rage after taking damage regardless of defensive stats · While Rage Mode is active, taking damage gives only half as much rage · Deal damage with Rage Mode to further empower your wrath · Current level: [LEVEL] (+[BOOST]% Rage Mode damage) · Progress to next level: [PROGRESS RATIO]% · Total Rage Mode damage: [CUMULATIVE DAMAGE DEALT]

buffs.name: Omega Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: It is also dropped from the Primordial Wyrm, The Devourer of Gods, each individual Exo Mech, Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth and Supreme Witch, Calamitas.

buffs.name: Candles
buffs.effect: Emit light.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Flask of Crumbling
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Crumbling buff, which causes all melee, whip, and rogue attacks to inflict the Crumbling debuff.

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Sharpening Station
buffs.source: Found in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle
buffs.why: The armor penetration bonus is one of the best class-specific pre-Hardmode melee boosts.
buffs.effect: In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Merchant for 10 GC.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased damage · +0.5 HP/s life regen and +2 max minions · Increased minion knockback · Grants various buffs as the day goes on · 'Contains the power of the dark sun'

weapons.effect: When used, it fires out between 25 and 35 bullets per shot that slowly spread out, while only consuming one unit of ammo.

weapons.effect: When used, it very rapidly fires bullets in a small spread. It also converts Musket Balls into high-damage High Velocity Bullets which have 4 additional base damage.

weapons.name: Svantechnical
weapons.effect: When used, it fires three streams of charged energy bolts in a sine-wave pattern. Each bolt splits off into 2 small bolts in a wide backwards spread upon hitting an enemy or tile, before turning around after travelling a small distance.

weapons.name: Voidragon
weapons.effect: When used, it loads a magazine of 50 shots, then alternates between firing bullets and concentrated void blasts that inflict the Whispering Death debuff.
