ammo.name: Vanquisher Arrow
ammo.effect: They appear as pink or magenta colors, can pass through tiles and aggressively seek the closest target within 4 tiles of range, inflicting the God Slayer Inferno debuff. They can pierce once, dealing 40% on the initial hit and full damage on the second hit.

items.name: Shattered Community

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Sniper Scope
items.why: 10% ranged damage and crit, and zooms out when you right-click with a gun.
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. tools.name: Rod of Harmony
tools.effect: It is the direct upgrade to the Rod of Discord, instantly teleporting the player to the location of the cursor when used, but without inflicting the Chaos State debuff.

weapons.name: Apotheosis
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a cosmic portal that releases a mini Devourer of Gods that swarms enemies and fires lasers at them, before disappearing 5 seconds later. The mini-Devourer of Gods inflicts God Slayer Inferno and Whispering Death.

weapons.name: Eternity
weapons.effect: When used, it will create a large circle, which inside will have five crystals, a beam, and a group of projectiles that create a flower shape while traveling, all of which will be centered around a nearby enemy. The beam will travel in an infinity shape.

weapons.name: Rainbow Party Cannon
weapons.effect: When used, a cannon appears locked to the player's location, pointing either left or right towards the direction of the cursor. It is unable to change direction until released.

weapons.name: Staff of Blushie
weapons.effect: Upon holding the ⚒ Use / Attack button with the weapon in hand, five blue gears will appear on the screen which are connected by a series of chains, and a row of blue fire appears some distance below.

weapons.name: Sylvestaff

weapons.name: The Dance of Light
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly summons four pairs of fast inaccurate light blades from a cone around the player towards the cursor's direction. Each pair of light blades will curve, converge, and home with each other and they pierce once and go through tiles.

armor.effect: Inherited Universal Set Bonuses: Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · Increased heart pickup range · Enemies have a chance to drop extra hearts on death · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · Enemies below 50% life drop a heart when struck · This effect has a 5 second cooldown · Inherited God Slayer Set Bonus (if applicable): · Press Dimensional Drive to Dimensional Drive towards your cursor for 1.25 seconds · Enemies you dash through take massive damage · During Dimensional Drive you are immune to damage and most debuff · Dimensional Drive has a 45 second cooldown · Inherited Silva Set Bonus (if applicable): · +3 HP/s life regen · 5% increased max run speed and acceleration · Taking fatal damage will revive you and make you invulnerable to all damage for 5 seconds · This effect has a 5 minute cooldown, which does not decrement if any bosses or events are active
armor.desc: The Auric Tesla armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is equipped, the player will emit afterimages and release a trail of golden sparkles while moving.
armor.headpieceBonus: Magic Tarragon, Bloodflare and Silva armor effects · Hold Shift to view these set bonus details and press Shift repeatedly to cycle through them Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · On every 5th critical strike you will fire a leaf storm · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · Magic weapons fire ghostly bolts every 1.67 seconds · Magic critical strikes cause blood explosions every 2 seconds · Inherited Silva Set Bonus: · Magic projectiles which cannot pierce will occasionally set off potent blasts of nature energy

armor.name: Gem Tech armor
armor.effect: Power Gems - Six gem fragments idly orbit you; one for each class, and a base gem · Each active gem provides a bonus for its respective class, while the defensive gem grants defensive boosts · Powerful enemy hits will dislodge gems, launching them into the nearest enemy for huge damage · Losts gems regenerate after a while · The lost gem is the same class as the weapon you are using, so better prepare for some weapon switching action! · Hold Shift to see an expanded description A gem is lost when you take more than 100 damage in a single hit · The type of game lost is the same as the class of the most recently used weapon · If said gem has already been lost, the base gem is lost instead · When a gem is lost, it breaks off and homes towards the nearest enemy or boss, dealing a base of 40000 damage · Gems have a 30 second delay before they appear again · The red gem grants 130 maximum stealth, increased rogue stats, and makes stealth only consumable by rogue weapons · The yellow gem provides increased melee stats and makes melee attacks release shards on hit with a cooldown. This cooldown is shorter for true melee attacks · The green gem provides increased ranged stats and causes flechettes to fly swiftly towards targets when they are damaged by a ranged projectile · The blue gem grants 4 maximum minions, increased summon damage, and negates the summon damage penalty while wielding non-summoner weapons · The violet gem grants 100 maximum mana, increased magic stats, and makes mana rapidly regenerate when holding a non-magic weapon · The pink base gem grants 75 defense, increased damage reduction, movement speed, jump speed, and +1 HP/s life regen · When all gems exist simultaneously, hitting a target with any weapon grants you +1 HP/s life regen for 8 seconds · This is increased to +1.5 HP/s life regen if a weapon of another class is used during that 8 second period for 2.5 seconds
armor.desc: Gem Tech armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set.

items.effect: When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

items.name: Chalice of the Blood God
items.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'

items.name: Radiance
items.effect: +1 to +4 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Reduces damage over time taken by 10 HP/s and jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit shining blue light if visibility is enabled · 'A once putrid crystal, now glimmering with immaculate purity'

items.name: Rampart of Deities
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Releases a blast of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health or taking high damage attacks · Reduces damage taken by 25% when below 50% life · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when you are above 25% life · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

items.name: The Sponge
items.effect: After eight seconds of equipping the item without taking damage, a barrier covers its user, which grants 10% damage reduction. As the barrier is formed, it builds up to 120 shield durability at a rate of 12 durability per second.

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Daawnlight Spirit Origin
items.effect: All ranged weapons can supercrit when critical strike chance is over 100% · Marks enemies and bosses with bullseyes which boost critical strike chance when hit · Extra critical strike chance quickly fades over time · Summons a heroic spirit from another world if visibility is on or in vanity slots · 'A strand of a lost cosmos remains, waiting for its master'

items.name: Planebreaker's Pouch
items.effect: 15% increased ranged damage, 7% increased ranged critical strike chance and 20% reduced ammo usage · Grants a 20% chance to not consume arrows · Pressing Ammo Cycle Hotkey will automatically swap the ammos in your ammo slots · The ammo type swapped depends on the ammo of the weapon you are holding

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Sniper Scope
items.why: 10% ranged damage and crit, and zooms out when you right-click with a gun.
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance

items.name: Calamity
items.effect: When equipped, a flaming aura spawns at the player's cursor. While an enemy is within range, the aura glows and continuously deals 320 damage at a rate of 12 hits per second, inflicting the Vulnerability Hex debuff.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Vehemence
weapons.effect: It fires a high-velocity hellish bolt that explodes into 18 skull clouds upon contact with enemies or tiles which deal 11% of the weapon 's damage.

weapons.name: Aetherflux Cannon
weapons.effect: When used, it spins up for about 0.5 seconds before rapidly firing pairs of fast yellow lasers which travel in a double helix pattern. The lasers pierce twice and go through tiles.

weapons.name: Hyperdeath Rift Scepter
weapons.source: Dropped by The Devourer of Gods
weapons.effect: It fires down a large beam at the cursor's position to disintegrate nearly anything it is aimed at. The laser can pierce infinitely, losing small chunks of damage for every few enemies it pierces, and will phase through blocks.

weapons.name: Primordial Ancient
weapons.effect: When used, it fires 5 dust blows that pass through tiles and converge at the cursor into an explosion of dust that inflicts the Armor Crunch debuff. Using it at full health and with no Mana Sickness gives the player, and any player that touches the dust particles, the Aeolian Earth buff which increases damage reduction by 8%, damage by 15%, and mana regeneration.

weapons.name: Void Vortex
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a circular spread of 12 tile-ignoring electric orbs along with a larger orb in the center of the ring at the cursor's position that deals 400% of the weapon's damage. The outer orbs quickly converge into the larger orb and space out from each other upon collision, causing the larger orb to explode into 12 homing smaller orbs that deal 66% of the weapon's damage and can pass through tiles.

weapons.name: Yharim's Crystal
weapons.effect: When used, it fires six red and orange beams that converge into one yellow beam as it charges, dealing massive damage and inflicting the Dragonfire debuff on contact. Yharim's Crystal cannot deal any knockback.

armor.name: Auric Tesla armor

accessories.name: Wings of Rebirth
accessories.effect: When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: It is also dropped from the Primordial Wyrm, The Devourer of Gods, each individual Exo Mech, Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth and Supreme Witch, Calamitas.

buffs.name: Supreme Mana Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it restores 400 mana and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff.

buffs.name: Candles
buffs.effect: Emit light.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Wizard
buffs.why: Free Clairvoyance remains a baseline endgame mage habit before any serious fight.
buffs.effect: It is purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC. Pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on a placed Crystal Ball grants the Clairvoyance buff and opens its crafting menu.

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases magic damage by 20%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the rate at which the player's mana regenerates. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Oblatory
buffs.effect: Enchanting is a game mechanic unlocked after defeating Supreme Witch, Calamitas, which allows the player to apply enchantments to their items, granting them unique additional qualities. It changes the name of an item by adding a prefix to the item's name (before any modifier the item may have), such as "Aflame Strong Photon Ripper." Hovering the cursor over an item with an enchantment in an inventory slot will show the enchantment details beneath the item's description. This description is colored #8B0000.

weapons.name: Sanctified Spark
weapons.effect: When used, it summons an Impious Immolator sentry that slowly follows the player and rapidly fires flame bursts at the nearest enemy which inflicts the Holy Flames debuff. buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Dungeon
buffs.why: A free extra minion remains part of every serious endgame summoner setup.

buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station

buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Crumbling buff, which causes all melee, whip, and rogue attacks to inflict the Crumbling debuff.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The extra minion slot is too valuable to skip, even in the earliest summoner boss prep.

buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum number of minions by 1. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: War Table
buffs.source: Dropped by the Dark Mage and Ogre during the Old One's Army
buffs.why: Table buff that boosts minion damage.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.

weapons.name: Wrathwing
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a fiery javelin which homes in on enemies while releasing gravity-affected fireballs as it travels, which explode violently on contact. The javelin also inflicts the Dragonfire debuff.

weapons.name: The Old Reaper
weapons.effect: When fired, it throws a scythe which spawns unstable isotope projectiles on enemy hits that explode after a brief delay.

items.name: Wings of Rebirth
items.source: Dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth
items.effect: When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Ascendant Insignia
items.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown

items.name: Asgardian Aegis
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash, empowered by a cosmic inferno · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

items.name: Statis' Void Sash
items.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 20% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.85x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws

items.name: Affliction
items.source: Dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode
items.effect: While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

items.name: Dark Sun Ring
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased damage · +0.5 HP/s life regen and +2 max minions · Increased minion knockback · Grants various buffs as the day goes on · 'Contains the power of the dark sun'

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

items.name: The Amalgam
items.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert

items.name: The Community
items.effect: When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

items.name: Chalice of the Blood God
items.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'

items.name: Radiance
items.effect: +1 to +4 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Reduces damage over time taken by 10 HP/s and jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit shining blue light if visibility is enabled · 'A once putrid crystal, now glimmering with immaculate purity'

items.name: Rampart of Deities
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Releases a blast of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health or taking high damage attacks · Reduces damage taken by 25% when below 50% life · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when you are above 25% life · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

items.name: The Sponge
items.effect: After eight seconds of equipping the item without taking damage, a barrier covers its user, which grants 10% damage reduction. As the barrier is formed, it builds up to 120 shield durability at a rate of 12 durability per second.

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Eclipse Mirror
items.effect: +10 maximum stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance · Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss · Stealth generates 25% faster when standing still and is boosted while moving if not attacking · Stealth strikes only expend 50% of your max stealth · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a burst of highly damaging darksun light · 'Its reflection shows naught but darkness'

items.name: Nanotech
items.effect: Rogue projectiles create nanoblades as they travel · Stealth strikes summon nanobeams and sparks on enemy hits · Stealth strikes have lifesteal, +15 armor penetration, deal 5% more damage · 15% increased rogue damage and 15% increased rogue velocity · Stealth strikes grant lifesteal and 10% critical strike chance to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Glove of Precision
items.source: Purchased from the Bandit for 48 gold after Plantera has been defeated
items.effect: Decreases rogue attack speed by 15% · Increases rogue damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and velocity by 15%

items.name: Spectral Veil
items.why: This is difficult and risky to use.
items.effect: While equipped, it makes stealth generate 15% faster.

items.name: Calamity
items.effect: When equipped, a flaming aura spawns at the player's cursor. While an enemy is within range, the aura glows and continuously deals 320 damage at a rate of 12 hits per second, inflicting the Vulnerability Hex debuff.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Photon Ripper
weapons.source: Dropped by the Exo Mechs after XF-09 Ares has been defeated last
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly fires out rainbow teeth which circle back after passing through the cursor or past a set distance. The maximum set distance along with tooth damage increases as the weapon is used up to 3 seconds where it is fully charged.

weapons.name: Exoblade
weapons.effect: Press ⚒ Use / Attack to release multiple energy beams that home in on enemies and slice them on hit · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to dash in the direction of the cursor with the blade · Enemy hits from the blade during the dash result in massive damage and a rebound · Press ⚒ Use / Attack immediately after a rebound to perform a powerful slash · Powerful slashes are larger, heal you, and create a large explosion · Struck enemies are torn apart by Miracle Blight

weapons.name: Ark of the Cosmos
weapons.effect: Holding ⚒ Use / Attack (default: Left Click) performs a five-swing combo of a small upwards slash followed by a very wide circular one that shoots 6 homing eon bolts, repeating the last two swings once, and then following it up with a medium-ranged throw, where the ark will be sent out spinning, following the player's cursor for a maximum of 2.33 seconds, before coming back to them.

weapons.name: Dragon Pow
weapons.effect: It fires out a dragon head that releases red, orange, and yellow homing sparks that inflict Dragonfire on hit, and each spark will deal one-eighth of the initial swing. When fired, the roar of Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth can be heard.

weapons.name: Orderbringer
weapons.effect: When swung, it fires a large energy wave that slows down as it travels and pierces infinitely. 4 homing stars are also fired alongside the beam near the cursor that deal 12% base damage and pierce 3 times. Hitting an enemy with the sword rains down 2 beams from the sky toward the cursor that home in on nearby enemies, dealing 10% base damage but losing 20% damage per hit.

weapons.name: The Burning Sky
weapons.effect: When used, the player holds the weapon out similarly to a wand, and a stream of burning meteors rain down from the sky in the direction of the cursor. The meteors inflict melee damage and can travel through tiles but do not pierce enemies.

weapons.name: Zenith
weapons.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Rapidly fires homing sword-sprite projectiles on each swing; needs Moon Lord swords.
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly fires fast-moving sword sprites towards the cursor in an arc returning to the player. The sword sprites can pass through blocks, pierce enemies infinitely, home in on nearby enemies, and create visual trails while traveling.

armor.name: Auric Tesla armor
armor.effect: Inherited Universal Set Bonuses: Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · Increased heart pickup range · Enemies have a chance to drop extra hearts on death · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · Enemies below 50% life drop a heart when struck · This effect has a 5 second cooldown · Inherited God Slayer Set Bonus (if applicable): · Press Dimensional Drive to Dimensional Drive towards your cursor for 1.25 seconds · Enemies you dash through take massive damage · During Dimensional Drive you are immune to damage and most debuff · Dimensional Drive has a 45 second cooldown · Inherited Silva Set Bonus (if applicable): · +3 HP/s life regen · 5% increased max run speed and acceleration · Taking fatal damage will revive you and make you invulnerable to all damage for 5 seconds · This effect has a 5 minute cooldown, which does not decrement if any bosses or events are active
armor.desc: The Auric Tesla armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is equipped, the player will emit afterimages and release a trail of golden sparkles while moving.
armor.headpieceBonus: Enemies are more likely to target you · Melee Tarragon, Bloodflare and God Slayer effects · Hold Shift to view these set bonus details and press Shift repeatedly to cycle through them Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · Taking damage gives Tarra Life, which gives +1.5 HP/s life regen · Armor Set Bonus to cloak yourself in life energy that heavily reduces enemy contact damage for 10 seconds · This has a 30 second cooldown · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · After striking an enemy 15 times with true melee you will enter a blood frenzy for 5 seconds · During this you will gain 25% increased melee damage, critical strike chance, and 50% reduced contact damage · This effect has a 30 second cooldown · Inherited God Slayer Set Bonus: · Releases a swarm of god killer darts when taking over 80 damage in one hit

armor.name: Gem Tech armor
armor.effect: Power Gems - Six gem fragments idly orbit you; one for each class, and a base gem · Each active gem provides a bonus for its respective class, while the defensive gem grants defensive boosts · Powerful enemy hits will dislodge gems, launching them into the nearest enemy for huge damage · Losts gems regenerate after a while · The lost gem is the same class as the weapon you are using, so better prepare for some weapon switching action! · Hold Shift to see an expanded description A gem is lost when you take more than 100 damage in a single hit · The type of game lost is the same as the class of the most recently used weapon · If said gem has already been lost, the base gem is lost instead · When a gem is lost, it breaks off and homes towards the nearest enemy or boss, dealing a base of 40000 damage · Gems have a 30 second delay before they appear again · The red gem grants 130 maximum stealth, increased rogue stats, and makes stealth only consumable by rogue weapons · The yellow gem provides increased melee stats and makes melee attacks release shards on hit with a cooldown. This cooldown is shorter for true melee attacks · The green gem provides increased ranged stats and causes flechettes to fly swiftly towards targets when they are damaged by a ranged projectile · The blue gem grants 4 maximum minions, increased summon damage, and negates the summon damage penalty while wielding non-summoner weapons · The violet gem grants 100 maximum mana, increased magic stats, and makes mana rapidly regenerate when holding a non-magic weapon · The pink base gem grants 75 defense, increased damage reduction, movement speed, jump speed, and +1 HP/s life regen · When all gems exist simultaneously, hitting a target with any weapon grants you +1 HP/s life regen for 8 seconds · This is increased to +1.5 HP/s life regen if a weapon of another class is used during that 8 second period for 2.5 seconds
armor.desc: Gem Tech armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set.

buffs.effect: In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Merchant for 10 GC.

weapons.name: Ace's High
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a line of four playing cards in the order of a heart, club, diamond, and spade, with a mild delay between each set. Each of the cards has varying effects.

weapons.effect: It uses Gel for ammunition, with an 80% chance to not consume ammo. When used, it fires a stream of fireballs that pierce infinitely but lose 5% damage per hit.

weapons.name: Starmada
weapons.effect: These attacks can be used independently. Timing these attacks together increases damage and reduces the spread of star shots, while boosting the number of star shots fired.

buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.source: Placed station buff
buffs.why: Endgame ranger still wants free ammo efficiency before every serious fight.
buffs.effect: It can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 10 GC in Hardmode.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Ammo consumption adds up quickly on the strongest guns, so this stretches your best supplies further.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff reduces the chance of consuming any ammunition by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage of arrow -firing weapons by 10%, as well as the velocity of arrows by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

ammo.name: Endless Musket Pouch
ammo.why: An infinite stack of Musket Balls, so ammo never runs out.
ammo.effect: While in the inventory, it acts as an infinite source of Musket Balls.

ammo.name: Holy Fire Bullet
ammo.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
ammo.effect: They deal up to 15% increased damage based on how close it is to the player, as well as explode upon collision with any enemy or tile, creating explosions which deal 33% of the bullet's damage and inflicting the Holy Flames debuff. Explosions shrink the longer the bullet has remained in the air, reducing down to half size after 0.27 seconds, and cannot hit enemies the bullet has hit.

ammo.name: Mini Nuke I
ammo.effect: Unlike the Mini Nuke II, it does not destroy tiles. It is a direct upgrade to the Rocket III, dealing more damage over a larger blast radius, but with lower knockback.

tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Aetherflux Cannon
weapons.effect: When used, it spins up for about 0.5 seconds before rapidly firing pairs of fast yellow lasers which travel in a double helix pattern. The lasers pierce twice and go through tiles.

weapons.source: Dropped by The Devourer of Gods
weapons.effect: It fires down a large beam at the cursor's position to disintegrate nearly anything it is aimed at. The laser can pierce infinitely, losing small chunks of damage for every few enemies it pierces, and will phase through blocks.

weapons.name: Primordial Ancient
weapons.effect: When used, it fires 5 dust blows that pass through tiles and converge at the cursor into an explosion of dust that inflicts the Armor Crunch debuff. weapons.name: Void Vortex

weapons.name: Yharim's Crystal
weapons.effect: When used, it fires six red and orange beams that converge into one yellow beam as it charges, dealing massive damage and inflicting the Dragonfire debuff on contact. Yharim's Crystal cannot deal any knockback.

buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Wizard
buffs.why: Free Clairvoyance remains a baseline endgame mage habit before any serious fight.
buffs.effect: It is purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC. Pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on a placed Crystal Ball grants the Clairvoyance buff and opens its crafting menu.

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases magic damage by 20%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the rate at which the player's mana regenerates. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.effect: Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Seraph Tracers
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.17 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 50% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava and damaging tiles, including Auric Ore · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Taking speed EVEN FURTHER BEYOND!'

items.name: Wings of Rebirth
items.source: Dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth
items.effect: When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Ascendant Insignia
items.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown

items.name: Asgardian Aegis
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash, empowered by a cosmic inferno · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

items.name: Statis' Void Sash
items.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 20% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.85x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws

items.name: Affliction
items.source: Dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode
items.effect: While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

items.name: Dark Sun Ring
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased damage · +0.5 HP/s life regen and +2 max minions · Increased minion knockback · Grants various buffs as the day goes on · 'Contains the power of the dark sun'

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

items.name: The Amalgam
items.why: This should be used with Void Vortex
items.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert

items.name: The Community
items.effect: When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

items.name: Chalice of the Blood God
items.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'

items.name: Radiance
items.effect: +1 to +4 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Reduces damage over time taken by 10 HP/s and jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit shining blue light if visibility is enabled · 'A once putrid crystal, now glimmering with immaculate purity'

items.name: Rampart of Deities
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Releases a blast of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health or taking high damage attacks · Reduces damage taken by 25% when below 50% life · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when you are above 25% life · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

items.name: The Sponge
items.effect: After eight seconds of equipping the item without taking damage, a barrier covers its user, which grants 10% damage reduction. As the barrier is formed, it builds up to 120 shield durability at a rate of 12 durability per second.

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Ethereal Talisman
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 60 and 8% reduced mana cost · 15% increased magic damage and 5% increased magic critical strike chance · Increases pickup range for mana stars · You automatically use mana potions when needed · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate in your inventory to toggle Mana Flower's effect

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Sigil of Calamitas
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 60 · 15% increased magic damage · Increases pickup range for mana stars

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Cosmic Immaterializer
weapons.effect: When used, it summons an entity of cosmic energy that fires homing energy bolts and exploding stars at enemies. It requires 10 minion slots to summon 1 energy, and only 1 energy can be active at once.

weapons.name: Ares' Exoskeleton
weapons.source: Dropped by the Exo Mechs after XF-09 Ares has been defeated last
weapons.effect: When used, the player throws out a box which opens up a control panel. The control panel features four weapon choices on top and weapon slots on the bottom.

weapons.name: Lilies of Finality
weapons.source: Found in the Brimstone Crag after Yharon
weapons.effect: Upon use with two or more minion slots, it summons 2 minions at the cursor, Ariane and Elster. There can only be 1 of each character active at a time, each consuming 1 minion slot.

weapons.name: Midnight Sun Beacon
weapons.effect: When used, it throws out a Midnight Sun Beacon that summons a Midnight Sun UFO after a few seconds. The Midnight Sun UFO will track an enemy and fire small lasers towards them.

weapons.name: Mirror of Kalandra
weapons.effect: When used, it summons the following weapons respectively: Atziri's Disfavor, Starforge, Paradoxica, Wind Ripper, and Hope Shredder. Only 1 of each weapon can be summoned at a time, each taking up 1 minion slot.

weapons.name: Saros Possession
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a spinning solar aura that fires homing light orbs that can bounce between enemies and pierce twice. Repeated summons will increase the aura's damage and attack speed by 20% per minion slot used.

weapons.name: Cadaverous Carrion
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a grounded Old Duke head sentry that rapidly fires homing sulphurous sharks at nearby enemies which inflicts the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff.

weapons.name: Sanctified Spark
weapons.effect: When used, it summons an Impious Immolator sentry that slowly follows the player and rapidly fires flame bursts at the nearest enemy which inflicts the Holy Flames debuff. It will briefly pause between attacks, during which it will fire one healing orb that heals 5 health each for every 4 minion slots the player has.

weapons.name: Kaleidoscope
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light (summoned after Plantera)
weapons.why: Empress of Light drop giving one of the largest summon tag damage bonuses.
weapons.effect: 20 summon tag damage · 10% summon tag critical strike chance · Your summons will focus struck enemies

armor.name: Auric Tesla armor
armor.effect: Inherited Universal Set Bonuses: Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · Increased heart pickup range · Enemies have a chance to drop extra hearts on death · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · Enemies below 50% life drop a heart when struck · This effect has a 5 second cooldown · Inherited God Slayer Set Bonus (if applicable): · Press Dimensional Drive to Dimensional Drive towards your cursor for 1.25 seconds · Enemies you dash through take massive damage · During Dimensional Drive you are immune to damage and most debuff · Dimensional Drive has a 45 second cooldown · Inherited Silva Set Bonus (if applicable): · +3 HP/s life regen · 5% increased max run speed and acceleration · Taking fatal damage will revive you and make you invulnerable to all damage for 5 seconds · This effect has a 5 minute cooldown, which does not decrement if any bosses or events are active
armor.desc: The Auric Tesla armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is equipped, the player will emit afterimages and release a trail of golden sparkles while moving.
armor.headpieceBonus: Increases your max number of minions by 4 · 55% increased summon damage · Summoner Tarragon, Bloodflare and Silva armor effects · Hold Shift to view these set bonus details and press Shift repeatedly to cycle through them Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · Summons a life aura around you that damages nearby enemies · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · Summons polterghast mines to circle you · Grants 20 defense when below 50% life · Inherited Silva Set Bonus: · Summons an ancient leaf prism to blast your enemies with life energy

armor.name: Gem Tech armor
armor.effect: Power Gems - Six gem fragments idly orbit you; one for each class, and a base gem · Each active gem provides a bonus for its respective class, while the defensive gem grants defensive boosts · Powerful enemy hits will dislodge gems, launching them into the nearest enemy for huge damage · Losts gems regenerate after a while · The lost gem is the same class as the weapon you are using, so better prepare for some weapon switching action! · Hold Shift to see an expanded description A gem is lost when you take more than 100 damage in a single hit · The type of game lost is the same as the class of the most recently used weapon · If said gem has already been lost, the base gem is lost instead · When a gem is lost, it breaks off and homes towards the nearest enemy or boss, dealing a base of 40000 damage · Gems have a 30 second delay before they appear again · The red gem grants 130 maximum stealth, increased rogue stats, and makes stealth only consumable by rogue weapons · The yellow gem provides increased melee stats and makes melee attacks release shards on hit with a cooldown. This cooldown is shorter for true melee attacks · The green gem provides increased ranged stats and causes flechettes to fly swiftly towards targets when they are damaged by a ranged projectile · The blue gem grants 4 maximum minions, increased summon damage, and negates the summon damage penalty while wielding non-summoner weapons · The violet gem grants 100 maximum mana, increased magic stats, and makes mana rapidly regenerate when holding a non-magic weapon · The pink base gem grants 75 defense, increased damage reduction, movement speed, jump speed, and +1 HP/s life regen · When all gems exist simultaneously, hitting a target with any weapon grants you +1 HP/s life regen for 8 seconds · This is increased to +1.5 HP/s life regen if a weapon of another class is used during that 8 second period for 2.5 seconds
armor.desc: Gem Tech armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set.

items.name: Affliction
items.source: Dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode
items.effect: While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

items.name: Dark Sun Ring
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased damage · +0.5 HP/s life regen and +2 max minions · Increased minion knockback · Grants various buffs as the day goes on · 'Contains the power of the dark sun'

items.name: Profaned Soul Artifact
items.effect: It summons all three miniature Profaned Guardians to assist the player.

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

items.name: The Amalgam
items.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

items.name: Chalice of the Blood God
items.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'

items.name: Radiance
items.effect: +1 to +4 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Reduces damage over time taken by 10 HP/s and jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit shining blue light if visibility is enabled · 'A once putrid crystal, now glimmering with immaculate purity'

items.name: Rampart of Deities
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Releases a blast of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health or taking high damage attacks · Reduces damage taken by 25% when below 50% life · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when you are above 25% life · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

items.name: The Sponge
items.effect: After eight seconds of equipping the item without taking damage, a barrier covers its user, which grants 10% damage reduction. As the barrier is formed, it builds up to 120 shield durability at a rate of 12 durability per second.

items.name: Nucleogenesis
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 4 · Grants immunity to Shadowflame and Irradiated · 15% increased summon damage, and increased minion knockback · Minions inflict a variety of debuffs · Minions spawn damaging sparks on enemy hits · Does not stack with downgrades

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Refraction Rotor
weapons.source: Dropped by the Exo Mechs after XM-05 Thanatos has been defeated last
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a gravity-defying disk that passes through tiles and pierces nine times. The disk sticks to enemies and continuously damages them before exploding into several homing blades in a flower pattern.

weapons.name: Supernova
weapons.effect: Disables normal stealth generation · Hold ⚒ Use / Attack to generate stealth, or hold ⚷ Open / Activate to toss the bomb without generating stealth · Tosses a smart bomb that locks onto and tracks targets · If no target is found it will return to you · Each bomb creates a miniature Miracle Blight supernova that drags in weak enemies and chases strong enemies · Stealth strikes create a blast that shakes the foundations of reality itself

weapons.name: Celestus
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly throws a high velocity scythe that pierces infinitely, passes through tiles and returns to the player after traveling a moderate distance. Every time it hits an enemy, it releases 8 double-edged phantom blades that travel outward from the point of impact.

weapons.name: Dimension-Tearing Disk
weapons.source: Dropped by The Devourer of Gods
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a disk that passes through tiles and returns to the player after traveling a moderate distance. When thrown at nearby enemies, it will fire a nebula laser beam that deal 70% of the weapon's damage.

weapons.name: Dynamic Pursuer
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a high-velocity boomerang which returns on hit or after 0.75 seconds. It initially moves slowly upon returning, but gradually accelerate until it reaches the player.

weapons.name: Seraphim
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a holy dagger that naturally slows down exponentially as it travels, while also reducing its speed by 60% for each enemy hit. After 0.83 seconds, it glows and bursts into 6 daggers and an angelic light orb.

weapons.name: Wrathwing
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a fiery javelin which homes in on enemies while releasing gravity-affected fireballs as it travels, which explode violently on contact. The javelin also inflicts the Dragonfire debuff.

weapons.name: The Old Reaper
weapons.effect: When fired, it throws a scythe which spawns unstable isotope projectiles on enemy hits that explode after a brief delay.

armor.name: Auric Tesla armor
armor.effect: Inherited Universal Set Bonuses: Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · Increased heart pickup range · Enemies have a chance to drop extra hearts on death · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · Enemies below 50% life drop a heart when struck · This effect has a 5 second cooldown · Inherited God Slayer Set Bonus (if applicable): · Press Dimensional Drive to Dimensional Drive towards your cursor for 1.25 seconds · Enemies you dash through take massive damage · During Dimensional Drive you are immune to damage and most debuff · Dimensional Drive has a 45 second cooldown · Inherited Silva Set Bonus (if applicable): · +3 HP/s life regen · 5% increased max run speed and acceleration · Taking fatal damage will revive you and make you invulnerable to all damage for 5 seconds · This effect has a 5 minute cooldown, which does not decrement if any bosses or events are active
armor.desc: The Auric Tesla armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is equipped, the player will emit afterimages and release a trail of golden sparkles while moving.
armor.headpieceBonus: +130 maximum stealth · Rogue Tarragon, Bloodflare and God Slayer armor effects · Hold Shift to view these set bonus details and press Shift repeatedly to cycle through them Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · After every 50 rogue critical hits you will gain 2.5 seconds of damage immunity · This effect has a cooldown of 25 seconds · While under the effects of a debuff you gain 10% increased rogue damage · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · Grants 30 defense when above 80% life · Inherited God Slayer Set Bonus: · 10% increased rogue damage, critical strike chance, and velocity when at full health · Increased length of invincibility when taking over 80 damage in one hit

armor.name: Gem Tech armor
armor.effect: Power Gems - Six gem fragments idly orbit you; one for each class, and a base gem · Each active gem provides a bonus for its respective class, while the defensive gem grants defensive boosts · Powerful enemy hits will dislodge gems, launching them into the nearest enemy for huge damage · Losts gems regenerate after a while · The lost gem is the same class as the weapon you are using, so better prepare for some weapon switching action! · Hold Shift to see an expanded description A gem is lost when you take more than 100 damage in a single hit · The type of game lost is the same as the class of the most recently used weapon · If said gem has already been lost, the base gem is lost instead · When a gem is lost, it breaks off and homes towards the nearest enemy or boss, dealing a base of 40000 damage · Gems have a 30 second delay before they appear again · The red gem grants 130 maximum stealth, increased rogue stats, and makes stealth only consumable by rogue weapons · The yellow gem provides increased melee stats and makes melee attacks release shards on hit with a cooldown. This cooldown is shorter for true melee attacks · The green gem provides increased ranged stats and causes flechettes to fly swiftly towards targets when they are damaged by a ranged projectile · The blue gem grants 4 maximum minions, increased summon damage, and negates the summon damage penalty while wielding non-summoner weapons · The violet gem grants 100 maximum mana, increased magic stats, and makes mana rapidly regenerate when holding a non-magic weapon · The pink base gem grants 75 defense, increased damage reduction, movement speed, jump speed, and +1 HP/s life regen · When all gems exist simultaneously, hitting a target with any weapon grants you +1 HP/s life regen for 8 seconds · This is increased to +1.5 HP/s life regen if a weapon of another class is used during that 8 second period for 2.5 seconds
armor.desc: Gem Tech armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set.

accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.17 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 50% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava and damaging tiles, including Auric Ore · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Taking speed EVEN FURTHER BEYOND!'

accessories.name: Wings of Rebirth
accessories.effect: When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 15% reduced contact damage from enemies · Replaces Adrenaline with the Nanomachines meter · Unlike Adrenaline, you lose no Nanomachines when you take damage, but they stop accumulating for 1 second · With full Nanomachines, press Adrenaline Mode to heal 180 health over 2 seconds · While healing you take [DR]% less damage · 'Nanomachines, son'
